reviews.author: gr8cie10
reviews.text: Warning!  #childrenshospitalMy daughter got in a car accident few months ago and she was seen at Overlake Hospital.  They did what they can do to help my daughter but because she had dental trauma (loss tooth and 4 more bottom front teeth almost out), I called our dentist in Bellevue.  On the voicemail, it says if it's an emergency, to go ahead and take my daughter to Children's hospital.  We were so afraid that we were running out of time so we went ahead and not wait for my dentist to open and drove to Seattle for immediate help.We get to Seattle Children's and they had us sign papers, took us in and told them what happened and the reason why we went there.  I gave them the paperwork given to us by Overlake Hospital to review.I told them I don't need anything else done, I just want a dentist to look at my daughter's barely hanging on teeth.  They said they have a call out to the dentist, an hour later, no dentist yet.  I was getting frustrated because they kept checking on us but the dentist was not showing up.  I told them my frustration and they called the dentist again.  Because we were waiting so long, I decided to call my daughter's regular dentist.  They told us if we want to come back to Bellevue, they will make room for us.Since we were already at Children's I waited a bit longer.  We finally heard back and what they told us is, the dentist is not going to be coming but they want us to drive to his office when his office opens.  Isn't this ridiculous?  I went to the hospital to be seen right away but now they want us to wait then drive to their location?I was so disappointed, I left and went to our regular dentist.  The doctor that was there was so apologetic but bottom line is, what we needed was help.  I felt the dentist didn't care that my daughter was already going through an ordeal and didn't even care.  The next day, I called and had to leave a message.  I got a voicemail back to call but it was so dry and no apology.  I told myself they better not charge for that visit so I decided to deal with it when the time comes.Now I find out this hospital is charging us for that visit, how ridiculous is that!  I called them livid, the person I had on the other line put in the request to remove the charges and I got a letter this week saying these are legitimate charge.  What nonsense!  Children's Hospital, may I remind you I came in to have my daughter's teeth looked at by a dentist, this darn dentist didn't think it's serious enough?  I have one tooth missing now, 4 more teeth just barely hanging, time is of the essence, what the hell!  The dentist never came, that's why we were there, so how is that charge legitimate?  I had to pay a lot of money for Overlake because they were the first responders, they did the work that's why they got paid.  You, Children's Hospital never did what we need done so why are you collecting?

reviews.author: Michael Savage
reviews.text: Awful, horrible, worst experience ever in the history of experiences. DO NOT BRING YOUR CHILD HERE unless you want horrible treatment and false CPS allegations brought against you.I cannot even begin to list everything that was wrong with this experience. We tried to get our son, who has long history of mental illness, lying and violent behavior, admitted to the PBMU. He has been admitted two times prior once for two weeks and the other time for three weeks (there average stay is 3-5 days). We made it clear that was once again an immediate risk to himself and others yet for some reason he wasn't admitted. When my fiancee wasn't able to come pick him up due to her health issues we was told to go to sleep and could pick him up in the morning. Then at 3:55 am I received a call from children's hospital caller ID stating that he was a police officer (didn't leave a call back) and said that he would be calling back in 5 minutes and we better answer or he would be filing a case to prosecutor for arrest for possible child abandonment. After dealing with CPS they were shocked as well that they had ever needed to get involved and everyone agreed he should have been admitted to the PBMU. I am floored at the utter unprofessional (and sheer disregard for the actual facts) demonstrated by the ER staff (especially Marie the mental health evaluator at the time of his visit) at this time. CPS got involved and helped in making the determination our son needed to go to long term residential treatment which is all we were trying to do in the first place.It is our intention to file a complaint with the department of health and we will be looking into the possibility of filing a law suit for false CPS report made among other basis.

reviews.author: Nina Yazvenko
reviews.text: This is a review for Urgent Care part of Seattle Children's Hospital. In short, it took me full 2h to get my 2 year old with a simple bacterial pinkeye through their "urgent" care at 8pm on a week day. The doctor was great, but it took us 1h to get to see the doctor, and there was 1 other baby in front of us! reviews.text: After finding out my daughter needed an operation and we were referred to seattle childrens I heard great things about it and although we were scared to begin this process we felt like we were in the best hands possible.It was VERY difficult to get into see a doctor and we were referred to several doctors before finally seeing the one who would be doing the operation. Each apt was an hr to 2 later than scheduled and one time we were even told we had been double booked and would need to reschedule.Pre-surgery apt - we were rushed, Q's answered but doctor was not friendly, looked extremely tired and treated us like we were just another case on his long list he couldn’t wait to get done with.Surgery - quick operation. Talked to us after and told us she was in recovery and it would be 30 mins max before they beeped us. an hr later a nurse urgently rushes into the waiting room asking for us to come back to the recovery room....worried as heck we found out she just was very upset and ripping iv's out. Told us they had been asking for us to be paged for 30 mins.....miscommunication between their staff we were told.Our stay - nurses, PT and ortho staff all couldn’t tell us how to place her in the carseat that was ordered for us because she wouldnt fit into regular ones with her cast. Overall knowledge of my daughter spica cast (body cast) was minimal and I felt staff were not educated on it very well. My daughter is on a soy diet....which was discussed prior to surgery day...and still no soy milk or formula for her. I went to cafeteria myself and used our own formula to mix with it from home we luckily had. With one nurse we were ignored and at times I had to ask for things (including meds) 3 to 4 times before they would reach us way late and daughter in pain.Overall I can say I am happy I researched ahead of time in the little time we had to once we found out she would need surgery. I would urge parents to be their childs voice and go with your instincts. Be very persistent and ask for things you need.Surgen said he would need to see my daughter a week to 10 days after her surgery....called once we got out of the hospital and told it would be 2 weeks before an apt was open and that was a work in apt.

reviews.author: Oxana- Mona Moore
reviews.text: I chose this orthodontist based on a recommendation and the very high rating on Google. The staff at the clinic are friendly and the office environment is pleasant.However, during my treatment I realized that most of the orthodontic work was done by assistants rather than the doctor himself. The doctor would give instructions, but in my experience it didn’t always seem like the results were closely checked.My teeth were initially brought forward to open my bite. However, at one point they were pulled too far to the left by mistake, and then the team tried to move them back to the right. During those adjustments the wire was over-tightened, and the teeth on the right side ended up tilting inward.At one point, when I raised concerns, the doctor looked at my original photos and asked if the issue had been there before I started treatment. That moment made me question the progress we had made.Eventually the doctor suggested removing my braces and said we had achieved the treatment goals. However, by that time I had already noticed an asymmetry in my bite that had developed during treatment. Even with that concern, I was told the treatment was finished.Because I still had doubts about my bite, I went to another orthodontist for a second opinion. After my consultation, that orthodontist called my treating doctor. I don’t know what they discussed, but afterward I was told that the clinic would not be taking me as a patient.I’m not a confrontational person. I simply came in hoping to get a healthy, beautiful smile like the one that was promised by the doctor’s reputation.Visually my teeth may look straight, and I have been wearing my retainers consistently as instructed. But the inward tilt of my upper teeth is now affecting the angle of my lower teeth, pushing them inward and exposing the necks of the lower teeth. I also continue to deal with headaches and neck pain.Now, about a year after my braces were removed, it’s clear that I will likely need to see another specialist and possibly go through orthodontic treatment again to correct my bite.If I had known this would be the result, I would NEVER have agreed to this treatment 😞

reviews.text: I have deleted my old review (which was 5 star as well) to add an updated one! Doctor Roos and all staff in his office are amazing. I have wore braces for a year at age 35! Even though there was a lot of work to be done I asked Dr. Roos to make a plan to prioritize the minimal possible  ‘time in braces’ over discomfort. He explained the plan and limitations and I ended up finishing everything in little over a year instead of almost 2 years as proposed at beginning. My smile is beautiful ever since.Both of my daughters are Dr. Roos’ patients now. The older one (12), started braces very early. She needed several things to be corrected as her teeth/bite were developing. She wore braces for a year at age 7 and the major things were fixed. We knew she would need another round of braces to correct more things and overbite. That was not possible before age 10 when some of the permanent teeth come out. She is now finishing the second round and things are looking good already. Few more month to go, and she will have a beautiful smile 😊. Dr. Roos is a magician!My younger one (9) started Invisaline few months ago, to widen her teeth and make room for larger permanent teeth to come in. By starting treatment as soon as possible (before more problems occur), my daughters will be done with braces in shorter time. We are so grateful to Dr. Roos for being proactive and so professional!I also can not explain how professional, skillful, pleasant and gentle all staff is! My kids have been really small when they stared braces and in so many appointments we have done in the past few years, not once they felt any pain or discomfort. The staff is so sweet that girls really enjoyed visiting the office!If your kids need braces, this is a place to go!

I just got done with the entire treatment and I couldn’t be more happy with the result.Dr Roos is a top-notch specialist, helped me a lot along the process with the requests/accommodations and worked together with my periodontist for implants and bone graft.Last but not least, his ortho Assistances are rockstars. They do their job professionally and just everyone is so positive and friendly.Special Thanks to Deb (assistant) as she took care of me on my last 2 appointments.Friendly staff and good atmosphere.

I was hesitant when it came to having braces put on at 30 years old but the consultation with Gail was a breeze and she helped put into perspective all of the benefits that would come of having straight teeth and not that they would just look pretty. They handled 100% of my insurance and set up easy payments so all I had to worry about was having them put on. From there Vickie has been handling my chart so I have an ongoing dialogue with one person who understands the challenges of my treatment plan. When decisions are needed to be made they let me know my options and I can ask as many questions as I want before I make a final decision. Overall Dr. Roos makes the appointments easy, painless and to the point!Bonus: Dr Roos' office works nicely with the dentist next door so I can schedule a cleaning and a tightening in one day and not have to move the car.

reviews.text: Roos Orthodontics has the most professional, efficient, and wonderful staff I have encountered in an Orthodontic office. Extremely kid friendly and very reasonable prices!

reviews.author: Rick Goetter
reviews.text: Dr. Roos and his team are the most efficient, skillful and knowledgeable group of medical professionals I have ever met. I highly recommend Roos Orthodontics for all orthodontic patients.

reviews.author: Richard M.
reviews.text: Excellent experience all around.  My case provided some challenges, but both Dr. Roos and the staff were friendly and up-front about everything throughout the process.

reviews.text: Highly recommend Dr. Roos and office. Always have been on time, great about scheduling and working with you! reviews.text: Dr. Roos and his team always exude professionalism and they always provide exceptional service. I would highly recommend Roos Orthodontics for anyone looking for top orthodontic care on the Eastside!

reviews.text: Myself and all three of my children have received excellent orthodontic care at Roos Orthodontics. I would highly recommend Dr Roos.

reviews.author: Michelle Tresemer
reviews.text: Best possible experience and outcome. Made braces a breeze!

reviews.author: Sarah Thatcher
reviews.text: Our experience as an entire family at Roos Orthodontics has been Exceptional! Our eldest daughter was their first patient from our family. We were so pleased With Roos Orthodontics that my Husband decided to use them to correct his own teeth. Our second daughter has completed her braces treatment with great success, and our 3rd daughter is now finishing her treatment. We only have one more child who will need braces, and he too will be a patient of Dr. Roos. The treatments and office visits are exceptionally well planned and performed...Dr. Roos is so knowledgeable about orthodontics and his staff really know what they are doing...and he custom treated each one of my family members! He is easily accessible (one time he even arranged for an associate to reattach a bracket when we were out of town!) His office staff is also fantastic. My 3rd daughter actually looks forward to her visits, and feels like she's a favorite of the office staff! There are a few above and beyond bonus points I'd like to share about Dr. Roos and his team...They have a very kid friendly office with xbox, movies and monthly contests. My favorite so far was the "guess who's nose this is" when Dr. Roos and his staff made casts of their noses and the patients got to compete for a prize by guessing correctly. They also have an annual pumpkin contest with the patients voting on the best creation by Dr. Roos and his staff.Most of my friends and acquaintances also use Dr. Roos, many thru my recommendation and the recommendation of other patients I know

reviews.author: M Kim
reviews.text: We have been very pleased with Dr. Roos and the entire staff.  Dr. Roos was very thorough in the initial consultation, explaining the detailed care plan, and follows up on each visit with next steps and progress made. It is impressive to see the consistent, high level of care he and the staff deliver with all patients in the open office environment. It is also easy to schedule appointments as the staff is very flexible with helping find solutions for busy schedules!   The office is clean, updated, and offers the latest in technology in a very welcoming environment.There are fun, in-office games, and rewards and incentives for good at home care. The excellent service by each and every staff member makes the entire family feel comfortable in the office, not just the patient.

reviews.author: JK C
reviews.text: Child at 9 years old was referred to Roos by dentist for slight crowding of bottom teeth. Roos evaluated and wanted to expand upper teeth after xray stating 1 adult canine "may" not have enough room. I felt unsure as crowding was so slight but trusting Roos' expertise, went along with expansion/braces for thousands of dollars, had to move middle of treatment to another state, expansion not only looked ridiculous as it made upper teeth stick out way over bottom, had trouble chewing food as teeth did not align properly, couldn't close mouth easily as upper lip had hard time going over expanded upper teeth. Continued with new ortho who after adult teeth came in stated 2 upper adult teeth needed to be pulled out to properly align upper and bottom. Years later and thousands of dollars later, teeth are aligned properly, not looking silly with much larger upper, and mouth more easily closed. I'm writing this review to warn any parents who may be told that their child should get an upper expansion especially when there is just slight crowding and a "may" not have enough room. It is understood when there is severe crowding that expansion would be option but my child's was so slight and later to find out 2 adult teeth needed to be pulled out anyway. It feels this early expansion approach by this ortho may be placed on parents/children who really could wait until more adult teeth come in. Advice is to consult with as many orthos as possible and go with the most conservative one. Thankful we have found one now, have a second child who has more upper crowding than my first, and this ortho still wants to wait until more adult teeth come in. Roos seemed like a nice orthodontist but again i'm leaving this review so other families do not experience what we have thousands and thousands of hard earned dollars later and frustration over the years for something that could have been avoided if we just waited until more adult teeth came in to be sure. It is understood expansion is done early when palate is expandable but again for slight crowding and "may" not have enough room, it was definitely not necessary for our child. Be careful families, as kind as some may be, they may have their financials/their business in mind over your families hard earned dollars and your child's appearance and comfort no matter what they say and how they treat you.

reviews.author: Daniel Lee
reviews.text: Roos Orthodontics exists for one purpose and that is to ensure that all your dental treatments are met to the highest standard. The moment you enter the office, the atmosphere is filled with warm welcomes and a comfortable waiting room. Roos Orthodontics also prides on the latest technology and software, so don't forget to check-in at the self-service kiosk (if you are a repeat patient) and throw a beautiful smile at the ladies sitting behind the desk. Your attending technicians are one of the best in the field, so you can't really go wrong with any of them. They are knowledgeable, caring, friendly, and gentle. Finally, you will meet Dr. Roos. He is extremely professional and courteous to his patients and he advocates on your behalf. He wants nothing but the best for you and he listens to all of your concerns and questions. When I think of Roos Orthodontics, I think of family. They are a family of believers who believe in the best care for you. Stop by today and get your orthodontic treatment from Dr. Roos. You will not regret it.

reviews.author: Jeff Hansen
reviews.text: My daughter completed her treatment with Roos Orthodontics a little over a year ago, and we are thrilled with the results; she always had a beautiful smile - but now it is a beautiful, and straight, smile.  I was very impressed with the offices willingness to work around important deadlines in my daughter's life (i.e. waiting until after school pictures were taken to put braces on, and fitting us in to a tight schedule to accommodate family pictures once her treatment were over.) Small things like these made me feel Dr. Roos and his staff cared about us as individuals, not just as a patient; this sentiment was echoed every time we came into the office and the staff welcomed my daughter by name.  Dr. Roos was professional and friendly - a great combination.  I have referred Roos Orthodontics many times - and will continue to do so.  We were 100% satisfied.

reviews.author: Pauline Rickey
reviews.text: Roos Orthodontics is an amazing practice.  Dr. Roos and his staff are friendly and caring of their patients.  I was the first in my family to visit Dr. Roos for braces as my lower front teeth were pushing against my upper front teeth causing them to become loose.  My dentist suggested I see an orthodontist. I heard about Dr. Roos from parents at my kids school and decided to make an appointment.  I told Dr. Roos I wasn't concerned about aesthetics.  In the end I had to choose between loosing my loosen front teeth or having braces to realign them.  I chose to have braces.  In addition, Dr. Roos for a few years would see my young kids to ensure we catch any orthodontic needs.  In the end, both my kids needed braces.  My oldest was developing an under-bite.  So, I needed to decide if we correct the under-bite with braces and afterwards with the use of retainers, he may not have to have surgery to realign his jaw.  There is no guarantee; however, at least as a student in high school, he doesn't have to deal with possibly needing surgery like a fellow schoolmate of mine when I was in 11th grade.  My youngest teeth were becoming crooked because his mouth was too small for all the adult teeth that were coming in.  With the use of an expander and braces, he is in the final stages of having his teeth correctly aligned.We are very thankful for Dr. Roos and his staff and would highly recommend his practice.

reviews.author: Neelima Rachapudi
reviews.text: The staff and Dr Roos are decent. They do a good job. But they are very busy. Unless you make appointments a month or two in advance, you'll never get the day and time you want. They are closed on the days the schools are closed so you are forced to pull them out of school for the appointments.

He then gave me a referral to UW's office of student dentistry.When I called them they had no idea why I would be referred to them, especially since it's the middle of summer and they don't even have students. I called Bright Now back and they insisted it wasn't a mistake but finally referred me somewhere out of my insurance network. That dentist advised me to never go to Bright Now and I couldn't agree more.

reviews.author: Adrienne Karls
reviews.text: I'm disabled and have a service dog. Everyone was very accommodating and thoughtful. The office manager even said she would sit with Buster if I needed her to. By far the best treatment to a dental (and many other medical providers) office in decades!

reviews.author: Emilie Newsham Novak
reviews.text: Unprofessional and unreachable - please read the rest of the reviews before booking an appointment here. If you have any concerns after your appointment or need to cancel or reschedule, you cannot reach them - their phone number (including the one they will auto-reply with here) will never be picked up and their voicemail box is full, so you can’t leave a voicemail. They weren’t sure they had time to do a cleaning at my scheduled exam (?) and diagnosed me with 5 cavities even though I’ve been seeing a dentist every 6 months for 30 years and have never had one. I suddenly got 5 cavities in 6 months? I don’t think so. I will be seeking a second opinion and I guess I’ll be a no-show at my appointment since nobody will answer my calls requesting to cancel. Also, the x-Ray technician knocked one of my teeth during the x ray process and the dentist commented that it was loose during the exam. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.text: Had the second of a series of procedures. The lobby staff is welcoming. The dentist and assistant worked well together. As pleasant as can be expected for a dentist visit.

reviews.author: Wentao Wang
reviews.text: A bill from Bright Now! Dental hat has been incorrectly referred to a third-party collection agency.We find the dental insurance Explanation of Benefits confirming that the bill has been paid in full. I find the dental clinic treatment history, which matches the services listed on the EOB.Despite this evidence of payment, the dental clinic has continued to send us bills and has moved the account to collections. When we contacted the clinic to resolve this, we were informed that because the bill is now with a third party, they cannot assist us. We find this response unacceptable given that the records clearly show the balance is zero.

reviews.author: Jae Lee
reviews.text: These private equity owned mega firms make medicine terrible - there’s no accountability or standards. They cancelled my wife’s appointment without telling her, and when she showed up, they realized that they never called. She had to wait for 45 minutes and the cleaning lasted 15 minutes. I also scheduled something that I was assured was a cleaning, but they called me 30 minutes before my appointment to tell me that I had to rebook the cleaning. Impossible to get good care here. We are changing dentists.

reviews.author: Emma Gorman
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Bright Now Dental for my entire life and my most recent experience to get a cleaning made sure that I will never be a customer again. I made an appointment after trying for several days because they’re phone system and online system were not working, a week in advance I made an appointment for 12:30 on a Tuesday, and on the day of the appointment received a confirmation email, though it said for 1:00pm. When I arrived the receptionist informed me that I was rescheduled because it overlapped with their lunch hour  and I assumed they meant for the half hour discrepancy between my appointment and the email. I was wrong, after waiting for an hour I asked to use the bathroom before getting in the chair and the receptionist informed me that I did not have an appointment, and would need to reschedule for another day. I can understand this was a miscommunication and the receptionist did not intentionally make me sit for an hour, but would’ve appreciated much more clarity especially because I received no advanced notice of the cancellation, but got a same day confirmation. I was rescheduled for the next week, and when I arrived I was told I would not be able to be seen because their power was out. Again, outside of their control but the level of service received was not that of a professional office who had already cancelled on me, and this being the second day off work I’d taken. I was rescheduled again, for 3:00pm two days later, the day before my appointment they emailed me to reschedule me for 2:30. Not a big deal, but seriously, get it together. There are other dentists, with better care. When I finally had my cleaning they forgot to administer fluoride until I asked for it, and also had trouble locating my x-rays and needed someone to come in to assist. the whole situation was very discouraging especially because I have been a life long client.

reviews.author: Ally Harrison
reviews.text: As soon as i walked in and i was greeted from very friendly staff. The assistant that helped me was super professional and made me feel so comfortable. As i was waiting it was a pleasant atmosphere and i was acknowledged by a financial advisor to go over my expenses for my visit. The dentist i saw made me feel safe, comfortable and happy that i will be able to fix my smile, the Xray assistant was also so supportive and helpful made my visit anxiety free. This is my new dentist office and i will be recommending this dentist office to others.

reviews.text: THE FRONT DESK WAS WELCOMING AND MADE ME FEEL VERY COMFORTABLE. reviews.author: L
reviews.text: Apparently the appt I scheduled was just for a 10 minute look in my mouth and I had to schedule cleaning separately, which they said they may or may not have openings for that day, and then I had to schedule fillings separately, so I had 3 separate appts spread out across the day and ended up having to take the full day off work. The dentist seemed competent but didn't communicate about what she was doing or even tell me how many cavities I had, just that I had them. Hygenist was good/gentle and another assistant was also nice.

reviews.author: Kleber Balao
reviews.text: I highly recommend their service.The doctor, the best hands down.Very attentive and highly skilled, not a single oversight, she knows her thing, and honesty speaks volumes.

reviews.author: Michael Aly
reviews.text: My hygienist is very efficient, I get in and out quickly. But also very careful and check in with me to make sure I’m feeling OK And comfortable.

reviews.author: Diana Klatte
reviews.text: I called for tooth pain and they scheduled me the next day to get it checked out. They offered several options for the following week to get the needed work done.  Kind and compassionate about my mouth sensitivity and nervousness with dental issues.

reviews.author: Chelsey Davanzati
reviews.text: Changing my review from five stars to two.I had been using this company for almost 10 years for my dental work. The dentists and hygienists we’re all great. I left last year when I went in for a normal cleaning which has always cost me $35. Before I went in a receptionist who I had not seen before handed me a bill that was about $250. I questioned the charges and she said that the company is doing new services for better cleanings that prevent infection and better screenings for oral cancer. I’m in my late 30s and don’t have dental issues and did not need any of this. She made it sound like these charges were not optional and that I had to pay them. I politely questioned and discussed this with her for about five minutes and told her I did not need them. She would not remove the charges and finally said that I could go back and talk with my hygienist about it. My hygienist straight up told me that this is something new the company is doing and I did not need these treatments so the charges were dropped.I work in the medical field. Adding charges to someone’s bill that they do not need without any discussion or consent and automatically trying to charge them for it is borderline illegal and ethically very wrong. I left and got a new Dentist because it’s pretty clear that the company changed their values and are looking to make as much money as they can.I recently saw a new dentist and went to pay for my cleaning afterwards and they said that my insurance covered everything. I questioned them and asked because I’ve always had to pay $35 in the past with Bright Now, they said no my insurance covers everything. So now I’m questioning if for almost a decade I was paying money that I didn’t need to.

reviews.author: Ibis Agosto
reviews.text: I went to this location for about 2 years. It is a touch and go type of place, which is not my style. Lots of up selling of services. Overall, not for me.

reviews.author: Mary F Scott
reviews.text: Got my teeth cleaned yesterday. Felt great. No problems, fast and friendly. I appreciate setting my every six month cleaning up every time.

reviews.author: Jason

reviews.author: Colin Keeney

reviews.author: Derek Shepard
reviews.text: The cleaning was great; however, they tried to say I had the start of a cavity and wanted to charge me $850 for one filling despite having great dental insurance (I didn't have a cavity).The reality is they are a DSO and owned by Smile Brands, which is owned by private equity. They have quotas to meet and upsell their patients. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: aaron hamilton
reviews.text: Place is really nice. It was my first  visit  here. I really enjoyed the cleaning  I got done  in this visit. Happy  to become a new client here.

reviews.author: Andre Golard
reviews.text: The two at the front desk treated me poorly. They were somewhat rude. They told different stories about why I had to wait (ultimately for an hour), while other patients (at least two with appointments after mine) were sent in. When I was finally let in, it was to meet a dentist, not the orthodontist my referral was for.

reviews.author: Alison Perry
reviews.text: My experience with Bright Now has been horrible. After paying my copay for extractions I was bombarded with calls and bills saying that my insurance had not payed and that I owed the balance.I filed a grievance with my insurance, who after review agreed I had paid my share. I discussed this with Bright Now who refused this explanation. I then filed a complaint with the Washington State Office of the Insurance Commissioner. They again assured me that this balance was between the two companies and that I paid my share.I have called several times and left many voicemail asking to resolve this dispute with no return calls or mail.Update: I got this pithy response to call the office. I HAVE!! MANY TIMES FOR MONTHS! YOU NEVER ANSWER!!DO NOT USE THIS OFFICE! WORST SERVICE AND PREDATORY BILLING PRACTICE!

reviews.author: cherry
reviews.text: The clinic is very nice and clean and the stuff is very kind :)

reviews.author: Noah Nguyen Hough
reviews.text: I strongly recommend avoiding this office due to their unprofessional and unethical billing practices. We were overcharged and found several random, questionable items on our bill. Most notably, they charged $85 for "adult oral hygiene instructions," despite the fact that my husband received absolutely no instructions or guidance during his visit. Also, how would 'hygiene instructions' cost 85 dollars?​It is deeply concerning to see a medical office tacking on significant charges for services that were never performed. After looking deeper, it seems this is not an isolated incident. I encourage everyone to read through other recent reviews before booking an appointment here.​This experience felt predatory and unprofessional. We will not be returning and suggest you look elsewhere for dental care to avoid being overcharged for services you didn’t receive.

reviews.author: Christa Rodriguez
reviews.text: If I could have given 0 stars I would have!!!! I was transferred to the Northgate office because I moved. The person that answers the phone is rude and doesn't have a lot of knowledge on policy and scheduling etc. Instead of asking me to hold she let out a huge sigh and fumbled the phone off to the manager. The manager, Amber is extremely rude as well and clearly doesn't want to support patients. I explained to Amber that I could not do multiple appts as I cannot take time off of work. I asked if she could assist with scheduling the dental work for the same day and talk with the orthodontist. I asked If I could schedule to have the work completed that was started in the other office and she told me no. I asked if she could request the records to make this easier on me, I was told no, I would have to schedule a new patient appt. have exam and xray done. Orthodontist would also be another appt. After going back and forth with her I did not schedule and called another office. They said that because I was a patient in another office that I was an established patient, why was this different with Amber at the Northgate office? I was also scheduled to have the work done same day and they were gathering the info from the other office, which Amber refused to do. They also scheduled me same day to see ortho, which Amber refused to even look into and told me I would need to make another appt. Seems all of the complaints are similar. Seems to me that this clinic would do better if they find professional staff that actually want to work with clients instead of shoving their stress on them. Making patients feel comfortable and respected is important. It doesn't cost a dime to be kind, Amber should look for work outside of management and customer service. Bright now in Northgate is losing patients and money because of her and her staff. If you can make the trip to Lynnwood you will at the very least be treated with respect.

reviews.author: Sam Welch
reviews.text: Drilled my tooth too much on a filling and then messed the crown up twice.

If I ever need dental work done that my regular dentist can’t do I will be sure to use Bright Now Dental again

reviews.author: K Germes
reviews.text: Really don’t recommend this place for a couple reasons one it’s a but runned down and has poor maintenance there was a big hole next to the dental chair I was sitting, and the place doesn’t really look clean which is a concern for hygiene, another reason the staff isn’t very friendly and they look like there not happy to be there and lastly I was guaranteed a call back by the end of the day and never heard back from them I tried calling but the line is always busy, will be looking for new options for me and my family. Please take your business elsewhere.

reviews.author: Ana Pulgar
reviews.text: Good services!

reviews.author: Emma Fontaine
reviews.text: I avoid writing negative reviews but I am honestly just shocked at how incompetent and uncaring the office staff are here. I work in healthcare and this level of incompetence would never be allowed.I came in in early December because I had something concerning going on with my gums. They told me they would refer me to UW oral surgery. I gave them a few weeks because it was holiday season and I know schedules are different. I called UW end of December and they said they hadn’t gotten a referral and to call northgate. I called Northgate and they said that was weird but they’d resend it anyways. Called UW again and they said they hadn’t received it but also wanted to check they took my insurance (which the didn’t) so I found south lake union dental to be referred to.I called Britenow and asked them to send in a referral to SLU. They confirmed the email to send it to and said they would get it out in a day or 2. Called SLU in a few days and they said they hadn’t received it. Called Britenow again and asked them to resend. They confirmed the email and said they sent it 3 times but they’d sent again.Called SLU and still no referral. I explained what had been happening and the rep recommended I just have Britenow email me the documents so I could forward them. I called BN again and asked them to send me the referral and chart notes and X-rays. I had to call 10 more times that week (only got through a few times) and spoke to people who said that they had already sent them but they’d send them again. Finally they come through after 2 weeks but it’s just the X-rays and nothing else.At this point they clearly have my correct email because the X-rays have come through. I call at least 30 times over the next 2 weeks and get through a number of times, each person telling me that they’ll send the referral and chart notes to me.Finally this morning I speak to someone and they promise they’ll send them over.  After the call I get a text asking to confirm my email. I confirmed it and they say they’ll send the info over now. After an hour I follow up letting them know I still haven’t received it. Finally after 3 hours I need to run errands and just go in.When I get there it isn’t busy and both the women are on their phones. I don’t mind when staff are on their phones when it’s not busy, but I’m confused about why they can’t call me and follow up about the text I sent hours ago. Especially when I’ve explained that I’ve been trying to get this referral for weeks.When I ask the woman to print my referral and chart notes, she offers to send it over email lol. Then she says, “oh, it looks like it bounced back”. She confirms my email and says “wow that’s definitely not what we had”…. How? You sent me an email with my X-rays last month and I’ve gotten in contact with you a dozen times at this point to confirm it. Also if you have been trying to email the wrong email for weeks (hypothetically) how many times has it bounced back and you’ve done nothing about it?I got the printout and left, but I still can’t believe the lack of integrity at this office. If I were sending a referral at the office I work at and found that it bounced back, I wouldn’t just leave it, I would call the patient to help figure out what’s going on. It’s unclear if there is something going on with their email, firewall, etc, but after this happened over a dozen times they should have looked into it.These interactions left me with a bad taste in my mouth and feeling honestly even worse about the world. Healthcare is really high barrier in the US and even as a person who understands the system/works within it (and went out of their way to problem solve when the referral wasn’t working) I still had to call over 40 times and ultimately come in in order to get a referral I really needed.I hate reviews that are this long but this felt necessary (and was cathartic to write).Hopefully these staff gain a heart and a backbone and realize that they’re in helping roles at some point but in the meantime avoid this office.

reviews.author: Kit Moreland
reviews.text: Visit 1: Booked a check up and cleaning. Lots of waiting around, eventually seen for the check up, told everything was fine but they wanted to replace 3 old fillings. They then told me the hygienist wasn't free so I needed to make another appointment for that and the fillings.Visit 2: Appt started 10 mins late. Had numbing injections given and told they'd be back in 5 mins once it kicked in. I was left for 30 minutes. Dentist and assistant got set up, put tools in my mouth then immediately announced that they needed to go back to a patient in another room - very cold and brusque experience even as I was saying I was pretty anxious.Left for another 5 mins. Dentist and a different assistant came back - aside: literally no one introduced themselves or told me what their role was besides the dentist. Nor did they tell me what they are doing which I find very helpful for feeling comfortable. Once they did the fillings I asked about the cleaning and they said they hadn't noticed that on the appt and I'd have to book another appt for that because it was now closing time and they wanted to go home.3 hours later, one of my fillings fell out.This was all such routine dental care carried out in the worst way I have ever experienced. Stay away.Ended up going to Megan Jones at Mountain to Sound Dental and had the most wonderful experience to replace that filling and get a cleaning.I had to call to cancel my follow up appointments, and I still got appointment reminders and I am now getting marketing spam to reschedule "missed appointments". I had to also call twice to have them email my x-rays over to the new dentist.

reviews.author: Geun Young
reviews.text: Super rude front desk lady will never come back again

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: To be honest, avoid this place if you don't want a headache. I have been a patient here for almost 5 years, and it is always the same story: they issue a bill or estimate that seems fine, then 8 months later the head office calls claiming the insurance didn't accept it and demands more money.On top of that, the front desk is not good at all. They are very rude and unprofessional. It seems their lack of professionalism is exactly what causes these statement issues.I strongly recommend that if you must visit this place, check your coverage with your insurance yourself. It feels like they intentionally put the wrong information on the paperwork to see if you'll pay more. Also, keep your pre-treatment estimates for at least one year to protect yourself from these crazy billing practices.Why should patients have to deal with such wrong and unprofessional behavior?

reviews.author: Linda Hainline
reviews.text: Was told a tooth needed to be extracted because it was loose and had no bone support. It was a tooth all by itself with nothing surrounding it that needed to be protected. Was quoted a price for a surgical extraction instead of a simple extraction. After working in the dental field for 40 years I challenged the coding but they wouldn’t budge. Found other issues while there for my first appointment so I will not be back or will not be recommending them to others.

reviews.author: Orlannie Ma
reviews.text: Rude front desk, ignored customer in line and stepped away.

reviews.author: Chris Forbes
reviews.text: Amazing !! I’m so happy with the treatment ,front desk , the staff where all so nice and caring.. I had been to another dentist in the past and they were unable to extract my tooth.. I can say with all confidence this oral surgeon is calm, knowledgeable, and believer or not. The whole procedure was painless. I was terrified after so many bad experiences at other places.. It definitely gave me confidence in professionalism again❤️🙏🏻 Thank you so much..

reviews.author: M. Mottware
reviews.text: When I was around 11 years old I went through some extensive dental procedures.  For years after I dreaded going to the dentist.  My last visit to Bright Dental Northgate was actually the best experience I have had in decades.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Trudy Tessaro
reviews.text: Showed up for 7 am appointment for my high school daughter to get fitted for the clear aligners, confirmed by the practice twice by text, and the place is dark!?  No one answering the phones. Google maps says it’s open? Did this place suddenly close?

reviews.author: Sampa Pal
reviews.text: Good dentist but desk staff is not helpful. I feel they were very eager or happy to get the high value check from me but did not cooperate to make a call to the pharmacy when I requested right after an intense procedure.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: An experience not to look forward to. Something totally amiss. Booked cleaning but got to be told I could only have an Xray and cleaning to be scheduled for a later date. They promised to get a braces insurance approval confirmed in 2 weeks. After 3 weeks, they stated I wait for 6 weeks. It is now more than 8 weeks and calls go unanswered

reviews.author: jonathan adams
reviews.text: Horrible service  waited an hour to get help with an scheduled appointment.

reviews.author: Madeline Marcy
reviews.text: Booked an appointment weeks in advance. When I got there, they did an x ray and a gum test, then told me it was too late to do the cleaning (for a scheduled appointment?). The next availability they had at the same time was over a month out. Super disappointing and unprofessional.

reviews.author: Paulette Scott
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience. My crown came off. I called. I got in the next day. Everybody was very nice. Very intelligent. Got me on my way and now I’m going to change and go with this new company Bright Now

reviews.author: Stephanie Maeda
reviews.text: The dental hygienists, assistants, and techs severely lacked professionalism and any regard for patient care. Usually I love going to the dentist and look forward to getting my teeth cleaned but this was a terrible experience. While getting my X-rays I asked to wear lead to protect myself and the tech responded that a banana exposes me to more radiation than an X-ray. Though this fact is true I wanted to limit my exposure to radiation when possible. I value and understand the importance of dental X-rays and wanted to have the x-ray completed AND protect myself.The next hygienist who removed the plaque from the teeth was extremely rough, the cleaning was painful, and my gums were bleeding.  She asked how I was doing half way through the cleaning and I told her she was hurting my gums and her response was “huh” and she proceeded to quicken her pace and scrape my my gums just as intensely. She sprayed water all the way down my face and onto my neck and attempted to blot it off. There was still a lot of water on my neck/face so I asked if I could please have a towel to wipe my face and she responded “what water?”.Finally the last hygienist who polished my teeth was also unnecessarily rough when using the vacuum to suction water from my mouth. While my mouth was closed she repeatedly shoved the vacuum forcefully into the rear of my cheeks where it was painful. Additionally her hair was not pinned up and dangling in my face during the polishing.The dentist herself was fine but did not say more than much more than everything looks fine to me.Due to the unprofessional experience and lack of respect toward patient comfort I will not be returning to Bright Now Dental and would never recommend this clinic to anyone.

reviews.author: David Bartlett
reviews.text: Carrying a knowledgeable dentist for a tooth reconstruction & crown. The dentist and hygienist, both showed concern for my comfort and overall safety. The Work was well done and looks good.

reviews.author: Fano
reviews.text: The. Secretary was very rude. I am planning to change my dentist

reviews.author: Pam Williams
reviews.text: I go to this dental office because of Mimi, their dental hygienist. She’s awesome! Excellent at her job, always asking if you’re doing okay, and making you laugh with her sense of humor. She is a true professional with outstanding chair-side manner. Highly recommend her.

reviews.author: Marie Leahy
reviews.text: The staff is always great.

reviews.author: Scott Beck
reviews.text: The dentist was fine and the dental assistant who did my x-rays was wonderful. Unfortunately, the front desk experience was unprofessional. I wasn’t acknowledged when checking in or out, and staff continued a personal conversation while I waited to schedule my next visit. It was uncomfortable and dismissive enough that I’ve decided to transfer to another dental office.

reviews.author: Carlos Bambini
reviews.text: Great service and proactive care.Glad to be a patient.

reviews.author: Steve Schuh
reviews.text: I have a great hygienist at Bright Now, about it’s impossible to get an appointment at my preferred 6-month intervals.  The office is booked 8-9 months out.  Not enough staffing?  Or a business choice?

reviews.author: Cheree
reviews.text: Good experience with my crowns today.

reviews.author: The Benster
reviews.text: The booking experience was terrible. 1. They booked me at a different bright now location. 2. When I called to confirmed, it was not in the correct location when I arrived. It was the other side of the building which cause me to be 10mins late. Then told me because I am late, the dentist can't see me. I had to rebooked and delayed for 2 weeks. 3. When arrived on time at 8am. I didn't get to see the dentist till 8:38am. So it's ok for the dentist to be late but as the patient, given the incorrect location to cause me to be late, it's ok for them. After seeing the dentist, I informed my right top and bottom tooth were in pain. They assessed and said to monitor but should work on the left side (I am sure it needs work). A day later, I think I am tricked as I went in to work on my right side and they rescheduled me to work on the left on Monday. I canceling and never will come bac. Maybe for others, they might have a better experience.

reviews.author: Mckenzee Young
reviews.text: Been coming here for a little over a year and have always had a positive experience. Staff is very kind and always go an extra mile!

reviews.author: Crystal Whale
reviews.text: Don’t come to this business if you can, even other branches of the same dental service is better than this location.They didn’t inform me the machine is broken, sent a message saying I can only do a consultation session, called in but nobody picked up, left a voice message, nobody called back. But when I showed up, there is nobody to even do the consultation with… they didn’t bother to cancel the session (to bill my insurance), nor will they get to voice messages after 24hrs (front desk shifts is another person’s problem)…Wasted a whole day in Seattle traffic. No follow up from the business manager even after leaving a written note.Save your own time and life, don’t waste it on this business.

reviews.author: david strack
reviews.text: Have had the same dental tech for many years now, and she is great, just wish there wasn't such a high turnover of the dentists

reviews.author: Eden Daus
reviews.text: I'm caught up on dental work for the first time in almost a decade! They are helpful and realistic about giving other options of something isn't affordable.

reviews.author: Alberto Silva
reviews.text: Very clean place, everyone starting with the receptionist all the way to the dentist are friendly and very professional.

reviews.author: Alison Boehm
reviews.text: Very professional, clean.  Dr was great with explanation of proceedure (root canal) and options.  Zero pressure.

reviews.author: Brent Brinkley
reviews.text: Nice people went quicker than I thought it would.

reviews.author: Bobby
reviews.text: The customer service, reliability, and communication is average at best. I have been extremely patient, understanding and respectful but have been disrespected by them many times since I first started going a year and a half ago. I have had them cancel appointments on me the day of without much of a warning causing me to miss hours of pay from work. 4 months after my wisdom teeth surgery, they told me I stopped breathing and they had a hard time keeping me alive. They barely explain what’s going on and usually don’t give me enough explanation when I ask. The receptionist doesn’t even have the decency to hold back clear signs of being annoyed with me when I ask these questions when no one ever gave me any paperwork or explanation of what’s going on. Their favorite line to give me now is “we will do some digging around and get back to you with your questions” then don’t ever proceed to follow up with any phone calls or emails.EDIT: The manager Amber, doctors, and surgeon are amazing humans who love and take their job very seriously but the front desk staff is where I’m having issues. I hate that it took me writing them a very bad review for them to take me seriously!UPDATE 7/10/25: I have seen significant improvement in the quality of care and urgency around my questions and concerns! I would give them 5 stars if my past experiences weren’t so frustrating.

reviews.author: Graciela
reviews.text: The hygienists is great! One of the best I've ever had.However, I went into the office recently to reschedule an appointment and later realized the appointment was never booked!They are booked until September so I have to look for another dentist to be seen sooner. This is very disappointing.

reviews.author: Tasha Hamilton
reviews.text: Mouth can barely open after 2 months I only got a crown on one tooth

reviews.author: Jude
reviews.text: Rude, unhelpful, and unprofessional front desk person. If you prefer to be treated with decency, do not bother with this place.

reviews.author: Evan Hoang
reviews.text: I came in for a cleaning and had a great experience with the hygienist—she was thorough and kind. The dentist was okay, though she didn’t seem very engaged with me as a patient, which I guess is common in more corporate dental settings.Unfortunately, my main issue was with the front desk. The staff member I spoke with was rude and overly aggressive when explaining my insurance. I’m fully aware there may be an outstanding balance depending on what’s covered—that’s not the issue. I just wanted a clear explanation, not to be spoken to like a problem.I understand that working in healthcare sometimes requires being assertive, but I came in calmly and simply wanted to understand my charges. The way it was handled felt dismissive and poorly communicated. Being a corporate office shouldn’t mean patients receive impersonal or insensitive service.EDIT: 1-star for the impersonal bot response.

reviews.author: Shuhong Guo
reviews.text: Excellent service for my clear aligners

reviews.author: Allan Villacrez
reviews.text: Great people, fast and professional

reviews.author: Rachel Moore
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience at Bright Now Dental. During my first appointment, the dentist missed a significant amount of calculus below my gumline and only gave me a regular cleaning. Fast forward to today, I went to a different dentist and was told I need a deep cleaning because of the substantial buildup of tartar. This was not addressed by Bright Now Dental, and I feel they should have caught it.Additionally, I was charged a cancellation fee without any prior notification. I wasn’t informed about the fee in advance, and there was no reminder or heads-up before they sent me the bill. It’s very frustrating, and I believe they should have notified me either by text, phone call, or at least mentioned it in advance before billing me.I do not recommend this place and would advise others to consider other options.

reviews.author: Jana Skillingstead
reviews.text: Yikes.  I'll start with a positive point: The young woman that was doing my xrays was trying really hard.  She was nervous and frustrated, but had a good sense of customer service, and really seemed to care.  It appeared that she wasn't adequately trained at this location, and was just left to figure out the equipment on her own.The facility wasn't particularly clean, wasn't very well lit, and most of the staff appeared either frazzled or apathetic.  I went in for a first visit check up/xrays/cleaning.  After the xrays and extremely brief visit by the dentist, I was told they didn't have time for the cleaning, and to reschedule. This was in early March. The next available appt was in November.Also of concern was the two dozen or so HIPAA violations.  While in the exam chair, a screen was facing towards me with a list of patients and their info clearly visible.The sense I get is that the priority is reimbursement, not care.  I do not have faith that this is a safe place to get serious dental work.

reviews.author: Yanilex
reviews.text: Don't come here.. is bad. I wished I would of read the reviews before choosing them.

reviews.author: Shawn Kelleher
reviews.text: I don't leave reviews unless they are either extremely good or extremely bad.Fortunately my experiences with Bright Now has been wonderful.In the past I have had awful dentists who tortured me... However, the lovely people here take great care to make sure you are properly numb and taken care of.I strongly encourage you to give them your business, these are good and kind people who won't rip you off and will go out of their way to minimize your discomfort/pain.

reviews.author: Malakai_hell
reviews.text: This branch of bright now is the worst, I like the other beaches but not this one, been nothing but rude and not helpful, Sarah is the worst dentist I’ve ever had having the audacity to tell me to take a loan out for money to get dental work done, I totally understand care credit which I have but to then tell me to get a loan is totally unprofessional and quite frankly rude. I’ve been to other branches such as lake stevens and maple valley and they were way more thorough with the process and nicer in every way.

reviews.author: Z Ibañez
reviews.text: Unprofessional  dental assistant (Asian Lady). You are the reason why people get dental anxiety. You are not my mom to scold me and say “NEXT TIME, FLOSS EVERYDAY!”  I have repeatedly told the people there I cannot afford the dental cleaning and have to save up.  Too many in the dental industry are not kind, and fail to acknowledge that's one of the many reasons people don't go.

reviews.author: E A
reviews.text: I have a different insurance now and my location has changed. I’m glad I found this dental facility. It’s near where I live and I work from home so driving far is out of the question. The facility is state of the art, great location with easy access, lots of parking, the lady tooth doctor is amazing and the staff are thorough which I so appreciate.  I got early appointments at 7am to complete my mission of best dental health check. Although I had to pay $1000 own pocket for laser gum maintenance, I am very satisfied with it. I know people spend so much more because of lack of maintenance. I like trying out the latest and I can tell the difference. My gums are stronger and my natural teeth and mouth looking perfect. It has been two years since my dentist appointment. I always have good insurance and go to the dentist regularly, however life got busy. I don’t like going to dentist appointments however I like to maintain good health which includes dental health. Thank you for taking care of me!!!

reviews.author: Dessie Spasov
reviews.text: Dr. Ghadak did a crown for me and she is so caring, sweet and amazing. I am deathly afraid of needles but she was so gentle I didn't even feel it, she really put me at ease. She also worked with me and the lab until the crown was perfect. I can't say enough nice things about what a wonderful dentist Dr. Ghadak is!

reviews.author: Scott Eaton
reviews.text: I love this place. Mimi is a pro, so careful and friendly. Wouldn't go to anyone else!

reviews.author: Valencio Socia
reviews.text: Great customer service!  I had two appointments in the same day and the dental assistant went out of her way to see if the doctor (dental surgeon) could start earlier for me so I didn’t have to wait an hour and a half between procedures. She made it happen and it worked out better for everyone and saved me so much time! Thank you!

reviews.author: Tim Tower
reviews.text: Friendly, efficient ladies: Brooke and Rebecca at front desk, and Mimi cleaning my teeth. I have been coming here for perhaps 10 yrs.

reviews.author: Weihong Miao
reviews.text: Don’t come this office. Today very bad experience. Front desk asked pay copay first. Cleaning female staff worked with attitude. Later one female named Amber said no more service let me go. Amber said she is the manager. She came with security guy. Be honest I am a health care provider too. I don’t yell and very quiet. I am quiet all the time because also I got law training a few years. Not good choice for dental appointment. Not professional at all. Should not get any star!!!More: A couple months ago, dentist Sara gave me a temporary crown first but one night broken. Called office and Sara don’t care. She doesn’t care about patients and customers. Sara only cares about money.

reviews.author: Wendy Land
reviews.text: Got an infection in my gumline from a laceration caused when having a crown placed. Learn to treat everyone with gentle hands. For people with Tori this is a sensitive area.

reviews.author: Brian Hartwich
reviews.text: Great staff !

reviews.author: Marla
reviews.text: Everyone was nice and listened to my concerns and needs. Appointments were easy to make.

reviews.author: ABC Chhetri
reviews.text: STUDENTS AND YOUNG ADULTS BEWARE. IF I COULD DO 0 STARS I WOULD. Manipulative staff. Definitely have to do a thorough check of all payments and get everything they “claim” to do in writing!!! Came here due to my tooth hurting and spoke with Rebecca and other office members on the phone. I had expressed to her that I needed to find somewhere where my insurance is taken as I could not afford to pay out of pocket which was communicated multiple times on the phone and in person during the consultation.Next day I come back with no knowledge of paying out of pocket, as they numbed me and proceed to start operating an office lady comes in different from whom I spoke with bringing a paper with the out of pocket balance asking me to sign it as I am on the bed with my whole mouth numb. I could barely speak and felt so overwhelmed and manipulated into signing this paper which I had NO knowledge of prior and was NOT told until after I was already being worked on!!!!  Doctor didn’t even fill my entire cavity and my tooth still hurts and they won’t stop mailing me the bill threatening to contact their claim agent. Ridiculous to even mention.As a student this was by far the worst dental experience I’ve had.This has made me terrified to ever contact another dentist again. I was left with my tooth still hurting. EXTREME lack of professionalism from this place and no sort of empathy or communication honestly.

reviews.author: Nancy Stonehouse
reviews.text: Allways great visits the staff are very personable and Dr Beaty the orthodontist is very caring and has great followup. Highly recommend the northgate branch

reviews.author: Hasan Abdessamad, MD, FRCSC, FACOG
reviews.text: Dr. Vi was excellent. She managed to numb my gum without me feeling it much and was very informative and interested.

reviews.author: Zach Matthews
reviews.text: The staff were nice and very friendly. They were able to squeeze me in for a cleaning the next day after I called. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Regina Harrington
reviews.text: Professional, friendly, efficient, excellent clinician

reviews.author: Renee Case
reviews.text: We went to these people in July to get our teeth cleaned. They only wanted to do X-rays and said they can not schedule cleaning and they are booked out until January. I got up form the x-ray chair and left. By January I will select a different dental insurance if this is the option with SIGNA dental insurance. .

reviews.author: Corey Wukelic
reviews.text: I had the greatest experience with specifically the dental hygienist / dentist that took care of my teeth this week! Gigi or Mimi? I sadly don’t remember exactly but she was incredibly thorough, gentle, and clearly knew what she was doing!

reviews.author: Naomi Armstrong
reviews.text: Horrible experience, rude staffing, should not take in new patients if they are too busy for them.

reviews.author: Vicki Ohge
reviews.text: Everyone is very nice Ethan. The front desk young man helped a lot. Now if we can just get everything straight and I can actually get in there and have something done. I know I will eventually but everybody there is really nice and I had a good experience and I will continue to go there

reviews.author: Jaime Young
reviews.text: The did a quality job of cleaning my teeth. They were competent, efficient, professional, and answered my questions. I did not get a day-of cancellation or find the building closed during my appointment as has happened before.

reviews.author: James Grigsby
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this dental office! I recently broke a tooth for the first time in my life and had no idea what to do. They got me in quickly and were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. I was fitted with a temporary crown that very same day. It was so well done that I completely forgot it wasn’t my real tooth and accidentally broke it while eating something I shouldn’t have (definitely my fault 😬).When I called, they got me in immediately and I was treated by Ebony, who had assisted me the first time. She remembered me and my situation, and in no time, I had a new temporary crown. Ebony made the entire experience fantastic both times, and I couldn’t be more appreciative.I highly recommend this dental office and their amazing team. They turned what could have been a stressful situation into a smooth and pleasant experience. Thank you all!

reviews.author: Tifa Robles
reviews.text: Very friendly staff and they help with my needs every visit.

reviews.author: Marlene Kang
reviews.text: They re glue my left side crown yesterday again and it came off middle of night again.

reviews.author: Cedes Lopez
reviews.text: The people working here are very pleasant however I don't know how much I trust this place anymore. I went in for a routine cleaning. The dentist cleaning was very friendly and thorough and when the doctor came out to tell me about my x rays, she said everything looked fine and that I could go. I had so e concerns about my gums but she said all was good. I got the impression that they just wanted me out of there as fast as possible.I ended up booking an appointment at a different office due to some sensitivities I was having with my gums. The doctor there told me my gums were inflamed but also told me I had a cavity after looking at my X-rays done by bright now from my cleaning. That was concerning as the doctor here told me everything looked good. They completely missed that I had a cavity!I have since started going to this other office for all my dental care needs. From the doctor's at brightnow seemingly not looking thoroughly at X-rays and missing important things and also giving the feeling that patients need to be in and out quickly, I don't feel this is the best place to go for dental care

reviews.author: Nicole Roy
reviews.text: My teeth feel clean, but I’ve had a different dentist each time I’ve gone. I had to remind them to do my x-rays and they only did one on each side to check for cavities on my molars and premolars, they didn’t capture my 1st premolars at all which is less than the standard of the other dental offices I’ve worked at and been to as a patient. When I looked at the x-rays they had a lot of overlap and would make it hard to see small cavities which I am prone to. Good thing I did remind them, because I had small cavities developing and needed a refill for my high fluoride tooth paste prescription which was never sent to my pharmacy. They also did not apply fluoride varnish despite new incipient cavities. One of the fillings I’ve had them do has problems with flossing due to an air bubble being trapped in the composite, it has a very light contact and gets food stuck very easily which can result in localized gum disease and possible bone loss and would need to be redone if I don’t floss after each time I eat, which even for me is inconvenient. They say they schedule you ever 6 months but it’s more like 9 due to only having 1 hygienist. I am not particularly impressed by my care but I know a lot of these things aren’t necessarily their fault, although they still negatively impact us the patients.

reviews.author: jade F
reviews.text: I have been here 4+ times this year to fix some old fillings. I am never numbed enough before we start. I have to ask for more every single time because of the pain. The last filling I had was the absolute worst with throbbing shooting pain that suddenly came out of nowhere because I was not numb. My fear of dentist is exponentially worse because of this. Today, my crown that they put in months ago fell out. They can’t get me in until 6 days from now! I called bright now and they gave me an appointment without asking any questions about the condition of my tooth and I they didn’t give me any info of what I should do until then. I am dreading going in because of my new found phobia. I know it will cause me extreme pain when they put the crown back onto my sensitive nub.

reviews.author: A I
reviews.text: The reception was ignored me every time I approached her. 1) when I approached and try to rearrange the filling appointment for tomorrow and just cleaning for that day. (She said she was busy ask me to sit) 2) when done clearing waited too long and I have to left without making cleaning for next 6 month. Give me a feeling should I go to other dentist for my next cleaning

reviews.author: Rory Baker
reviews.text: I had a good experience. Friendly service and my  appointment was a breeze. 👍

reviews.author: Madeline Cyra
reviews.text: I had a lot of things to do, the staff is professional and friendly, everything was explained to me, so I could understand, am very pleased with everything they have done for me, I can smile now,  and not be embarrassed, thankful for everything you have done for me, I have told my friends about my experience at Bright Now

reviews.author: Chris Jakubowski
reviews.text: Efficient and friendly

reviews.author: Marie Barchasch
reviews.text: The dentist and staff were kind , professional and caring. The only reason why I gave them 4 stars is I was in pain on my left back tooth after I had some work on that tooth. I had taken a total of 8 ibuprofen and the throbbing pain. I called to ask for an antibiotic. I did not want any pain medication. The dentist called in pain medication  which never ones the pain medication which I did not want and I was fine with not having the pain medication. I ended up going to a urgent care and got a antibiotic and the pain went away after 2 days I felt that since I work in the medical field that the dentist should of went ahead and ordered the antibiotic so I didn’t have pain for 2 days . This was a wrong judgement on the dentist’s.

reviews.author: Io Wolf
reviews.text: Horrible experience. The incompetent X-ray tech had no idea what she was doing and then their equipment broke and they didn't know how to fix it. Then I was told I need a procedure that is not covered under any insurance. Sounded to me like they needed to pay off a new fancy piece of equipment. Big grifter vibes on the whole place

reviews.author: Dejene Hailu
reviews.text: It is clean and looks well managed.

reviews.author: Sanyam Rajpal
reviews.text: They don't even offer drinking water to patients

reviews.author: Amy Denton
reviews.text: Went for my first appointment because my insurance changed.  I wasn't told that a cleaning wasn't included in your first appointment and would have to make another appointment. As someone who doesn't do well at the dentist and let them know this, I felt as though they wanted to power through and didn't have much empathy. I was also told that I had 4 cavities that should be filled. I paid out of pocket to go back to my old dentist and was told that I didn't have any cavities and that my teeth looked great. I would not go back to Bright Now Dental. It was a bad experience and I don't trust them.

reviews.author: DyniCari Huber
reviews.text: My latest dental work is complete, and I am happy with the results. Dr. Olga was awesome, my teeth look and feel great!

reviews.author: Stacey McInnis
reviews.text: I am new to the area and needed to find a new dentist.  I have seen the same one for 18 years prior to this.  First of all, the technician was awesome. (Personable, efficient, etc).However, the Dentist, Dr Olga was so rude to me.  I was previously on a 4 month cleaning schedule (I private pay for the extra cleaning per year).  Dr Olga wanted me to get a deep cleaning and then get on a 4 month cleaning schedule.  ( peridontal maintenance).I was fine with that until they couldn't get me on the schedule for several months.  This would put me 7 months between cleanings.  I asked if I could schedule a regular cleaning in the mean time and she was so condescending.  She said insurance would only pay for the deep cleaning since that is what I was doing before   ( I've never had a deep cleaning).  I had to argue with the receptionist and the Dr about scheduling a regular cleaning.  It was so weird. Finally, the Dr said, "It's your health, do what you want". This is after the exam where she said I have great teeth, no cavities.

reviews.author: Lisa Chan
reviews.text: I truly believe this dentist office operates the majority of their business on insurance scams. I take care of my teeth and oral hygiene and have always maintained my 6 month check ins. I had to establish new care because I accidentally signed up for a DMO instead of a PPO. During my first appointment yesterday, the dentist took maybe 10 mins looking at my x-rays and mouth and within the first 3 mins told me I need a crown and if I didn't get it within 6 months, I would like have to have gum surgery. I have never been told by any dentist that I have such decay on any of my teeth or gums. I went to check out and while it seemed urgent for me to get a crown, because they have only 1 hygienist on staff, they told me to get a follow up cleaning was going to take 3 months. After expressing my frustration they were quick to tell me that they'd be happy to transfer care to another dentist of my choosing. Why do easy? Because I had already designated this office for care, they already billed me for xrays and an exam, and to establish care at another office would mean I'd have to pay OOP. Bright Now is a complete scam. Check their reviews. I was warned but given my DMO insurance plan, I had to pick between two dentist offices that both garner terrible reviews - was just trying to pick the lesser of two evils. Horrible experience and I don't trust their diagnosis for one minute. They try to tell you you need significant work immediately so they can get paid, yet seem to think it's ok to have to punt a standard cleaning for 3 months. Absolutely terrible. 0 stars if possible

reviews.author: Trang Phan
reviews.text: Do you want 20+ X-rays and then a consultation with a dentist only to wait several weeks later for a cleaning? Book here. As of 03/2024, they have one dental hygienist on staff. They do not give you that piece of information when you book as new patient.Appt at 7 AM. Not seen until 7:40 AM.Folks were all kind and polite. Facility is nice and lots of free parking, which is a plus.

reviews.author: Mze
reviews.text: Absolute nightmare. It took me a lot of effort and courage to finally go in to the dentist and fix my smile and these people just blatantly lied and shot me down every chance they had. During my first visit a lady in front of me was telling the staff how rude and unprofessional this office was. I should of took that more seriously and left. Unfortunately I did not and received the worst service of my life. The first doctor did absolutely nothing so I won’t talk about him as he was on vacation every time I tried to see him. I had to right my own treatment plan for the future hell I was about to endure. The second doctor actually started the process of fitting my dentures but never saw him again either. When the dentures came back for the try in a third doctor appeared and tried to make them fit even though they where clearly made wrong. She used a grinder tool to try and make them fit which only made them incredibly sharp and jagged and tried to send me on my way with them. That is what the photo shows. Around this time is when things went from bad to worst. I tried to get refitted several times only to have my appointments cancel the same day. They also had me come in only to tell me they forgot to order the paste needed to do the refit. After months of this I finally was able to get refitted. However it didn’t end there. During the process of refit and delivery a fourth doctor tried to give me metal dentures and not the upgraded ones I already payed for. They claimed they didn’t have the paperwork showing the upgrade. When I told them I did have the paperwork and the bank statement to prove it they dropped their lie and sent the upgraded ones through. After a few more cancellations the day of my appointments and I finally received my dentures only to have them barely fit. I just took them and walked out. This whole ordeal took a year and a few months and I still don’t have correct fitting dentures. I have to wait 5 years to be able for my insurance to cover them again or pay out of pocket. These doctors and the staff are rude, unprofessional liars and do not deserve to be in business. Stay far far away from this place. To Charlotte who responds to these emails, who are you? Where were you when I needed assistance getting through all this? You and your PR email is completely useless.

reviews.author: Andrew P
reviews.text: By far the most frustrating dental clinic I’ve been to. At my first visit they still hadn’t l seen me for an hour after my appointment, so I had to reschedule.
