At my new appointment they didn’t do a cleaning at all, even though that’s the only reason I was there! They made me schedule two separate other appointments for that. Incredibly frustrating experience with unapologetic staff.

reviews.author: Tsion Abrham
reviews.text: This business is the worst experience I have ever had. I ordered a mouth guard in December 7,2023 and I have not received it since(February 2024).When I got fitted for the mouth guard, they have suggested I should go with the hard mouth guard instead of soft mouth guard.  when it came, it wouldn’t fit and had things that needed fixing. I got fitted again and exact same thing happened. Both times I had to call them to check if it is available yet; I  was told they will call me as soon as it arrived, and they never did.When I went to get fitted the second time, the dentist assured me the inside will be soft and told me has the same kind herself. When I went to pick the second one, it was exactly the same as the first one; I was told by the assistant that she ordered exactly how the dentist described and showed me the receipt. She also assured me she will call me on Monday. It was a frustrating experience and I wanted never to go back to the place, I have paid more than $200 out of pocket and I requested if I can have my money back instead.They told me the manager is not available and they will contact me on Monday.Monday came, nobody called. I waited until Tuesday and called, left a voicemail, again nobody called. I called Wednesday several times during business hours, they ignored my calls.As a healthcare worker my self, I can’t imagine treating patients like this. I highly advise you to find another provider who actually cares to provide services to the patients with care!

reviews.author: jack lim
reviews.text: People are nice and very generous. Waiting time wasnt long at all. When i had a crown this visit, i had no problem on tooth when i got home. I fell a sleep while getting crown done.

reviews.author: Wes Miller
reviews.text: I've had a really good experience with all the staff who have worked with me here. Mimi is an especially good hygienist, who did my cleaning fast and without ever putting me into any pain. So glad to have found a good dental center, and I look forward to coming back here.

reviews.author: George Castillo
reviews.text: I am new patient of Bright Now Northgate and I went in for a crown due to tooth filling needing to be replaced.  The employees and Dr are all very friendly and accomodating.  They made my experience very pleasant and they have now gained me as a patient who will continue to use them for my dental cleanings and checkups.

reviews.author: PuppiesGetaway
reviews.text: I never leave reviews. However this time I felt I needed to let others know my experience. I went in for a consultation knowing I wanted an implant and a handful of teeth extracted. This was my second consultation. I wanted to make sure my first experience, was not just " oh they are new let's impress them ". When I tell you, I walked in and the same smiling face, remembered my name, what I needed and was ready to start my treatment, I mean it. She was so kind and warm.  The kind that makes you feel like you're family. I spoke with the surgeon, got a price quote and the same smiling woman came in to talk to me about options. I didn't even know I had options. I have been saving for years for this surgery. When I explained that, and was told I could apply for this medical credit card to not have to front everything right at the holidays, I almost cried. The kind woman got me a tissue and apied with me in the same room. When the surgeon heard we were applying, he took extra off my total because " it was the holidays and Amber wanted to help me". I've never had so much kindness in my life. My surgery went great, and I got a chance to speak with Amber at my follow up visit. Turned out that she was the office manager. You would never guessed it. She was in the back, she helped the doctor, she was answering phone's. Most managers don't wear so many hats. This impressed me more. You can tell Amber takes pride in her job, and cares for people. If you want you or your family to be taken care of and treated like family, I recommend this office. Best dental experience I've ever had.

reviews.author: Cody Tesar
reviews.text: Went in for my cleaning and check up before deployment. The hygienist was fantastic, very thorough and took her time cleaning. I was greeted by Amber, the office manager upon arrival, who took the time to go over financing with me. Amber answered all of my questions and was very patient and helpful with the whole process. It's a breath of fresh air to have medical staff who care about your well being.

reviews.author: Emelyn Deal
reviews.text: Excellent

reviews.author: Carolyn Stoebe
reviews.text: The hygienist was fabulous. The dentist was cold and controlling. I did not appreciate her manner with me and will look for another dentist somewhere.

reviews.author: Dave Stringer
reviews.text: Hygienist always makes my visit enjoyable. She is joyful, funny and pleasant To be around!

reviews.author: Akbar Ziaei
reviews.text: Totally I'm not satisfied 🙃. I don't recommend this dental care to anyone. Cancelation fees: 100 box).

reviews.author: Guesh Wubneh
reviews.text: ion luck them. They’re terrible.

reviews.author: Cristina Sanchez-Martin
reviews.text: What I loved most about my visit was being able to have the option of speaking Spanish with Paola, which made the visit very humane. It seems like a little gesture but it makes a huge difference. The rest of the staff were also wonderful and very caring.

reviews.author: Maria Lyne Anderson
reviews.text: Wonderful dental hygienist who made appointment easy and fun. Very nice receptionist and a beautiful office.

reviews.author: Uriah Fernandez
reviews.text: I was 15 min late, but still accepted me.  Very greatful

reviews.author: Christian Dingfelder
reviews.text: The manager there is super lazy and plays on her phone most of the day, while joking with coworkers and being unprofessional. The hygienist is amazing and nice always asking if your doing okay during procedures.

reviews.author: Risa
reviews.text: i just want my teeth fixed as i am in a lot of pain. receptionist was very accusatory and acting like i was being difficult when i simply needed help understanding their system. i was very clear that i did not understand and needed some guidance. i thought i was being very kind and offered ideas on where the mix up was coming from, she just continued to be combative and talk down to me. we rescheduled, but i wish i never went. i started to cry while filling out paperwork and quietly left. i understand they probably get a lot of difficult people, but i was just trying to get some help. dealing with the half of my mouth aching is easier than being humiliated.

reviews.author: Jeremy Hare
reviews.text: One of the more enjoyable dentist experiences I’ve had in my life.Very attentive and professional hygienist (Mimi) did a great job with ensuring I was comfortable throughout cleaning. Dentist (Dr. Jasper) was great at providing me details of my mouth and options on how to change things up to support more healthy teeth in the future.Update as of August 2023 - still great, super comfort focused hygienist (Mimi is the best!) and straight forward cleaning. Top notch overall.

reviews.author: susan malone
reviews.text: The dental assistant that cleaned my teeth is extraordinary;  she explained to me how to clean my bridge and sent me home with some EEZ-THRU Floss Threaders!I highly recommend her ❤️

reviews.author: Alejandro Núñez
reviews.text: Received a $50 charge for an "Oral Cancer Screen" which is not covered by insurance, no one told me they were going to do it, and I doubt they actually did it. Went for a cleaning they said "no charges today" and then received this.

reviews.author: Ashley Whitesides
reviews.text: I really love the dental hygienist here. She's super nice, gentle, fast, and checks in with you regularly during the cleaning to make sure you're doing okay. I came in early to my appointment and they got me in before my allotted time.

reviews.author: Kris Bolcer
reviews.text: Surgery went well, the one star is for their service and follow up because there are plenty of other good surgeons in the area. As the caretaker, they failed to really provide any instruction besides handing me a small pamphlet at the end. The prescription was messed up and it has been impossible to reach them via phone since, even drove back during “office hours” to find that were closed. They have yet to return any of my many voicemails 3 office days later. As a medical professional myself, their service and care for their patients is atrocious and I don’t recommend using this company at all.

reviews.author: Rhiannon Edwards
reviews.text: The dental assistant was very gentle (as for as dental stuff can be) and understanding of my fear of dentists. One of the best dental visits in my life.

reviews.author: Katherine Rose Mercadillo De Guzman
reviews.text: This team is one of a kind. I feel very comfortable every time I step in their office. All staff is very professional and knowledgeable and I love my new doctor.

reviews.author: Samuel Lubahn
reviews.text: This office is the closest to me (that's on my insurance), so I'm trying to be patient with them, but their customer service is awful.I initially called about some tooth pain and scheduled an appointment. I have had to reschedule (because the dentist didn't work the day of my appointment) and wait weeks before the next. I have been told appointments will be months away for cleanings. And now, after a month of waiting for a root canal since my initial phone call, they told me on the morning of the procedure that the doctor that would be performing is no longer covered by insurance.I'm trying to be patient, but if you have another option, then I recommend trying someplace else.

reviews.author: grace gift of God
reviews.text: Yes I enjoyed !!! Oh my God I’m  very glad For everything thank you so much For good service and God bless Brighten Now Dental🙏

reviews.author: Toa Reap
reviews.text: Had a lot of work done… great dentist; super helpful staff!  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Liz
reviews.text: The Drs and hygienist are great and I’ve have lovely experience with all of them. My biggest problems are a) cost. They don’t seem to charge the insurance right and they will quote and charge you higher than they should. Please get a second opinion and quote from a different office before committing. B) Receptionists have really bad customer service etiquette and are very rude. They don’t pick up the phone at all times and never answer the voice mails I have left. I feel unwelcome and uncomfortable interacting with them. I will definitely change offices once I’m done with my procedure.

reviews.author: Varsha Negi
reviews.text: Front staff was rude both times I visited. Doctor was good but then got a more than $1000 bill months later after assuring me the procedure was covered- they charged me for uncovered therapeutic medication which was oxy that i did not need and did not take. Overall genuinely disappointing.

reviews.author: Alexys Berens
reviews.text: I really hate giving this review because I love the dental staff here. They are so friendly and do really excellent work. That being said last fall (2022) I went in for a routine checkup and was told I should get selants. After confirming with the administrator (twice) and 2 members of the dental staff, I was told that the procedure would be covered by insurance, so I proceeded with the sealants. Unfortunately, a few months later, I received a prebill that indicated this was not the case. After calling to followup, I was told to wait for the actual bill. Well in is now May (2023), well over 7 months later, and I was finanlly called about a balance on my account (after I was told numerous times it would be free). The person I spoke to on the phone was short, could not answer my questions, and failed to provide information on themself or why they were calling until I asked for more information. When I asked to leave a compliant, I was transferred to a voicemail that told me to call back during business hours (even though it was business hours). Bright now may have good dentists, but I feel taken adavntage of and lied to. The actual customer service has been terrible. Who knows how many times they have done this before.

reviews.author: Olivia Mahler-Haug
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs. I was told today that “we are so understaffed right now its unrealistic to expect a timely response on anything” when asking why someone hasn’t followed up on my inquiry from a month ago when they had committed to getting back to me. They admitted they don’t have the right resourcing in place to provide quality care.

reviews.author: Claire Jacobs
reviews.text: Dental care OK, but my husband is getting bills for appointments that were paid for at the time and we have credit card receipts verifying those payments.

reviews.author: John Kalberer
reviews.text: With the dental plan I have this is the closest dentist I can go to. Every appointment usually starts late even though I'm on time.. it seems like they over schedule.Today I showed up at the start of my appointment 9a.m. I walked in the door and the receptionist said Hi how are you I said fine. I then waited 10 minutes without being called assuming that someone would call my name so I could go get my teeth cleaned. I then asked if I needed to check in. The receptionist had me fill out a form and told me to sit down I waited another 5 minutes and then she notified me that I could no longer attend my appointment because it was 20 minutes after the start. I told her that you said hi to me as I walked in the door at 9:00 a.m. and she said sorry I can reschedule.So now after waiting 6 months to get my teeth cleaned I have to wait at least another month to reschedule. This place is a joke.

reviews.author: Anna Christensen
reviews.text: I needed a prescription for antibiotics, which the doctor wrote.  When I went to pick it up there was nothing.  They never sent it to the pharmacy.  I called all the pharmacies in my area.  Nothing there.  I called their office twice about it and no one bothered to return my calls.  I was running a high fever from an infection and they put my health in serious danger.  I cancelled future appointments and will never go back.  I actually liked the oral surgeon but the office staff is completely incompetent .  I’m still furious at being treated this way.

reviews.author: ann skorokhodova
reviews.text: Initially i came for teeth cleaning, which was fine. Although radiograph shows cavity in my last molar, which did not bother me. My first visit with orthodontist last about 3 hours. He was doing other patients while i was sitting and swallowing my own blood. Eventually he said that there is no way that he can fix it with simple filling today. My the only choice is onlay, which i had to google because nobody explained me. After 3 weeks with onlay i gave up because i can not put up with constant pain, so they “adjusted” something which did not change anything. I am fed up with them and requested to remove that thing. Dr offered me something else but i lost all my trust to their professionalism. That day he put a temporary filling which fall off within 5 hours. I had to order a dental kit to fix it because i do not want to come back again but its very painful when a half of your tooth exposed. And my filling stays for 7 days. Receptionist is the only nice person, she sent my radiographs. And i have my tooth fixed with another clinic. All the time i felt like i am a guinea pig and he has no idea how to manage a situation. It is very disturbing when you are sitting in a chair with drilled tooth bleeding and nobody cares because they have other patients to take care. At some point I had to ask somebody else for a paper towel to spit by blood instead of constant swallowing. I have never been so scared of dentist until i came here. Temporary filling on a pic.

reviews.author: Sandra Bordin
reviews.text: Professional and courteous

reviews.author: cederich hower
reviews.text: Great, friendly staff! Good sense of humor we laughed through most of the visit.

reviews.author: Miriana Duran
reviews.text: They are cheap but have the worst customer service, have been waiting to get my additional set of aligners for weeks now and I need to keep calling and have no response. Finally I talked to someone and they said they would call me back and haven't heard from them for over 2 weeks. Go elsewhere!!

reviews.author: Steven Farwell
reviews.text: I can't seem to get an appointment. They were very nice the first time I went but then ghosted me. I've tried requesting appointments twice and never hear back

reviews.author: James McIlvey
reviews.text: Their staff is friendly and the hygeinists are professional and competent- no complaints, I am a pleased customer. The dentist is a bit quick in the examination but that is more a note than anything. Good crew here- I have always feared the dentist and they make it as pleasant as a dental visit can be.

reviews.author: Linda Huckaby
reviews.text: At first I was impressed. Then today happened. After waiting over a year to get my dentures, I show up for a  fitting appointment (1 hour commute) only to be told they didn't have the impressions for the fitting. Worse yet, instead of being apologetic or even sympathetic, the receptionist treated me as if it were my fault they couldn't provide the services THEY booked the appointment for! They hound you for advance payment, then FAIL to provide as promised. If you have any other insurance options, take it!

reviews.author: Jeb Korzilius
reviews.text: Every interaction with the staff at this office have been positive, pleasant, professional, and enjoyable. The dental hygienist was engaging and personable. The dentist I saw was professional and made me feel remembered as a patient even though I’m sure they see a ton of patients! It was wonderful.

reviews.author: Google user
reviews.text: Dr. Jasper was very friendly and made me feel optimistic about finally getting my smile back… until I got the $21,464 quote!! I see why dental tourism is a thing. Nice facility but not affordable

reviews.author: Summer Gnoinsky
reviews.text: I came in for an emergency fix and they were able to see me quickly. While I was there they squeeze me in for a cleaning, which was perfect. The staff had positive and friendly attitudes, and I left with a good feeling. Usually I am anxious at the dentist, but they eased my stress.

reviews.author: Kristen Finch
reviews.text: I'm not happy with BrightNow Dental. There is nothing "now" about Bright Now! It was a chore to get an appointment. If you are a new patient you get scheduled through "SmileBrands" which is confusing, and if you are a returning patient, good luck getting them on the phone. They have too many clients and are constantly booked up. When you finally get an appointment, they don't do everything you need in a single appointment. For example, I had to come in to get the X-rays and imaging and then come for a second appointment for a cleaning, why? Additionally, I had to schedule an appointment so far in advance, that of course I totally forgot when it was. The reminder phone calls they set up for you are less that 24 hours in advance of the appointment, but you get charge a no-show fee ($50) if you don't cancel within 48 hours! I asked if they can adjust their system to send notification calls earlier and they said it is on the patient to remember, which is fair but not helpful. I paid and won't miss an appointment again, but it feels wrong that they probably have a lot of no shows because their reminder phone calls are not before the no show fee is initiated. Finally, their phone service says to use the online system to schedule the appointments, but when you finally get them on the phone they tell you that that system is broken and they don't want people to use it. The only receptionist I have interacted with is not very understanding and seems to be frustrated with clients, but I don't blame her, the system she is working under is not convenient nor friendly. This is the only location in the city that accepts my weird plan. For this, I will change during open enrollment to avoid this place.

reviews.author: Mohammad Ullah
reviews.text: They not maintain the schedule time.

reviews.author: Ramune Soda
reviews.text: Terrible Invisialign experience. Spent over $5k to straighten my teeth here and that went fine. However, when it came to breaking my retainer, I came back to have it replaced. They lost the original molar impression so they took another scan of my teeth to get another retainer ordered. They did this w/o explaining. However, the logic was flawed because I came with slightly crooked teeth from breaking my retainer and not having it for weeks while I waited for an appointment. They sent me my retainer a few weeks later and it was the crooked one and not the perfectly straight version I had before. It also came with an extension of my wisdom teeth in the upper half.Do they even check results after they perform scans for Invisalign? The doctor seemed to be in a hurry since I already finished paying for my treatment and didn't pay for the visit after. He handed the scanning to an assistant who was really unfocused and unpleasant to be around, casually talking about lunch plans with another person and repeatedly saying, "How can I even do this?" since my mouth was too small for the scanning device.I don't trust this place, and don't recommend this Northgate office or chain to anyone who is looking for orthodontics treatment, or honest service.

reviews.author: Haneen Alattal
reviews.text: From the front desk to the dental hygienist to the dentist they are all nice with good customer service, I like that clinic, Thank you.

reviews.author: Kelley
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Friendly staff and speedy dental hygienists and dentist. If you are looking for a place to go, check out Bright Now.

reviews.author: Harry Kitt
reviews.text: Care was thorough and genial.

reviews.author: Dejene Gizaw
reviews.text: They  charged me copay multiple times and mailed me extra balance to pay six months after they charged my insurance. When called for explanation, I received unprofessional treatment from the manager office. It is not just one time, we have been their customers for years, they don't care.

reviews.author: bezawit Goshu
reviews.text: Poor customer service and confusing unexpected bills after their treatments.

reviews.author: Zachary Schneeweis
reviews.text: The availability of the next teeth cleaning appointment was in 9 months after my visit, which was after the annual cycle of insurance. It defeats the purpose of paying for yearly insurance if you're not able to get teeth cleaning within that time period.

reviews.author: Carl White
reviews.text: Needed an emergency procedure and got it done promptly. Nice staff and will be going there for further dental needs.

reviews.author: Wendi Tillman
reviews.text: A two for friendliness but a complete waste of my time. I very specifically said I JUST need the crown of an implant put back on. I was told no hesitation a general dentist could do it. I left with my crown in hand and told id need to see a periodontist for another $150 exam. No thank you

reviews.author: Erin O’Dell
reviews.text: I have been going to this dental place since my insurance has changed and I am giving one star due to the fact I have been cancelled on the last minute due to some dentist not showing up. Not once- not twice! Not 3 times-! no-four times folks this has happened. Since early october.  I call out sick for work each time and being a nurse have left my floor short staffed as a result, and it’s so frustrating to confirm the appointment the day before and then get a robocall cancelling me on the the morning of. A huge waste of my time, when I’m needed to work desperately. I called yesterday to make extra sure we are still on and to verify sick time through my nurses unit. Then I’m cancelled. There has been no response to my calls, and the service is just really unprofessional without any explanation, no early warning, no human voice to call me to reschedule. I’m going to continue to try and get a hold of my plan to make a complaint and beg them to let me switch back to my last dentist who never robocancelled me ever.Update: how’s the roboresponse to my one star! I have emailed this charlotte bot. Charlotte assured me the complaint will be forwarded to the correct person who will reach out. It’s been 2 months Charlottebot! I’m still here.It’s been a year…I’m sure charlotte made good on her passing of the unsavory package of me.I was unable to switch providers in delta care. But - November!!! open enrollment here I come. I’m updating because my daughter just had a very unfriendly experience, had fillings done and was shut down abruptly when she asked questions about the procedure. She thought it was one filling and was surprised to hear going in that it was 3. She did not see the X-rays, no one explained anything. She got nervous and asked for me-the dentist told her shortly that I was not allowed to see her.Meanwhile I’m there waiting-I tried to make an appt to get my teeth cleaned, and the receptionist says flatly there’s none open till next July. 8 months away.Y’all see the 4.5 stars-don’t believe it, go look on yelp and other places too, it’s like one or 2…this last year the most apathetic unprofessional service I’ve ever experienced.I guess this is what state dental insurance is like? Delta care ppo, They have a limited number of dentists on a list-these businesses are guaranteed income and bodies, so the work and effort produced doesn’t matter. what you’d expect if you tried to turn health care into a McDonald’s drive through. Except there’s an 8 month wait for service.

reviews.author: Eileen Lomer
reviews.text: The people who work here are lovely but the Bright Now organization as a whole was disappointing. The online scheduling forced me to misgender myself to make the initial appointment. I scheduled my first appointment online for a "Dental Checkup" expecting a dental cleaning but instead had x-rays and my gums measured which was not disclosed at any point in the scheduling process. Afterwards, I was referred to schedule a dental cleaning and periodontist consultation. The office does not allow scheduling online after the initial visit and only takes appointments over the phone, unfortunately only during my working hours. The periodontist only has Monday availabilities and the dental cleaning was unavailable for several months on my weekdays off. I'm a minimum wage worker and cannot take time off work to schedule a dentist appointment or meet this limited availability.

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.text: The worst filling experience ever among all my dentists

reviews.author: Alexander Theoryn
reviews.text: This location has been hard to work with regarding getting them to work with my dental insurance provider. They charged my insurance a full claim for an exam when my son did not even open his mouth and put through a pediatric hold. I have been calling for over a month to try and sort it and never get followed up with, just a usual line of “we will follow up with you tomorrow”, but with no call. Canceled my appointment the day of and no one followed up to reschedule.Edit: Thank you for your response. I have sent the requested information to the email provided.

reviews.author: Domenica Dee
reviews.text: This is one of the only doctors offices left in Seattle that treats you like your family. Scheduling or staff aside they hear you and they want to help. Not to mention the talent. Not everyone likes going to the dentist but they make it easy

reviews.author: Gabe Lungstrom
reviews.text: The staff at Northgate are very friendly, and the dentists (while busy) are professional and collaborative. The DH conducting the review was thorough and friendly. My only concern is their capacity- they are a busy spot but they are good at what they do. I am glad I took the chance on the Northgate location, I have been very satisfied!

reviews.author: Nicole Murray
reviews.text: Dr. Jasper is amazing! Always an enjoyable dental experience coming here, highly recommend!

reviews.author: thedol715
reviews.text: Everyone was so professional and friendly. The dentist took care of my treatment and took the time to do my cleaning! Great service!

reviews.author: Biff Bam Boom
reviews.text: Hygienist is really good. Staff members put in good effort. I’ve had 4 different dentists in just over 2 years so no real familiarity. It feels corporate. Rethinking if I want to continue being a patient.

reviews.author: Jeff Dodson
reviews.text: Dr. Jasper was great! He is smart, personable, relaxed, and an excellent communicator.  And he was not at all defensive when I asked him relatively detailed questions about what was going on in my mouth.  Not a scary visit at all. Very pleasant.

reviews.author: Kurtis Mays
reviews.text: Awesome staff, awesome environment and awesome pricing!

reviews.author: Hugo
reviews.text: Best care in the world! Stag is friendly and professional. Mimi is above that anyone can expect from a hygienist. She’s lovely and go the extra mile. Is an asset to the company.

reviews.author: Alex M. M. Miller
reviews.text: Was on time for 10 AM appointment, finally asked back into the room at 10:40.Not super clear about pricing, and receipt was just thermal paper from credit card charge, no printed details.Failed to initially send after care prescriptions to pharmacy. Then sent the four of them with my first name as my last name. I spent 3 hours at the store pharmacy waiting for them to fix their issue.

reviews.author: Paul R
reviews.text: I was honestly very pleasantly surprised with how quickly the dentist was able to resolve my issues with my chipped tooth. The resolution was quick and I was off on my way!

reviews.author: Ann Delmore
reviews.text: Professional, personable service!  The best!

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.text: The staff were very friendly, did a great job at making feel comfortable since I'm always anxious going to the dentist. The cleaning with thorough and painless.

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.text: Great dental experience! The staff members were friendly, professional and very clean office.I had a dental emergency loose tooth and was looking for a new dentist.The dentist and hygienist did a great job explaining everything to me.I would highly recommend Bright Now Dental  in Northgate WA.

reviews.author: Anita Gonzalez (Ani)
reviews.text: Excelente staff and services. Dr. Jasper was amazing as everyone else. I love that I have them as my dental care

reviews.author: Sanders
reviews.text: terrible service.they didn’t call me or let me know that I did not need to eat. They also did not let me know I have to have someone here to take me home afterward. Terribly run practice, I would avoid at all costs. They also don’t have a CT x-ray machine which is literally a standard for dentists across the nation.

reviews.author: Rowe
reviews.text: If I could give negative stars I would. I've been going to Bright Now for years but this is by far the worst location I've ever been to. The staff schedules appointments during closed hours so there isn't even anyone there! And if you're lucky enough to be scheduled when they're open the wait time is an hour minimum, even when arriving early. This is the most disorganized Bright Now I've ever been to and the front desk staff is rude and condesending, never going here again and will be warning everyone to steer clear of the Northgate Bright Now.

reviews.author: Katie Gill
reviews.text: The office was very comfortable and the people at the desk were all very friendly. The assistant was efficient and the periodontist was polite, clear and thorough. Superb service!

reviews.author: tariq ahmed
reviews.text: They are doing amazing.

reviews.author: Analisa Murray
reviews.text: Mimi gave my teeth the best cleaning I’ve ever experienced. She was quick, there was no discomfort AT ALL, she was always checking to see if I was alright, and she was so funny and lovely to talk to. :)

reviews.author: Jason Aliberto
reviews.text: Great service and customer service! Very helpful and polite!  Did great on my teeth cleaning and cavity.

reviews.author: Zeena Baz
reviews.text: Bad experience ever!Bad customer service ever, i have tried to call them many times to explain my issue, finally more than 10 days ago called me to ask me what happened, after I told them about my issue, they made my 2 IMPLANT wrong, they never care ,Customer service told me she will call me back on Friday 12/03 but nothing!!I will go with a lower to fix my problem with them.Just be careful when you are going to this place.I have proof how they talk to me and what they did.

reviews.author: Sarah I
reviews.text: The dental hygienist is great! However getting an appointment or trying to change an appointment is not acceptable. Over 6 months out or further. Husband had an appointment cancelled (by them) and has not been able to get in again. Was told that the wait list is 200+.

reviews.author: Akshay Nair
reviews.text: TLDR:Felt like a busy factory production line without any quality control!No respect for patients, and chances are, you may not require the procedure they suggest/ or they are experimenting it. Take a second opinion if you in doubt!Details:Didn't wanna leave a bad review because I still go here! But have to say this!first visit:One doctor(visiting) runs between patients and do heavy work without break/ thoughts. The filling came off and I had to go back, on my follow up visit, they had no record/ notes of my previous visit or the procedures done and why!!On the second visit,(not a busy day)  I asked the new doctor, why my filling isn't complete.She was a good doctor, took time and explained to me my situation with a drawing, and how a filling wouldn't work. Then why did the other doctor did it in the first place! And they don't have the notes to confirm why! she said may be the other doctor was hoping it might work!After the procedure, when I asked (with hands) for suction, the assistant said- 'swallow it, its yours'!2 strangers had their hands (with gloves of course) in my mouth for half an hour, grinded my teeth, put cotton in there, did the filling and she wants me to swallow??!My molar feels sensitive now and I'm scared of going back here!

reviews.author: Sonia Rezaie
reviews.text: Didn’t stitch up wisdom teeth removal surgery, wasn’t even surgery just yanking teeth out. Did a total waste of money exam even though I had X-ray referrals from my dentist already just to price gouge. Didn’t even give painkillers after surgery was done, just sent me home with a couple of strips of gauze and that was it. Way overpriced for severely low quality and painful work.

reviews.author: Derek
reviews.text: So four months after my appointment, I get a bill in the mail that is charging me for $200. When I called the office, they said it was for the difference between what the insurance paid out and what they were expecting to get. I double checked my insurance and the EOB info they have doesn't match up with what Bright Now provided me on my bill... I called the Bright Now office twice (actual location as well as their main business office), but they couldn't tell me what the difference was from.

reviews.author: Catherine McGarry
reviews.text: I had to wait a while but the dental care was excellent.

reviews.author: Chris Roach
reviews.text: Experienced, thorough, and gentle techs and dentists, BUT their schedule changes, their greeters and phone receptionists are inconsistent with their patient/customer care, and the wait list for reschedules (cancelled on their end, mind you) is long (80+ people).UPDATE: Two of my routine cleaning appointments (patient of two-ish years) have been rescheduled (short notice each time) due to the place changing hours (I get it with Northgate construction and all but the second time was due to child care schedules) causing a delay in my dental care of 3+ months each time.Not suggested for new patients, great spot if you can get an appointment.Still waiting until October for my rescheduled apt.Update: October apt was rescheduled as well, but they were able to get me in on a cancellation (thank goodness, as the next available appointment would be in June)

reviews.author: George Mitchell
reviews.text: Don't even bother, they'll just waste your time. Scheduled an initial appointment, they cancelled it on me and told me to reschedule. A month later I've been informed that appointment has now also been cancelled. I could've gotten this done months ago somewhere else.

reviews.author: dnat121
reviews.text: UPDATE: 10.4.21NEGATIVE 5 stars if I could.I just received a letter informing me that my data was breached in a "cybersecurity incident". Great. If it wasn't bad enough, it only gets worse.Just avoid.Negatives:- They do X-Rays and cleanings on two separate appointments.- They will cancel your cleaning appointment and put it on YOU to reschedule.- They only have one hygienist, so wait time to get a cleaning is long. (Scheduled a cleaning for August 2021 in February 2021 - they did not have any appointments sooner than that.)- Front desk staff are curt and rush things. After an oral surgery, they failed to provide me with the an antibiotic prescription necessary to prevent infection. LUCKILY, I healed without it. Although it COULD have been a big problem.Basically if you like to waste your time, have appointments cancelled on you, be told you have to reschedule an appointment they cancelled, then this is your place.

reviews.author: Dicky Tjahjadi
reviews.text: Very bad service.Book my new patient visit for almost 1 month wait time and got a phone call 1 day before the appointment that they can’t accommodate the appointments time that we agree before. Offering for a reschedule that will make me wait another 3 weeks very very unprofessional for a dental place to do that action to the patient

reviews.author: starr loutsis
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience! Loved all of the staff!!Thank you for my beautiful smile!!!!

reviews.author: Nera Acutillar
reviews.text: The receptionist were accommodating. The doctor is friendly and very professional.

reviews.author: Phyllis Dyan Steele
reviews.text: Terrible service. I called the office making an appointment informing them I was deaf a few weeks in advance. They have a generic scheduler. I even had them transfer me specifically to that location to ensure smoothness. I let them know that if they wanted to get an interpreter. They could do that. I arrived to my appointment to them denying me service because there was no interpreter.

reviews.author: Mandy Maloon
reviews.text: Bright Now Dental is in network for my insurance. I've gone there five times in the last year or so; once for my initial exam, once for cleaning, twice for surgery, and once for follow-up. For each visit, I was told the amount owed on the day of service, and I paid them the agreed amount. Now, several months later, I am suddenly getting harassing calls from some kind of debt collector, saying I owe $204.00. So, I called my insurance (Delta Dental) who spoke to Bright Now. According to my insurance, the bill is in regard to a date of service in January. Delta Dental said my total amount due for that visit was $100.00. In actuality, I paid $150.00 on that day, which is reflected in my bank statement. So, Bright Now has sent some fictious amount to a debt collector, who are calling me DAILY, when they actually owe ME a refund of $50.00 for overpayment. I've called their office several times, but have not received a call back. Can one send a debt collector to a company that owes you money??

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.text: The dental staff are all incredibly kind and sweet. Always very friendly and concerned for your comfort.That being said, this is no exaggeration, the worst dental experience I’ve ever had to endure. I booked an appointment in November of last year and came in December, feeling discomfort in my back left teeth where a previous large filling had been. After the consultation, the mandatory cleaning and the initial filling removal and impression appointment, we were ready to install a new crown over the previously filled tooth.Unfortunately the new crown did not seat correctly. So we had to remove it, pack my gums again and take a new impression. A few day later I get a call saying the 2nd crown was damaged somehow (at the lab or in transit) and I had to come back in for a third impression.When I came back for the third try I informed them I was moving at the end of that month (about 3 weeks time) and that this would have to work. So again, we removed the temp crown, packed the gums and took a third impression.Needless to say the third one did not seat properly either. They offered to refund my money and set me up with a temporary crown until I arrived at my new dentist in my new location.2 weeks later, I’ve been refunded the money I paid but still had to eat the cost of all the time I had to take off work for the continuous return appointments. Also the temporary crown they installed has popped off while eating, leaving me scrambling on a Friday night to find emergency treatment.If you’re going for a cleaning this place is fine but anything other than that I wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.author: Sadie Gail
reviews.text: Good doctors and staff, but always waiting a long time here. Bad scheduling and trying to squeeze in too many patients!!

reviews.author: R F
reviews.text: I was a patient of about 3 years here and consistently it was the worst experience I've ever had with dental care or any medical provider for that matter. I kept thinking they would shape up once the construction at the mall settled but both the front office staff as well as the providers themselves have always managed to disappoint. I've lost several days of work time to shoddy dental work and canceled appointments without notice at this point. Would genuinely not wish this place upon my worst enemy. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: Susan Little
reviews.text: My experience with Bright Now was not what I expected. I'm on Medicare & I was told they took my insurance but it only covers cleaning & bite wing xrays. I went to another office & I was told it would be half price from the first office prices?  When I arrived they said $39 for first visit. I was quoted higher prices from my first phone call after they did my exam. Now I ended up getting Delta Dental plan $62/month. Make sure they know what plan you have & if they take your plan before you go to Bright Now. I spent 2 hrs there & nothing was done..The communication needs to be better & the front desk needs to have one person working on insurance & the other on checking people in & making appointments. Very confusing information. Thanks Sue

reviews.author: Jon Morgan
reviews.text: Even after all this, they only ignore you. Never go here under any circumstance. It's an absolute disaster.You moved my appointment without bothering to tell me (and ignored my email about it). Then you made me confirm it twice, as if my confirming it the first time wasn't enough. Have you seen the Seinfeld episode about the car rental reservation? Because you similarly seem not to understand the fundamental purpose of booking appointments. They need to be scheduled at times that work for both parties, and they should never be changed without communicating that to the other party. I resent the double standard by which you expect us to pay fees if we're late or don't show up to appointments, yet you just cancel or move them without ever bothering to tell us that, let alone compensate us for it.I repeatedly told you--in person, by phone, and through your website--that I am autistic and need to communicate by text message or email, not phone. Yet you STILL won't communicate with me by any means except phone. Even when I explained that on the phone with your office manager, she refused to listen to me, interrupting me repeatedly after I asked her not to because of my autism. She seemed disgusted, as if accommodating disabilities is beneath her and interrupting patients with ableism is her birthright. She proceeded to tell me she'd have the district manager call me, but of course, that never happened.When my previous appointment was canceled, I received a voicemail (not a text message or email, despite all the texts and emails you send us) saying there was an appointment available, and I should call back if I wanted it. The message never mentioned that, unlike the norm for such calls and messages, the office was calling many patients to offer them the same appointment, or that it would go to the first patient who called to say they wanted it. The normal procedure (this is a dental appointment; not a commercial airline flight) would be to reserve the appointment for the patient you offered it to until they called back. Your message said nothing about making it a speed-based sweepstakes, therefore I had no idea I needed to call immediately to get the appointment, or that there was a chance someone else could take it from under me. I had my boss approve the sick time so I could go to the dentist, only to find that since others had called in the 1-2 days since I got the message, I didn't even get the appointment. This is terrible, irresponsible practice.You refuse to accommodate disabilities. You insist on the ableist interruption of your patients on the phone, and you refuse to communicate in writing after being repeatedly told that's what your patient needs. You either fail to communicate at all, or communicate very incompletely and misleadingly, wasting the patient's time and making them wait longer with temporary dental applicants instead of getting the permanent ones you promise. You impose a double standard that charges us money for things you do with impunity. You repeatedly ignore us and fail to follow through on your word.This is inexcusable and unacceptable. You have lost my business for good, and I will urge others to avoid you too.

reviews.author: Alvaro de la Cruz
reviews.text: Front desk people are always rude. Actual dentist and staff are amazing though.

reviews.author: Ashton Yang
reviews.text: Every appointment I made in the last year was cancelled with less than a week's notice, and then I had to schedule far out again due to Brightnow's limited free appointments (perhaps they have too many patients to appropriately handle). I recently discovered that in my cleanings for the last two years, I was never given fluoride treatment- a huge oversight on their part and huge lack of quality care. I often have to wait past my scheduled appointment time and many of their dentists have very poor bedside manner. For an oral surgery procedure, the total price was way more than originally estimated. Overall, I had a very poor experience here and will now be switching dentists. This chain lacks the personal care and attention to detail that should be standard in this practice.

reviews.author: K. M.
reviews.text: The dentist was great! She answered all questions and was very gentle. The clinic was very clean. Everyone was very friendly and efficient, and almost all COVID safety guidelines were followed; my only concern was when they allowed two people, who were not patients, come in to use the restroom in the back ... and didn't check their temperatures or do a COVID screening as they did all patients checking in.

reviews.author: Steven Philips
reviews.text: Received a bill 6 months after my visit for a “personal protective fee”.   Fortunately they were able to remove this charge, but I’ve never been to a doctor’s or dentists office where I am charged something like this.

reviews.author: Andy M
reviews.text: This office has canceled two appointments with less than one hours notice.  Last time I did actually get in I waited in the chair for 35 minutes before the doctor came in. They had me down for an extraction. Ummmm no, just here for a cleaning. This isn’t the most organized or on time office. Nobody is unkind.

reviews.author: Megan Rutherford
reviews.text: Wow they were so great with my kiddo! She is six and left saying "I love going to the dentist!"

reviews.author: Patrice Enders
reviews.text: The staff & and orthodontist are pretty amazing.  It was fascinating to watch them work.  I appreciate the many years of experience here and obviously they're taking a ton of covid precautions to stay safe

reviews.author: karol hansen
reviews.text: I am very happy with my recent experiences at Bright Now Dental at Northgate in Seattle. Everyone here is friendly and professional. It's never the MOST fun in the world to go to the dentist, but they make it as comfortable and easy as is possible at this office. The hygienist here, Mimi, is outstanding! Very kind and gentle, careful and thorough. Good sense of humor too! Highly recommended. 11/4/20 - Want to add to my review that Bright Now Dental is in new offices and they are beautiful! A big upgrade. Also, I saw Dr. Doan today and she was wonderful, explained things very well, and made excellent suggestions. Nicole, her assistant, was professional and personable and made me feel very comfortable. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Julie Astrup
reviews.text: Doctor and assistant heard me clearly and were very kind.  Further treatment was explained very well.  "bright" and clean dental areas.

reviews.author: Diana Vasquez
reviews.text: I have been a client here since they open back in 2011. Dr Beattie is awesome! Great at solving the most complicated cases. Always resilient and very professional. That is why on keep on coming back and bringing my family.

reviews.author: Betsy Turnbull
reviews.text: Clean & professional

reviews.author: Lester Black
reviews.text: Never use Bright Now Dental Northgate, this is an absolutely terrible dental office!When I arrived for my first appointment, the receptionist tried to get me to sign a "release of liability" (which is signing away your legal right to sue for medical malpractice) before my appointment. When I asked why this was necessary, she said "oh don't worry about that one." Wow! So they're trying to get people to casually give away their rights. Not a great sign but then it got even worse. The dentist arrived 90 MINUTES (!!!!) after I received novocaine for my filling, meaning the anesthetic had completely worn off. When I told the dentist this, he said "it's fine" and continued the incredibly painful filling. To make matters worse, he had a 40-minute conversation about "gushers, people who bleed profusely when they have dental work" during the entire procedure.This was an absolutely horrible experience and I wish I had taken the warning signs from the beginning and walked out of that office. Learn from my mistakes and avoid Bright Now like the plague!

reviews.author: Kylee Hoffman
reviews.text: They canceled my appointment for a cleaning 3 times before I was finally able to go in 2 months after I had initially scheduled. When I went in, I waited around for half an hour and then got called back for x-rays, and that was it. They didn’t even schedule me for the correct type of appointment after rescheduling 3 times. Do not waste your time with this place.

reviews.author: Karen Sandy
reviews.text: This was the most pain free deep cleaning ever. The entire team here is so conscientious and efficient. Great experience!

reviews.author: Ken Arney
reviews.text: My teeth feel fantastic after my cleaning.

reviews.author: Dave Myers
reviews.text: Very friendly office. Painlessly filled three cavities. Proper precautions were taken to prevent the spread of covid.

reviews.author: mkroberts11
reviews.text: Great friendly care. Honestly the best root canal treatment I've ever had.

reviews.author: Rick Koetje
reviews.text: Quick, clean and friendly professional service. Highly Recommend!!

reviews.author: Gail Claassen
reviews.text: Dr. Sloven, oral surgeon, is wonderful.   Positive, respectful,  interested in your wellbeing as well as expert, knowledgeable and a consummate in his field!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Duncan Wright
reviews.text: Mimi was one of the most energetic and customer friendly hygienists I’ve ever had the experience of coming across! She made my experience 5 stars

reviews.author: Jeanelle Ariza Torres
reviews.text: Everybody is very profesional, I loved my dentist and the higienist she is the best.!

reviews.author: Erin Johnson
reviews.text: Their hygienist is booked out for at least 6 months and they don't tell you this when you book your initial visit. If you're trying to get a cleaning anytime soon go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Gretchen Hamm
reviews.text: Called for a cleaning Feb 5 and told they could schedule me at the end of August. I always wait 20-30 minutes before appointments although the office seems empty. Fillings had sharp edges and I had to come back to get them fixed. 5 dentists and 1 hygenist. High turnover, seem to rush through the exams. I'm changing dentists.

reviews.author: Oscar Swing
reviews.text: Not very happy with this establishment.  My appointment felt rushed the whole time I was being seen.  I found out that my cavity work had to be re-done due to the fill coming apart in pieces.  Now they are going to bill me again for the same work that they did before.  How does a cavity cap/fill come apart only after 1.5 years.  I wonder if the material they use is not up to par with the industry.  Don't go to this place they will end up charging you for another procedure that they did not do correctly the first time.  No stars for this place4 months later update:DON’T GO TO THIS ESTABLISHMENT IF YOU SEEK QUALITY DENTAL AND STAFF CARE.  I wish I could give them no stars because of how poorly they function as a unit.  They have no office manager anymore ( I assumed quite or fired for how bad of a manager she was due to the excessive negative reviews like mine) so there no longer is any leadership  or accountability for what they do. My complaint involves a  previous review in how they did not take Care of my cavity  properly. And then try to put the blame on me. I did not return to them wanting to charge me for something that was there fault.  I was told that they OVERCHARGED ME BY $150.00. I told them  I wanted my money and to send  me the check. IT HAS BEEEN 4 MONTHS AND I STILL DO NOT HAVE A CHECK.  I have been calling them for months trying to get an answer put I guess they don’t really care. No one in this establishment has given me a call to discuss. I keep getting the run around. PLEASE DON’T GIVE THEM SERVICE YOU WILL NOT BE HAPY. And don’t take my word for it research them, find the numerous negative reviews like mine. Just my opinion but it seems like they continue to do this to people and have  issues. Not a good company to be involved in. If anybody would like to sue them I would be willingly to help and be part of the lawsuit just saying. Peace out

reviews.author: Steph Y.
reviews.text: I arrived early to my initial appt for a cleaning, but ended up having to wait an additional 30 mins after my appt time to be seen. Two other people who came in after me were seen quickly. Nobody let me know there was going to be a delay and I had to finally go up and ask someone. While I waited, I tidied up the Lobby because I was bored since the TV wasn't even working. After I was finally seen and went through the x-rays and exam, they didn't even do my cleaning! They have to do a separate appt for the cleaning (this is the first I'm hearing of it). I was upset that they essentially wasted most of my morning and I didn't even get what I came for. Nobody during the entire process had mentioned I'd have to do another appt until they were done. The only reason they get three stars is because they luckily had a cancellation for later the same day (I had to wait around a couple hours for it though) and the hygienist was great.

reviews.author: Aubry Dugan
reviews.text: Got half my xrays done (because one of the machines was broken so they couldn't even look at my wisdom teeth, the reason I was even there), was left for more than 30 minutes to wait in the chair, the dentist talked to me like I was a child and sounded very judgmental when I said how long itd been since my last appointment. Plus she didn't even listen to me. One of the first things I said to her was "Hey my crown is hurting, I think my wisdom teeth are putting pressure on it." And then about 10 minutes later she said 'but no pain in your tooth?' ??? Lady I said 3 sentences to you so far and you forgot one of them.Finally they quoted me for four extractions and a cleaning. More than $800 per tooth PLUS almost $700 more for anesthesia.I'll not be returning.

reviews.author: Joanna Marco
reviews.text: Took 2 months to get in as a new patient, then another 2 months to get in for a cleaning (why they don't do the exam and cleaning on the same day is beyond me and was an unpleasant surprise at the first visit), then another 2 months to get a filling that was recommended at the initial visit. The filling cracked a week later and was very painful and they couldn't make time to see me for 2 weeks. So not only was the quality of the dentistry poor but they don't even have reasonable availability. I am planning to find a new dentist as soon as my insurance will let me.

reviews.author: Ray Ruiz
reviews.text: This was my initial consultation: I was pleased with the dentist telling me exactly what I needed with no nonsense. Front desk was polite and proficient. I feel like this is going to be a good experience here.

reviews.author: Colin Leetham
reviews.text: This last Summer (2019) I went in to get a routine cleaning.  Since then I have been billed for services that I did not receive.  I reported the error to their office, and they were rude and dismissive.They literally waited 2 months to bill my insurance, billed me for a dental exam that I didn't receive.DO NOT USE THEM.(Prior Post) During my last visit the hygienist asked if I had any new medical developments since my last visit.  I mentioned kidney stones and she proceeded to give my unsolicited folk remedies.I will not accept service from that individual again.Promoting alternative treatments is at best not helpful and at worst lethal to someone with serious medical issues.

reviews.author: Meghann Luc
reviews.text: They overbook patients! I waited over an hour for my appointment and their excuse was that they were so far behind that my 4pm appointment was simply forgotten about. By the time they finally saw me (after arguing loud enough to be heard in the waiting room over who would have to fit me in), it was near closing and the hygienist did a complete rush job. I finally left two hours after my appointment time. I'm only giving two stars because the dentist I saw (Dr Neral) was very kind and finished up most of the hygienist work herself.

reviews.author: Maha Sarhan
reviews.text: I was not happy at all the dr I saw didn’t seem to be able to check all the x-rays they took, he didn’t check my teeth at all, it took him maybe 5 mnts to tell me that all looks good which I know it doesn’t as I had a lot of problems with bone loss which he didn’t even ask abtHe was talking abt feelings which was not my case at allUseless visit to a new dental office that I had to go to thru my insurance

reviews.author: Chelsea Murphy
reviews.text: Called to make my first appointment for a cleaning. When making the appointment I was very clear that I was coming In for a cleaning. Upon arriving I get taken back for X-rays and to see the doctor. After seeing the doctor I was told they did not have time to do my cleaning, nor are they able to accommodate me any time in the next month. I was very clear what I was coming in to have done, and none of what I requested was done. When I voiced my complaint office staff came up with several excuses on why services could not be offered.  It was a complete waste of time.

reviews.author: Mohammed Said
reviews.text: This is my first google review and I guess it’s worth writing it. I called on my way to my appointment saying that I might be 5-10 minutes late. On a protest Friday in Seattle, it took me some time to leave downtown & head up north. Whoever answered my call said “10 minutes is not a big deal & it’s within  your grace time.” Couple minutes later, I got a call from the clinic saying that the doctor wanted to reschedule the appointment because patients are backed up and they are not yet done with other patients. I decided to go and talk to the front desk hoping to find any other doctor. This time they had another story saying being 5 or 10 minutes late could cancel my appointment & Dr. Makker is the one who decides.I do not recommend this clinic at all from their shadiness to the unprofessionalism in communicating to their unfriendly stuff. The only reason I booked an appointment there was because I was having bad toothache & its conveniency to me being in the same zip code. At this point I prefer even driving extra miles just to avoid dealing with them again.

reviews.text: waited 45 minutes for the doctor to see me.  it would have been nice to have someone explain the delay. we almost walked out.  had we known it was an extended procedure taking place, we would have understood.at age 92 and unstable, it was difficult for me to have the X-rays done and my daughter might have helped but was not invited in on this.doctor explained he could do nothing other than what the referring dentist thought should be done.  my dentist told us it would be a consultation which we thought meant we'd have options other than extractionthe doctor was efficient, the assistant was most helpful and could give a lesson to the rest on customer service

reviews.author: Allan N
reviews.text: I went there about 5 years and I've seen the good and bad. The service at BrightNow can be terrible at times but remarkable at other times based on specific employees. For example, "Sky" was their beyond amazing hygienist (who no longer works there) who really cared about her patients and took the time to do a phenomenal job. Dr. Chouhdry was always helpful and super friendly too.BrightNow sometimes really messed up at times though, enough in total to make it worth going to their competitors.They seem unorganized because they often seem to make scheduling mistakes that cause delays for patients. It's not unusual to experience 20-30 minute delays beyond the scheduled appointment time before being invited from the lobby to the back room. If someone arrives at the recommended 10-15 minutes prior to the appointment it can be a 35-45 minute wait before the appointment begins. At times the overall employee turnover seems to be high. The delays may be an indication that they're understaffed or overbooked.A huge miss is their policy where patients must be examined by a doctor at every BrightNow location they visit before they can have their teeth cleaned at each one, since they're considered a "new patient". In the 21st century, the previous exam data from their doctors should be shared across all branded locations --franchise or not. It's odd that medical facilities under the same brand name can be this disconnected and that they can't appear to trust their company-wide dentists/doctors to have a baseline common level of quality or consistency where some basic data sharing between doctors would enable a patient visiting another location to get a basic cleaning done.I had a big mess up by them recently when I worked in-person with Northgate to schedule an appointment for a Monday at an alternative location (Lynnwood), and I confirmed it verbally 2-3 times with the scheduler as we entered it in our calendars. They or someone at BrightNow then bungled my appointment and made it be the prior Friday instead. They had an expired phone number on file so they called someone else to either change or confirm it --but regardless, they changed the date and time of my appointment without me agreeing to the change. I wouldn't have scheduled that Friday because I had a critical event planned then. I showed up at their Lynnwood location at the agreed time on Monday only to find out that (1) my appointment didn't exist in their system, and (2) that they would require me to go through "new patient" processes (e.g. a new doctor exam). This would have been $300+tax to do an exam, cleaning, x-rays, and flouride.I called the office manager and was told to go back to the Northgate location for a last minute reschedule fix for 4 hours later. It then unfortunately started 25 minutes later than the scheduled time, and then it was very hurried. The hygeinist barely skimmed my teeth, was too casual, and was done in 25 minutes, which was never the case for past appointments and based on my specific needs. I felt rushed out the door because they were behind schedule.This created frustration and wasted hours of my time in a rental car, and major interruptions to my vacation in the area.Also, they don't seem to have the expertise in caring for patients who have special dental needs. I felt hopeless with my situation. I learned a better care routine from another provider.Lastly, I had a dentist there recommend and implement a new "bite soft" oral device for bruxism (teeth grinding) which was a mistake in that it dramatically shifted my teeth. My teeth don't bite down properly anymore except for on 2 surfaces. I went to two orthodontists, theirs gave up on me, and no one knows how to fix it. It'd require taking teeth out and putting implants, or surgery.In retrospect, this wasn't good and I won't use them again. I want better care, a dentist with synced systems across locations, better staff retention, reliable scheduling, and with the doctors' names glued permanently to the door (BrightNow has a 8x11 paper in a holder on the door).

reviews.author: Kristina Deignan
reviews.text: EDIT: I spoke with management the day after this was posted(09/06/2018).  It was a 'Yeah, we're sorry this happened but it was out of our control' and a 'there isn't much that we can do' situation. I get that. She was able to contact another individual, who was able to get me some tentative dates for November, but nothing was set in stone, but the schedule wasn't released. I decided if the individual whom I spoke with had kept his promise to call when they received the November schedule had actually called - I would have scheduled, and changed my review to be more positive. He indicated that it would be mid-month, and September is now over, and I'll be taking my business elsewhere.If you choose to go here, I hope you have a better experience than I did.ORIGINAL: I've been here three times now, and have gotten a very unprofessional feel from this place every time. My first visit, I came in as an emergency visit, and I was lucky that they were able to see me the same day. I was told to come in a full fifteen minutes ahead of my appointment - standard for new patients because paperwork, but when I arrived, the office was closed for a meeting. They failed to lock the door, and there were several people waiting in the waiting room just staring at each other. I made my emergency appointment less than an hour before the appointment time. It would have been great if they gave me a heads-up on their meeting. (It was a party of some sort, they were having a good time, and I don't grudge them that, but we could hear it all from the office.)My second appointment was a surgeon evaluation, and I waited in the waiting room for quite some time. Eventually, I was brought back, shown an eight minute video, and waited about fifteen minutes for the surgeon to talk to me. After we'd had things hashed out, I was instructed to wait there and someone else would be there to talk to me. I waited a bit over forty minutes before another staff member realized that someone had dropped the ball, and I was escorted to the front - but still had to wait on my paperwork.My surgical visit was scheduled earlier today. I've had a number of confirmations in both text and call format, starting two weeks before my appointment, and then every day for the four days leading up to my appointment. I was called with a two hour notice, that my appointment was cancelled.I work Graveyard, and had to locate someone to cover my shifts - and I had to use PTO to get the time off for this appointment. I can't just go back to my boss and say "LOL, my dentist office screwed up, so I can work my shift." I'm out that time, my shifts have been filled. I had to ask someone else to use PTO, to take me to and from my appointment - and my appointment was cancelled because someone else, not even the surgeon was sick. I have to plan these things at least a month in advance to get coverage, and they were unable to schedule out far enough to meet my needs.It is clear that this place is understaffed, and every interaction I've had has been unprofessional - and aside from my first interaction, completely unprepared to handle day-to-day business.

reviews.author: Eli Johnson
reviews.text: I made an appointment for a checkup and cleaning.  It was only when I got there that it became clear that it was *just* a checkup, and that I had to block out some time for the hygienist as well.  When I came back for the second appointment, the hygienist did the cleaning but I had to set up another appointment for the polish, which apparently couldn't be done right then.  So that made three appointments for a service that had only ever taken a single trip at every other dentist I'd ever visited.  At no point during the process was any of this clear, which made me suspect it is their way of charging more from the insurers (though I have no evidence of this).In addition, my insurer doesn't cover adult fluoride treatments, so I made sure to tell that to the dentist. And the scheduler when she mentioned fluoride.  And the hygienist who said she'd be doing fluoride. And the next scheduler who mentioned it.  When I came in for the polish they were still all ready to do a fluoride treatment.  If I hadn't been very vocal I'm sure I would have ended up with the bill for it.The staff, doctor, and hygienist were all very professional and personable, and I have no complaint toward any of them.  The hygienist in particular was very kind. But the business practices are at best inconvenient. Having used up my full set of x-rays with them makes it a little more difficult to immediately change dentists.

reviews.author: Caitlin Olive
reviews.text: UPDATE:  My cleaning appointment that was supposed to be yesterday was cancelled the day before because they still didn't have appropriate staff to perform cleanings, and the next appointment was yet another month out. I'm so disappointed with the "service" I received from this location and will not return. Do not book appointments at this practice unless you have an extremely flexible schedule and can wait multiple months to get a cleaning. I'm also expecting that they may bill my insurance incorrectly. Note to the dentists:  if you don't have enough hygienists on staff, then don't book yourself solid with exams and not be able to do the cleanings yourself. If you would have done my cleaning the first visit as every other dentist I've been to does, you would have had a repeat client. That is no longer the case, and I will continue to share my experience with my friends so they can avoid it as well.Waited nearly an hour to see the dentist (with no apologies for the delay) and then was told that there were no hygienists working today and that they have one starting tomorrow, so I'd have to come back in a month for a cleaning and that the dentist was booked solid with other patients so couldn't do the cleaning herself. The call center should inform patients that they don't have appropriate staff to perform routine services in one visit so the patient can make the decision to go somewhere else if they don't want to go to the dentist twice. The x-rays were also more painful than I've ever experienced. I will not return, and I would advise you to look elsewhere.

reviews.text: After waiting two months for my deep cleaning appointments, Bright Now Northgate has called the night before to schedule me out a month further because of hygienist scheduling issues  not once but twice. reviews.author: Phil ToContactHassan
reviews.text: Great dentist.  Fair administrative staff.  I was referred quickly to a oral surgeon, for which the staff was to help me set up the appointment urgently.  After 20 minutes, they had recommended offices that were at least 45 minutes away.  Several times I asked, Is there a reason you are sending me to particular ones?  Is there not an oral surgeon closer to where I work and live?"  Google maps!  They finally got it and sent a fax to an oral surgeon within 10 minutes' drive asking them to call the patient.  (I found this out while driving home and looking at the paperwork).  **why not just call the oral surgeon's office directly??**  Finally, I asked for a copy of the dentist's chart notes for my dentist friend to review.  They sent me a billing statement instead.  Excellent young dentist (fresh from graduate school but really on the ball), fair staff.  With 2 staff and a dozen dentists' cases to juggle, probably they were not able to multitask everything all at the same time well enough to give the attention to each task that was necessary.Also...no hygenist available for cleaning and they may have charged me for more work than was done (I signed for the charges before the actual appointment, and most of the work was cancelled).  Lots of pain in my mouth--for unknown reason--walked out after painful xrays and exam with no analgesic or any scripts for medication for that matter.  It took me a while to realize how poorly this office visit was handled.

reviews.author: E B
reviews.text: They are absolutely the worst when it comes to keeping your appointment for you. I have had three appointments cancelled by them and the rescheduled appointments are almost always at least a month out and there is no guarantee that appointment will be kept. reviews.author: Miss Sarah
reviews.text: This has been my best experience with a dentist and all the staff I've ever had. I have to have  a lot of work done because I had cancer and it has made my already soft teeth begin to crumble. They have worked with me so much regarding planning and my financially  limited income. I actually saved up and went in to begin my plan the first tooth we were going to work on this year was to fix decay and get a crown. The dentist while looking at this tooth found she had enough left so all we had to do was a little build up and fix the cavitity. I was so excited because that meant a huge savings and made it possible to do my next tooth which I really need a crown to  happen sooner than I expected which will be at the end of this month. I also over the last few years have had to had a few teeth pulled and I recall going in about 2 years ago and just hoping that it wouldn't have to be but it had cracked all the way to the roots so it made me very emotional. The compassion I was given was so unexpected because here I am a grown up crying because I was losing my 2 tooth. There kindness and complete understanding helped me get through it. I was also financed in house at this time to get some additional work done. I have dental insurance but it doesn't cover much but even paying out of my super slim pocket I will always go to this dentist because of how they treat me.  I leave happy everytime and look forward to my next visit . My teeth feel so clean and fantastic after I get my cleanings done as well. I truly would recommend this dental office to anyone I know. I've always had the most exceptional experiences and they will be my dentist forever!  Just one more thing I have to say that yes this is a business and with the dentist telling me that we could actual just fill my tooth and fix the decay I was shocked because it would cost less for me but also not bring in the most money for them so they were looking out for my best interest and not there financial benefit. I have so much respect for this dentist.  Thank you so much for being the absolute best ever!!!

reviews.author: anya gambino
reviews.text: I had been going here because it is covered by my dental insurance.  However, today was the last straw.  I have been trying to schedule a dental cleaning since January, and both appointments have been cancelled, relatively close to (1 business day before) my appointment dates.  Most recently, I get a call that the appointment is cancelled on Friday and then a call that is a reminder for/confirmation of the appointment on Sunday, with the appointment on a Monday morning.  When I explain this to the receptionist WHILE I AM IN THE OFFICE for my appointment, she says "I have no control over that."  They don't have a hygenist on staff and are relying on a temp agency to fill the holes, and clearly, the holes are not being filled.  They are scheduling cleanings without confirming that they will have someone to PERFORM the cleanings.  Here's a thought- don't schedule appointments if you don't have the staff to complete the appointment.  It's not like someone called out sick today or had a family emergency.  Seems pretty simple, right? I have contacted my insurance company to relay the problems I have had recently at this office and I asked them to send me my records and close my file. Just a heads up for current and future clients to beware...

reviews.author: Josh Blake
reviews.text: I just walked out of this dentist and did not let them work on me. They have a policy that requires all patients to have an x-ray of their head every year you are their patient. I am 40 years old and have never had a cavity, filling, or crown in my life. I spoke with my friend who is a dentist and he said someone low risk like me does not need to have annual X-rays and that I need an X-ray only by exception, meaning if I have a problem. This Dental business wants to perform X-rays on everyone annually if you need it or not. They want you to have an X-Ray because it is a source of income from them and a procedure they can bill insurance companies for. The main problem with getting so many x-rays is that whenever your body gets exposed to radiation, there is a risk of damaging your DNA, which could lead to cancer.  The amount of radiation from one x-ray is very small but getting lots of dental x-rays every year can add up to a lot of radiation exposure over your whole life! I told them my concerns and they would not make an accommodation for me and refused to work on me. This is unethical because I am very low risk that the X-ray would uncover a problem and there are placing their income model over my safety. Everyone needs to not be overly concerned with X-Rays but also not agree to unnecessary X-Rays because radiation exposure is cumulative and also poses risks to your health. Bright Now dental is not concerned with their clients desires to limit this exposure because they can't bill the insurance company. You should not reward this office with your business as they are conflicted about truly representing your health.
