reviews.text: I recommend BrightNow! Dental, especially for new patients. I was impressed by the clean facilities, dentist, and staff on my first visit. On that visit, I had x-rays taken, a consultation with a dentist, and a cleaning. My dentist, Dr. Kwan clearly explained the different treatments available to me and Xenia, the main receptionist, explained the costs covered and not covered by my insurance. The hygienists seem to rotate depending on the day of your visit, but the cleaning that I got was totally painless. I wish you were located in downtown.

reviews.author: Dealing with It
reviews.text: Bought a new house nearby and wanted a local dentist. Tried this place and was disappointed. They appeared to just look at my insurance and maxed out the amount of work they could do. I got a second opinion from my usual dentist (where I've been going for about 20 years) and they just shook their head at the list, disagreeing that such work needed to be done. It looks like bright now is just a factory that the owner uses to extract maximum money from the patients. Even though it's an extra 10 miles to drive, I went back to my usual dentist.I'm sure this place could do the job that a dentist needs to do but you've got to reign them in and choose what work you want done and don't let them talk you into getting more than you need. The place isn't beyond dismal or outright criminal so I gave them 2 stars instead of one.

reviews.author: S R
reviews.text: Update:  I received a call from Sr. Sepi who was angry that I wrote about my experiences.  She tolfd me I would have to finish my care with a different orthodontist even though I prepaid for everything and she is not willing to return any of the money. Dr. Sepi did not show any concern for the pain I was in and the dentist’s request to have them remove the wire for tooth decay which was very close to the root. She was only concerned that I had written a one star review. When Dr. Sepi called me she tried to tell me that one is not allowed to write about an incident, only about overall experiences.Original review: I have an urgent dental issue and the dentist requested that I have the wire removed from my braces in order for them to do the work. In the past two years I have never made a request for assistance from Dr. Sepi’s office for anything that was outside of a regularly scheduled appointment. However, I am in a considerable amount of pain and was told this dental work cannot wait. I was very taken aback today by the new person answering the phones who said I couldn’t come in to have the wire removed on Wednesday (two days away) even though I explained to her that this was urgent and would only take a few minutes. She said they didn’t have time, told me to have a nice day, and disconnected the call. I was very upset because Dr. Sepi instructed me to go to the dentist. Unfortunately, the dentist at Trailside Dentistry told  both Dr. Sepi and myself it could wait until October. I am now in pain so I got a second opinion and the second dentist told me last week that it couldn’t wait. I thought Dr. Sepi would understand since she is the one who told me to go to the dentist. I have repeatedly been told by their staff that it isn’t a problem for them to remove the wire if needed. Unfortunately, her third receptionist in under a year decided to argue that I already have an appointment on August 12th, which does not help my dentist on August 5th. When I asked to speak to someone else she informed me that I would only be able to speak to her. I even asked to speak with Dr. Sepi but was told I wouldn’t be allowed to speak with her. It is awful to be in terrible pain and to have someone play gatekeeper and to fail to show any understanding of how urgent needs work. If I could’ve waited for my already scheduled appointment, I would have. As it is, I am waiting several days to get the work done.

reviews.text: Overall, I had a good experience and results. I even finished ahead of schedule. The team is knowledgeable, and front desk team is kind. I am docking a star because I needed reshaping and communicated this every visit — however they did my final retainer, and then had me redo it after reshaping with the dentist. The dentist found this strange as well that they didn’t have me do this before the retainer was first made. Not only was this an inconvenience, but I got charged for the second retainer. They did waive the charge given the misunderstanding, which I appreciate… however Dr. Sepi started treating me noticeably differently as a result. It was an unfortunate end to an otherwise great experience. I would have preferred to wait until I am completely done to provide a final review, but part of the tension was that I did not provide a review right away. In addition, my teeth shifted as a result of the delay of getting a second retainer so now I have to wear an additional set of aligners. I do have one more visit and truthfully I feel uncomfortable about going back for my followup after my last two interactions… it did not feel professional. My advice: reach out to your dentist for a second opinion if something feels off.

reviews.author: Lea Quan
reviews.text: I'm not getting paid to say this but I must say my orthodontics journey was so much smoother because of Dr. Sepi and her staffs. My case was quite complex as I had underbite, shifted midline, hidden tooth on top of some root canal treated teeth. I was feeling skeptical because they changed doctor and Dr. Sepi doesn't advertise herself and her degrees like many other doctors do. However, I'm so glad I chose her for the following reasons:1. Dr. Sepi never overpromise anything but she over delivers. My treatment was initially going to take 24 months but I saw wonderful results in the span of a couple of weeks (vary by person). In 10 months, I was already happy with the result. Never trust a doctor who promises short treatment with Invisalign without looking at your age and the complexity your teeth.2. iSmile charged the lowest fee out of all the clinics I had consultation with. They also do TAD for you in the clinic which nowhere else could when I asked.3. Dr. Sepi is easily reachable over the weekends and patiently explains what to do when something goes wrong. They're very accommodating and flexible as well if you ever want to take your braces off for important events, dental treatments, or simply want to switch to clear braces.4. The staffs here are super nice and welcoming. I love the friendly vibe in the office and always feel happy to come to my appointments and not scared.If you're debating whether to get braces or not, it's really worth the sacrifice and investment in my opinion and will make you a more confident person.

reviews.text: Dr. Sepi and team have been absolutely amazing and I would and have recommended them to people I know that are seeking orthodontia in the future. My case was unusual as I was a patient of the previous practice before she took over. Some time elapsed before I went for a veneer consult, they told me that I would need refinement as my top row were a bit close to the bottom and there could be risk of chips after the procedure. I explained my situation to them and they had me in immediately for an exam. I was nearing the end of the window from invisalign to be able to order new trays(which was my own doing). Dr. Sepi wanted to ensure I was ready for them and happy with my smile, she got me re-scanned and new trays lightning fast and I didn't miss the window. To my astonishment I was fully expecting to be charged for the additional work, she included it as part of the agreement by the previous owner. Very rarely have I been as impressed and thankful for this exceptional level of service, I would recommend iSmile to anyone I know and to anyone taking the time to read this review.

reviews.author: Tina Nicolas
reviews.text: My daughter has just completed her orthodontic treatment with Dr. Sepi and my younger son is just starting his treatment with her.We were able to take the basic expectations of orthodontic care for granted in her office.  Based on our experience with her, I have great confidence in Dr. Sepi's technical skills to make teeth align, install and adjust dental apparatus and make perfect smiles.  Dr. Sepi has a low tolerance for patient pain.  Breaks are taken or treatment is revised to keep pain in the rearview mirror.  Hygiene is well managed - gloved hands are in the patient's mouth, on sterile tools, on covered equipment or in the air.  I love how they open drawers!What I have learned from the experience of being in her office is that orthodontics is more than technical skill. It is craftsmanship.  It is the eye of the artisan. She has an amazing eye for straight and level but also for what makes you uniquely you.  Dr. Sepi talked to us about how to strike the balance my daughter wanted and was up front with costs. Then, she delivered the beautiful results.What has really made Dr. Sepi special in my mind is that her passion for the art and science of orthodontics brings out her inner teacher and coach.  She really wants us, both patient and parent, to understand and to have a picture of what is currently going on in the patient's mouth and what needs to happen for the mouth and teeth to work properly. She took a lot of time to explain.  We were given excellent instruction on how to care for the work that had been done in the mouth but also were coached and encouraged to voice concerns and questions.Another thing that really contributes to the climate in the office is that Dr. Sepi hires good people, skilled people and coaches them to be even better. The orthodontic hygienists don't think twice about asking her for help if they run into trouble.  Dr. Sepi steps in immediately and as she does so, she coaches the assistant as to how she is working out the problem and also takes in their suggestions.  Dr. Sepi levels everyone up so the staff is constantly refining their techniques and growing. I see this as a huge benefit to the patient because everyone works to their potential every day - they want to and are buoyed up by their work.   This means that when you see Dr. Sepi, there is a team in her office who cares about the work they do, and they care about the patient.   We have had Taryn most of the time as our hygienist and we love her too!What sets Dr. Sepi's practice apart is the ethos of the office:  People flourish here. I have the feeling that when she turns out the lights at the end of the day and closes the blinds, everyone who has been in the office that day has been uplifted in some way.

reviews.text: TL;DR: Dr Bill is really good. He takes a good care of their patients and their health; staff is very courtgeous, kind, and acommodating. I'm glad that it was his team that fixed my teeth!Long version:Hello, I was a client of Dr. Bill and he's a staff for at least 2 years and a half. I went to him because I need to get dental implants but first I needed to straight out my teeth because once I get the implants, is not gonna be possible to put my teeth in the correct position.Anyways, he was very good for different reasons:3. 🦷 Quality of Care & ResultsDr Bill really cared about my treatment. In the first session he listened about what brought me there, what I wanted to do, and provime some timelines to achieve my dental-care goals.He also mentioned what options I had between using Invisalign vs using braces and what it meant in term of cost, care, effort, results, etc. I really left that appointment thinking thathe was thorough about what options I had.During the sessions he would always checked how we were progressing. When I slacked on using rubber-bands he gently reminded me why they were important. When I used them consistently he woudl cheerished it so it motivated me to keep using them.I would say that I'm very happy with the results. My teeth are aligned. They look amazing. They support me in every step.1. Customer Service & StaffRenton Smiles Orthodontics staff is really nice. I don't recall having any bad interaction at all. On the contrary, they were very helpful, kind, and supportive.For example, more than once I had loose brace becasue I ate something too hard then they'll do their best to see me ASAP.Something that I like is that over time I really got to know them and they got to know me and get a strong patient/client patient relationship. I felt that some of the wires were poking my cheeks, the inside of my cheek. They were always diligent and quick to fix that. For example, I would call them and say, "Oh yeah, come quickly or you can come today. We'll make room for you." So they were really kind.2. Pricing & Payment OptionsWhole treatment was not expensive and they supported a plan to pay in installments. They reached out to my insurance and help me navigate that and check how much it'd cover and how much i'd cover.4. Office Experience & TechnologyRenton Smiles Orthodontics is very accessible. It's on the first floor so no need to climb stairs.The office itself is clean, and I got to say that I was very surprised that Dr Bill's office used a lot of tech to 3D scan my jaw, have X-rays, etc. He also updated all chairs and monitors so I think tech wise it was pretty amazing.

reviews.author: Goldie B
reviews.text: First I would just like to say that I never take the time to write reviews but I'm making time because if I can help at least one person make the right decision then I've done my job. I decided to go with Dr. Sorenson and he put on my braces in November of 2018. He said that my treatment would be around 18 months, ok fine. Now I will say that I understand that sometimes that is a guesstimate depending on how your treatment is gong. I did not expect much in the beginning because if you've had braces before you know that you go for adjustments etc. spread out over time. Well about after a year I asked him "about how long do you think I have before my treatment is complete?" His answer was "well you can take them off whenever you're ready". In my mind I'm thinking, "excuse me sir, I didn't pay all this money for that answer and further more your job is to tell me your expert opinion as I've paid you to do just that".Anyway, it was clear that my gut feeling was correct, his communication was absolutely horrible. After every appointment, I left not knowing how much longer I had or in what direction my treatment was going. It was absolutely HORRIBLE, when I realized that I wasn't the only one who felt this way I knew it wasn't just ME. Even my Dentist who had to communicate with him to get my braces just right couldn't believe his communication and inability to understand what she wanted. Well then a miracle happened during COVID, his office hired another orthodontist. I kept hearing to give him a try and after almost 3 years of Dr. Sorenson not being able to get my treatment done or communicate about it properly I decided to give Dr. Kaz a chance. Well let me tell you, it was a breath of fresh air! His communication skills were the absolute best, I left every appointment KNOWING exactly where I stood and he communicated with my Dentist beautifully. I say all that to say, I started with Dr. Kaz at the end of 2021 and was out of braces in June 2022. I would probably still be in braces had I not decided to make the change. I could never thank him enough. NOW, if you are an adult looking to get braces I recommend Dr. Kaz 100%. I can't speak for Dr. Sorenson as it relates to kids. He may possibly communicate better with parents of children but I will say if you want excellent communication skills, friendly, GENUINE interaction then Dr. Kaz is your guy!! I was going on 4 years with braces but was able to get them off at the 3 1/2 year mark thanks to Dr. Kaz.With all that being said, if it wasn't for possibly the best office staff that anyone could ever ask for that literally became family I don't think I would have made it. To Gretchen and Laurie at the front desk (who have since retired) THANK you! You two were the absolute sweetest and I loved our talks. To Brikaya, Valeria, Bianca and Michelle what would I have done without you 4?? The sweetest genuine souls that I will miss and hope to keep in touch with. All of you are gems and brighten up the office in the best way! THANK YOU THANK YOU. Lastly, Dr. Kaz thanks again for all of your help in such a short amount of time :)The reason I only gave 2 stars is because of my experience with Dr. Sorenson. If I was to rate Dr. Kaz and that amazing office staff I would have given 10 stars!!!!

reviews.author: Shannon O'Hara
reviews.text: In high school, I had bottom braces put on by Dr. Sorensen. Loved the atmosphere of the office, everyone was very nice & super informative. Fast forward 8 years, and now I'm back into Dr. Sorensen chair, you know when they say wear your retainer? Yeah, I thought oh it won't hurt to miss a few nights, then it turned into weeks, then into years... I know, I know, I did it to myself. Then one day, I noticed in a picture my teeth have shifted! I was ready for the whole " I told you so", but Dr. Sorensen & his assistants reassured me it's a simple fix. Now I'm doing Invisalign for my top teeth, 5 trays only! I absolutely LOVE Invisalign, I'm on my third tray and already noticing a difference! Thank you so much: Dr. S, Michele, Jen, Lisa, Lauri, and Gretchen for making me feel confident in my smile, again.

reviews.author: Tamela Thomas
reviews.text: The best measure of a person's character and professionalism is how they handle adversity.   I began treatment with the Invisalign product but did not get the result we had hoped for so about 2/3 the way through my treatment I was told I would have to go into traditional braces.  I was angry and shared my frustration with Travis and his great reception team.  Travis handled the confrontation well, stayed calm, and did not get defensive or confrontational.  After I cooled off, I came back and went into the traditional braces for about 6 months. The end result of Travis' work is a beautiful smile.  I appreciated that Travis stayed in the game when things were getting super touchy.

reviews.author: Jason Herbeck
reviews.text: I'm so glad that Dr. Sorensen was recommend to me!  I have been thoroughly impressed with everything about his orthodontics practice ever since my first visit almost a year ago.  Dr. Sorensen, his administrative staff, and his assistants are all awesome.  They are professional, friendly, and welcoming, and made me feel right at home from the start.  It's easy to feel self-conscious about something as visible and important as your teeth, but the sincere passion that Dr. Sorensen and his team have for what they do immediately put me at ease.  Not only is it clear that Dr. Sorensen is highly qualified, respected, and up-to-date in terms of the field of orthodontics, but he takes time to explain his assessment in detail, the different treatment options that are available, the timelines involved, etc.  Rather than feel pressured, I felt informed and well prepared to make a decision that fit my goals.  And once you've made a decision as to the treatment plan that suits you best, Dr. Sorensen is always happy to answer questions along the way.  I don't live in the Seattle area, but given how prompt, courteous, and helpful everyone is at Sorensen Orthodontics, it has definitely been the right choice for me.  Highly recommended!

reviews.text: Growing up I had braces twice and tons of retainers, so you can understand my surprise when I started to notice that a tooth was moving out of line! I can tell that my tooth is moving back into line, and I am so excited by the results.I highly recommend Sorensen Orthodontics and had a great experience with them in their Kent location.

reviews.author: Michaela Morrison
reviews.text: There is no other place I would go for my daughter or myself! I went to three different orthodontic consultations for my jaw pain… Two orthodontists said braces would fix my problem. Dr. Sorensen, however, took several x-rays (free of charge) and then sat down with me to explain that I needed to see a jaw specialist. He was more than willing to work with the specialist to correct the issue, but was honest in that simply putting me in braces would not fix my problem. So when my daughter’s teeth started coming in crooked, I could not think of anyone better to treat her! Torri, the other orthodontist in the office, is wonderful. She gave me her personal cell phone number after my daughter was fitted for a retainer; told me to call her anytime. Which I did… At past 9PM. reviews.author: Adam Billen
reviews.text: I just finished active treatment (~2 1/2 years of Invisalign + 1/2 year of braces) and have been very happy with my time here. I was a patient when ownership changed from Dr. Baker to Dr. Schruth and the transition was very smooth. I came in very skeptical about braces/Invisalign and met with Dr. Baker to ask her a list of 29 questions about why it was being suggested that I pursue treatment and if it was medical or cosmetic. She met with me 1:1 and answered all of my questions, explained what my teeth would/would not like long term if I did/didn't pursue treatment, and I (with my parents) decided to start treatment. Invisalign was pretty easy for me, it's uncomfortable at first but I stopped noticing it after awhile (started feeling weird to not have it in). Invisalign did the vast majority of the work for my teeth but I needed braces for a final adjustment on one or two particularly stubborn teeth. Dr. Schruth and the whole team knew I wasn't fond of braces and made my time with braces very short (we even tried a mini triple bracket for just the one tooth that needed adjustment) and only did them on my top teeth when that wasn't quite enough. They communicated clearly, adapted to what I wanted/needed as treatment went on, let me make the final decisions as treatment changed, listened to what I had to say, and made visits as much a casual conversation as they were orthodontist appointments. You won't regret coming here, and getting to and from the office is easy as they've got a parking lot and there's are #7 stops right by the office going both directions. Plus, plenty of places to go in Colombia City to get a cold smoothie or cone of ice cream after the occasional uncomfortable adjustment.

reviews.author: E Martin
reviews.text: Excellent staff and orthodontist, Dr. Schruth. We started our children with Dr. Baker for the “first stage” and completed the second stage with Dr. Schruth. He is patient, cheerful and explains the adjustments and treatment course. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kyle Sambat
reviews.text: I did 4 consultations before choosing Rainier Valley Ortho for my braces. I felt anxious at first since I'm getting braces at 21 years old but the staff were very friendly, welcoming, and very respectful. They have patients ranging from children to grown adults. The consultation took about less than an hour they explained financing, took xrays, looked at my teeth. In about a week they put spacers on and started the process right away. They also do discounts if you pay in full. I've never waited longer than 5 minutes when I come in and its rare for me to wait because they are always watching the front to make sure everyone's taken care of. The scheduling is very flexible I'm in college and when I needed to reschedule because of exams they were understanding and respectful. Every time I had a question or concern they were always quick to help and answer. Dr. Baker helped me first she was very kind, she retired and Dr. Schruth took over halfway through my treatment. I was skeptic of him first but that went away right after meeting him he was as kind and respectful as Dr. Baker. He takes pride in his work as he should because he does a really great job. He's passionate about his job and even though he takes care of a lot of patients he really takes time to make sure you're okay and well taken care of. Every appointment he's always happy to help and he's very nice to his staff. Kelly, Yanina, and Rinat are very helpful. I'm so happy with my teeth, I've always been insecure about them but after getting the braces off and finishing my treatment I feel more confident with my smile. Dr. Schruth also helped smooth out my front teeth to make them look straighter I'm glad I made my decision of getting my braces here. The place is very very clean. Parking is good too there's always space.

reviews.text: I’ve been a patient of Dr. Schur since 2015. He treats my whole family, so I’ve seen his work with both adults and kids.The office is always very clean, and the staff is kind, patient, and happy to answer any questions. After almost ten years, I feel comfortable enough to joke around with them, which really helps with the nerves I get when something goes wrong.For my child, they corrected a large gap between the front teeth and helped guide the transition to permanent teeth using temporary braces.Lacy, a former assistant, was especially helpful in reducing my child’s fear of the dentist. She also treated me, and those visits were some of the best experiences I’ve had.I was very hesitant to fix my own teeth — partly fear, partly stubbornness. Dr. Schur suggested trying Invisalign since it’s removable, but I struggled to wear the aligners for the required 22 hours a day. He talked through the issue with empathy and made me feel understood.I eventually switched to traditional braces, but I tend to break or lose brackets often. Even so, Dr. Schur and his staff have always been supportive and encouraging, even though every repair costs them time and money.I strongly recommend Dr. Schur for anyone looking for an orthodontist who is skilled, patient, and genuinely cares about his patients.

reviews.author: Ajay Krishna Amudan
reviews.text: TL;DR: Dr. Schur is an amazing orthodontist and my experience with him and everyone at the clinic has been incredibly positive.I recommend him to anyone who is looking for an orthodontist in the Redmond/Bellevue/Seattle area including for both braces and invisalign.Longer Version: I met Dr. Schur for the first time in October, 2020. I was really confused at that time if I wanted to do braces as a 25 year old. I was also considering whether I should get jaw surgery as part of my treatment because my jaws were pretty misaligned. I had previously seen another orthodontist in 2019 who was too eager to push me to the surgery route and I decided to not go through with orthodontics or surgery at that point. When I spoke to Dr. Schur, what I loved about him immediately was that he was willing to work with my goals in mind and he was empathetic but at the same time very practical and realistic. He pointed out to me that there was no reason for me to decide on whether I wanted to do go through with jaw surgery at that point and that he could make my teeth look a lot better both with and without surgery. That really helped calm me down. He also added that the first 6-8 months of orthodontic treatment can be done without knowing whether we do the jaw surgery and we can then figure out what I wanted to do. He also asked me to consult with Dr. Bobek who is the jaw surgeon he recommends which was a fantastic recommendation. Over the next 8 months, I figured out I did want to go through with the jaw surgery and eventually I got jaw surgery in April 2022, around 16 months after starting orthodontic treatment in December 2020. The surgery went really really and today, November 7, 2022, I got out of braces. I love how my teeth look and how my bite feels and I have 0 issues from my jaw surgery.Dr. Schur is really a genius at what he does and there are very few people I know who are as good at what they do. He is always thoughtful whenever I ask him any question ( which I usually tend to ask a lot of ) and never commits to anything unrealistic or impossible. He constantly reassured me through the journey even at times where I got a little anxious at how long it was taking or how my teeth still weren't looking perfect yet. If there is one thing I learnt through this process, it is that Dr. Schur always knows exactly what he is doing. He has also been really good at communicating with my jaw surgeon and my dentist. He is always on time and the visits in clinic are a breeze. His assistants and doctors in his clinic are super nice and are themselves very very good at what they do. The front desk has always been super helpful in setting up appointments and always super responsive over calls and have been able to get me in short notice multiple times when needed.My case was a complicated one with jaw surgery and a primary canine extraction as part of the entire process along with orthodontics and Dr. Schur really made sure everything went perfect well over the course of 23 months.

reviews.text: I just had another great experience (& reunion) with Dr. Jeff Schur and his orthodontic Team! 10 years ago, they used their orthodontia skills to successfully move the teeth in my lower jaw (where a damaged tooth had to be removed). Ever since that procedure, I’ve been wearing my retainer to keep my teeth in their “new” positions. But I just lost the retainer.I called Dr. Schur’s office late Thursday afternoon to ask if they could make a replacement retainer for me. I was surprised when they worked me into their schedule the very next day. They assessed the situation and made a mold first thing the next morning, had a new retainer made, and fitted me with it at 10 AM on Friday – less than 24 hours from when I called them “out of the blue” (no warning).They’re not only skillful and efficient, but as nice as they can be! Another very positive and telling fact is that the same clinical assistants helped me yesterday who were working with Dr. Schur for my orthodontia 10 years ago. That is a real (and positive) contrast to many offices in the dental professions these days, where it seems to be difficult to retain really excellent professionals.

reviews.text: Dr Shur and their team are amazing. I had originally started braces in Atlanta and moved to WA when I had already completed 6 months of treatment. I would highly recommend this place !!

As an adult orthodontic patient, I was against braces and instead of pushing me into a treatment plan I didn't want, Dr. Schur went back to the drawing board and came back with an Invisalign treatment plan that still gave me the results I desired. The Invisalign process was so simple and my teeth have never looked better! I highly recommend Dr. Schur and his team for any orthodontic treatment you may need!

reviews.author: Sofi A.
reviews.text: I've been dragging my feet about getting braces for many years. I finally gave in and I've had nothing but good experiences here at Dr. Schur's office. Dr. Schur is very patient and has a gentle touch - so far my visits have been virtually pain-free. He makes himself readily available for after-hours emergencies - even on Superbowl Sunday! reviews.author: Jamie Pikulin
reviews.text: Dr. Schur and his staff are exceptional. I am an adult orthodontia patient.  I had a fear of dentists and orthodontia for years; but that fear is gone. At the outset, Dr. Schur carefully explained the treatment options and his office manager explained the costs for treatment. Each time I visit, the staff is cheerful and competent, my treatment is explained and I leave looking forward to my next visit (really). To start my orthodontia, I had 4 wisdom teeth and 4 "regular" teeth pulled and had old-fashioned wire braces put on all in the same day. It was no problem at all! If I knew it would be this easy, I would have done this 20 years ago! I cannot say enough good things about Schur Orthodontics.

reviews.author: Oliver Lee
reviews.text: If you're thinking about visiting Dr. Teja for orthodontic treatment, please hear my story and strongly reconsider.  I visited about 4 different orthodontists in the Seattle area before deciding on her, and I made a big mistake. My treatment began during the summer of 2022, when I was in Seattle. In January of 2023, her office unfortunately had a fire and she was forced to close and relocate her patients to other local dental offices in order to continue to provide treatment (which made scheduling very difficult). I had also been planning to move to California during March of 2023 and I let her know that I would look at local orthodontists and see if the price was going to be an issue and attempt to transfer care.After moving to California in March of 2023 I realized I would need to pay another new round of orthodontics to transfer, so I decided to remain with her office (to which she agreed). During this time I had some attachments fall off and needed to get them reattached. In October of 2023, Dr. Teja had another emergency in which a family member had passed away, causing her to be unavailable for another 3+ months. During this time, there were only 2 communications sent to me from her office, one in October and one in November.After waiting for months, I decided to reach out to her office in March of 2024, which I found out she had been back by that time unbeknownst to me. In April of 2024, I flew back from CA to get my teeth rescanned so I could get new aligners. However, her office again failed to notify me and communicate with me for the appointment until I inquired what was going on in June of 2024.At this point she told me I was being a noncompliant patient and threatened to discontinue treatment for a breach of contract. This was her way I believe of trying to get rid of me as a patient. However, it was her office that was unable to provide timely care, was completely unavailable because of her office fire, and was uncommunicative for months on end, claiming that I was being a “noncompliant patient” and further refused to continue to provide me orthodontic treatment or give me any sort of refund.I submitted a formal complaint against her through my insurance company mid-2024. They had a 3rd party orthodontist investigate my case and after months of sending in evidence of communication between us, ruled in my favor and gave me a full refund of the money insurance had paid her. Of course I was relieved but it did not take away the massive headache and unnecessary blame I took (not to mention the initial deposit I made for orthodontics and continued payments, which was unrecoverable via credit card). I do my best to be the most compliant patient as I myself am in the service industry, but this was completely unprofessional and she lacked the self-awareness until a 3rd party had to look into it.If you’re on the fence of going to her office- do not. She seems nice and pleasant when you first meet her, but is totally unwilling to see the patient’s perspective and gave me a terrible experience with orthodontics. There are several other providers in the area with glowing reviews which I will not name but would recommend instead.EDIT: I am editing my response in order to provide a more complete picture to the reply by Dr. Teja below.a)Losing my attachments definitely compromised the fit of my aligners, despite what anyone may have “thought” so, hence why I could not put them on.b & c)The reason minimal progress was made was due to her office only being able to provide me 2-3 appointment dates PER MONTH and hence did not adequately meet the standard of care.d)I received a release of records. However, her office agreed to continue my care after this (this was documented).There was a previous review on Yelp for Dr. Teja under "Gwendolyn H" that describes exactly how I was treated and felt many times. I often felt invalidated, gaslighted, blamed, and had to put up with defensiveness and dismissal whenever I brought up something she did not like. Please read this review and make the judgment for yourself.

reviews.text: As a first time client I made an appointment to get my braces replaced because they are broken and haven’t been changed in 6 months. I moved from out of state and after a visit with the doctor she told me I should go back to the state from which I came to have them replaced. I also needed a permanent retainer and she does not do that. Since I do not plan on going back to the state I moved from this advice was not ideal and considering the doctor is an orthodontist she should at least be able to change my front bar/bands. The staff is lovely but as a practicing orthodontist this place is under qualified.

reviews.author: Chase Smolik
reviews.text: My review below is thorough, but in case you don't want to read all of it - Dr. Teja and team provided one of the best experiences I've had with an orthodontist. To describe Dr. Teja's practice in three words I would say: thorough, honest, and caring. If you are considering treatment, Dr. Teja will provide you an honest opinion and address any questions you may have.(I consulted 3 total orthodontist as I consider treatment, I previously had braces from 1999-2008 with an ortho out of state)I recently visited Dr. Teja at Queen Anne Orthodontics (along with two other orthodontists in the area) for a consult. Her and her staff had been displaced from their normal office due to smoke damage from a neighboring building that caught fire, so my consult was at a temporary location.I was kindly greeted by the woman at the front desk (apologies for not remember her name), and after completing paperwork was brought back for my appointment. Dr. Teja's dental assistant was incredibly kind and timely in collecting X-rays, photos, and discussing my reason for the consult.Briefly after, Dr. Teja reviewed my concerns and examined my teeth, bite, and discussed all options of treatment for my current concerns. She thoroughly explained the potential outcomes of each of the three options, even if I chose not to seek treatment at this time what may happen. I greatly appreciate her approach to honesty & transparency, because she helped to explain the pros and cons of every option, ultimately leaving it to my decision.After we discussed the options, Dr. Teja took the time to explain how Invisalign works, shared pricing information, and while we had a brief moment for her dental assistant to take a few more pictures, she took the time to get to know me a bit more.Two weeks after my appointment, I received a follow-up letter personally addressing me and wishing me well on my time with family out of state (something we discussed in our appointment) and to keep them in mind as I consider treatment.Even though I have yet to begin treatment, when I do, I will choose Dr. Teja at Queen Anne Orthodontics. Dr. Teja and her staff truly care about their patients and it shows!

reviews.author: Nathalie Stanley
reviews.text: Not very cost effective. When breaking brakets had to pay 75$ per broken braket. Was extremely unhelpful when asking for tips and tricks to make things easier to remember putting on bands. When we finally got to retainer it immediately broke and I had no money to get another one. I grind my teeth in my sleep and her advice was and I quote "just stop doing it." "You gotta do better!" Hated going in and after it burned down we didn’t get any instruction of what to do.Even more infuriating my sister had a braket that kept popping off and she kept having to pay. Only 500$ down the line were they able to fix the problem. No matter what concern we had it was always met with an eyeroll and "we know how to do our job"They were all genuinely nice people and I would feel bad for telling them this in person but its been a few months now and I'm just stupidly frustrated about it as I have to do this whole process again somewhere else. Probably just using invisalign this time around.

reviews.text: Recently,  my dentist  finished porcelain veneer work on my two front teeth.  What an intricate process and precise work that has been!  I am ecstatic how my teeth look! Dr Teja was recommended by my dentist who said: "she does precise work, she is thorough in her line of work and when you are finished with wearing invisilign, your bite and teeth will be perfect for my veneer work." While Dr Teja worked with me, I was always treated with much care, kindness and could come in at any time that worked for my work and life schedule. reviews.text: I came here after another orthodontist recommended treatment that felt overly aggressive and honestly way too expensive. This office took a much more reasonable approach and explained exactly which issues actually needed correction versus cosmetic preferences. That transparency made me trust them almost immediately. The office itself is clean and modern without feeling cold or overly fancy. One adjustment appointment left my teeth more sore than usual, so I called worried something was wrong. They squeezed me in for a quick check, adjusted the wire slightly, and the discomfort improved almost immediately afterward. The assistants are also very gentle during appointments, which matters because my teeth are sensitive. I’m only halfway through treatment and the changes in my smile are already more noticeable than I expected this early on.

reviews.author: S Keranen
reviews.text: An enthusiastic 5 Stars for Dr. Heidi Horwitz and her staff!I grew up in a poor family with 6 kids, so braces were never an option growing up.  Fast forward years later, and after school, work, marriage, putting a child through private schools, braces and college, it was finally my time to address a smile that always bothered me and was causing issues with wear.  In a consultation with a different orthodontist, I was told they would need to pull teeth.  I never went back. Thank goodness I found Dr. Horwitz, as she confirmed there was no need to pull teeth, and moreover, that she could correct my crooked overbite using the Invisalign system. I didn’t think Invisalign was even an option for me, but she patiently explained the entire process, showing before and after pictures of smiles like mine. Her office employs high-tech equipment, and is in a beautiful setting in West Seattle, which is a great location for anyone living on the west or south side.  Her staff is fantastic – a fun, professional and congenial team. I seriously can’t remember when I’ve laughed so much at any doctor’s office.  You can tell they all enjoy their jobs, and care about their patients and their treatment results.  Now that my treatment is complete, I will truly miss my second family at Dr. Horwitz office.  I plan to visit just to say ‘Hi’ now and then (and for the occasional retainer check).   I recommend Dr. Horwitz – smiles all around!

reviews.text: If I could give Dr. Horowitz and her team 10 stars I would! Their mantra should be "going the extra mile" because no matter what you need they will make it happen. I did Invisaline and Dr. Horowitz made sure everything was perfect, from correcting my under-bite, to narrowing my lower incisors to make room for all of my teeth. Her team is also a pleasure to work with and these ladies make you feel at home every time you come into their beautiful West Seattle office. They made a huge effort to work with my very complicated schedule and navigated my multiple insurance companies. If you have the option to go to Dr. Horowitz I would strongly recommend her!

Her compassionate and patient demeanor instantly put my daughter at ease, making each visit a positive and stress-free experience.The entire staff at Orthodontic Excellence deserves praise for their professionalism and dedication to creating a warm and welcoming environment. From the friendly receptionists to the skilled technicians, everyone has contributed to making our visits pleasant and enjoyable.Furthermore, the state-of-the-art facilities at Orthodontic Excellence are a testament to the practice's commitment to excellence. The modern equipment and advanced technology utilized by Dr. Megha and her team instilled confidence in the effectiveness and efficiency of the treatments provided.I am delighted to see the remarkable progress my daughter has made under Dr. Megha's care. Her expertise in palatal expansion and braces has resulted in significant improvements in my daughter's dental alignment and overall oral health. We are truly grateful for her exceptional skills and unwavering dedication.I wholeheartedly recommend Orthodontic Excellence and Dr. Megha to anyone seeking top-notch orthodontic care. reviews.author: Monica Devaraju
reviews.text: Dr. Megha and her staff are incredibly kind and knowledgeable. They understand that being poked and prodded and having braces in your mouth is not always the most fun thing and strive to make the process streamlined, easy, even enjoyable.My treatment with them was a pleasant one- they explained the timeline upfront and kept me updated at each check-up. The staff took the time to go through paperwork and associated pamphlets (taking care of braces/what not to eat/taking care of retainers, etc.) and give their personal advice, which I found especially helpful. I'm a person that likes to ask questions and have an idea of what I'm getting into, and I felt quite comfortable bringing these up with Dr. Megha & staff- they are very approachable and well-informed about the patient experience. Though the office is currently split between two locations, scheduling was straightforward and I was able to get in when I needed to, even being a university student commuting from another city. Oh, and the facilities and equipment are great! Bonus: the staff takes time to decorate for holidays and make the space a fun one for kids :-)

reviews.author: David Stipe
reviews.text: I gave myself braces for my 55th birthday. I was scared and not quite sure to expect even though my Daughter had braces as a child. Tara took away all of those fears during our first meeting. My experience has been meeting these wonderful, caring, personable, compassionate, friendly, helpful, professional people I have ever had the pleasure to meet. I will always remember my time with everyone. The first time I saw Dr. Virk's big hands moving towards my small mouth I thought this isn't going to work. But, It did. He was gentle and his hands did fit into my small mouth. Jessica was always able to "change" my appointments when work got in the way. Dr. Chatur was a driving force in how well I did with my braces. She and Bobbi treated me with more kindness during this whole process than I could ever wish for. Dr. Chatur gave me the ability to smile again without hesitation. For that, I will always be grateful. I moved away from my friends last year. I miss them. I managed to find another Ortho group to see me the final months of my braces. I hope to get to get my braces off next Saturday. It will not only be a day to remember for my but I am sure I will cry. Not because of the long process, the waterpicking, the cleaning, and everything associated with this accomplishment, but because I know that without the encouragement from these great people I would not have been able to do it. I know ths is more than 4-5 lines, but I could write all day about my experience and the happiness I am feeling. Now, the cosmetic work begins and my transformation will be complete. I encourage and challenge any adult who is considering braces to go see the great people at Orthodontic Excellence. The key word here is "Excellence"! Thank you!! Thank you!! Thank you!! David

reviews.text: I went here to get a second opinion on invisilign after first visiting my dentist. Originally my dentist told me that I should get veneers to cover a small cosmetic gap in my front teeth. He also advised that I could get invisilign in combination with veneers, but I would be paying for most of the costs out of pocket because it was "cosmetic". After thinking it over, I went to Orthodontic Excellence to get a second opinion. They were VERY friendly, the first triage visit was free of charge, and they gave me very unbiased honest opinions about my mouth. Eventually we decided on invisilign and composite teeth caps that will both correct some crooked teeth, and fill a small cosmetic gap in my front teeth. They also worked with my insurance company, and got MOST of the cost covered. I only had to pay a small amount per month for the duration of the treatment, insurance covered the rest.Thanks guys, keep up the good work.

reviews.author: Tara Smith
reviews.text: Great staff and doctors. My kids absolutely love this office and are excited to go to their visits each month. Staff extremely helpful with my insurance needs. Great experience overall

reviews.author: Angela Velasco
reviews.text: Exceptional orthodontic care from start to finish. The office is clean, organized, and welcoming. Cristal thank you for your patience, with both my daughter and I we will miss seeing you and the rest of the team. I would absolutely recommend this practice to anyone considering orthodontic treatment.

reviews.author: J Feldman
reviews.text: If you are an adult getting Invisalign, please get a second opinion, or just go somewhere else.I finished my care with Leone & Vaughn last year and was left with front teeth that were completely different than what they told me to expect, constant jaw pain, and an uneven bite. I wore my aligners every day and night for all the recommended time and never missed a day/night.At my final visit, I had a gap in my two front teeth, that I have never had in my life.I was then gaslit by their providers who told me to “go to a TMJ specialist” and they also had no option for fixing the new gap in my teeth other than putting on a permanent retainer, which at my first visit, they said they never install on clients.They rushed through visits and conversations and are not honest when they make mistakes.Their treatments are far more expensive than their competitors and the lack of care they provide does not align with their costs.It is unfortunate that I wasted nearly two years and a ton of money to get jaw pain and gapped teeth.

reviews.author: James Calhoun
reviews.text: I’ve been going for aligners for just over a year and wrapping up treatment. After being scanned for retainers, I felt one tooth was not fully aligned. They scheduled me to come back in, offered to make the adjustments at no additional costs.The adjustments were made by using a tool to  make indentions into the existing aligner trays (assuming due to new tray costs), we tried this with a few repeated sessions. I ended up with one of my front teeth and the one next to it still not aligning with a noticeable ridge. The rest have had noticeable and much improved alignment.I previously tried Smile Direct Club and did 2-3 additional treatments/revisions with no luck. Turns out it was due to overcrowding which the at-home program couldn’t offer a solution to.Overall, feel like the shop was professional but focused on volume over individual quality/results. Would probably go with a different place for future adjustments (which I believe I will need)

reviews.author: Chiho Harada
reviews.text: I recently completed my Invisalign treatment at this clinic. While the staff and doctors were always friendly and professional, my overall experience was somewhat disappointing.The final results were not as straight as I was initially told they would be. I also lost some of the natural function of my canine teeth — for example, I can no longer use them to cut thread when sewing, which I could easily do before. The treatment seemed more focused on appearance rather than bite alignment.Communication and consistency were also concerns. After the full payment was made, the follow-up care felt less attentive. When the clinic changed its location, I did not receive any notification, and once, after arriving only five minutes late, I was told my appointment could not be seen that day.In addition, different doctors sometimes gave conflicting advice — for instance, when my aligners stopped fitting properly, one suggested wearing them for three weeks per set, while another recommended ordering new ones.Although everyone at the clinic was kind and polite, scheduling was often difficult, and the experience as a whole felt disorganized.I truly appreciate the staff’s effort, but based on my experience, I might hesitate to recommend this clinic to others considering Invisalign treatment.

reviews.author: Sherman Buck
reviews.text: Chanthavy was great, was able to temporarily fix my upper retainer till new one is made, due to needing a crown. I had my series of Invisalign's with them and am extremely happy with how my teeth and bite are. My teeth were in very bad condition in the beginning. I've had several replacement retainers made with an upper night guard. Each time was a great experience, quick, efficient, and timely turnaround in getting the new ones. Today's experience was also great as I got to experience their new technology for scanning teeth instead of using the old methods of using the goop to make impressions. Very cool. As always the staff is super friendly, informative, and am able to get a timely appointment when needed. Turnaround time for getting the replacements is also appreciative. I would heartily recommend them for orthodontistry services.

reviews.author: Sheryl Wiser
reviews.text: My experience was wonderful! Professional, kind and extremely capable staff all the way around. I couldn't be happier with my treatment or the outcome.

reviews.author: T. Ten Bruin
reviews.text: I wanted to give this clinic a better review, but my experience has been subpar. I initially felt good during my consultation in March 2024; the doctor listened to my concerns about needing another course of Invisalign after losing my retainers. She suggested trimming some teeth for a better fit, which made me anxious, but she reassured me we could still achieve the results I wanted without that approach.After much contemplation, I decided to revert to the full treatment plan that might involve tooth trimming. However, during my follow-up appointment on February 24, 2025, I realized no one seemed to be listening to my updated request, as I only interacted with assistants without any doctor involvement.By June 23, 2025, I was told to wear tray number three longer, and then I met with a different doctor who also failed to pay attention to my concerns. At my final appointment in August, the doctor indicated they had followed my initial requests without acknowledging my attempts to change the plan. I was shocked to learn that my additional notes were not documented, and staff only referred to my initial consultation notes.Reflecting on my experience, I feel neglected by the staff and frustrated with the lack of personalized care. It seems they prioritize volume over individual attention, leaving me dissatisfied with my Invisalign journey.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Whalen
reviews.text: I had braces as a kid but didn't wear my retainers. (Wear your retainers, kids!) So, I needed orthodontic treatment as an adult and went to Leone & Vaughn after initially having a consultation elsewhere.My experience was great from the start. Everyone there is efficient, organized, friendly, and knowledgeable. Plus, I was able to get Invisalign treatment, which the initial orthodontist said I couldn't do. And, I saved about $3,000 compared to what the initial orthodontist had recommended.My bite is now aligned, I always wear my retainers, and my teeth look great. :)I recently had some crowns done and needed new retainers. I hadn't been to the office for a while, but it was still the same great experience.My only wish is that every healthcare provider could be as organized as this place.

reviews.author: Carly Reigel
reviews.text: I’m not sure why I haven’t written a review yet, but it’s long overdue! I saw Leone and Vaughn for my final treatment for Invisalign where I had switched ortho providers. They were nothing but professional and always felt welcome.I’ve personally never received a long wait time here but to be fair they’re busy and long waits can be a thing in any office. Don’t let the recent negative review deter you from coming here they are great! I’m happy with my final smile and would come back. Photo below is my husband and I.Thank you team! 🫶

reviews.author: Samantha Anderson
reviews.text: I came in for an Invisalign consultation and unfortunately had a disappointing experience. I was made to wait 45 minutes past my scheduled appointment time. At first, I was told the delay was due to a patient emergency, but later the assistant admitted it was actually a scheduling mix-up—and that the doctor had been available the whole time. That kind of miscommunication and lack of transparency was really frustrating.To be fair, I did like the doctor herself—she seemed knowledgeable and kind—but the staff’s handling of the situation left a bad impression. I also ended up getting a second opinion, and another orthodontist quoted me literally half the price for the same treatment. Ultimately, I decided to go elsewhere. I can’t recommend this office based on my experience.

reviews.author: Ankita Gadage
reviews.text: They made me wait 1.5 hours before the appointment. Very slow service. Whole story- I arrived at 2 pm, at the check in the lady said my appointment was scheduled for next week same time, then she added that there is an opening at 3pm. For which I said okay. I dont mind waiting for one hour because Its my mistake. However at 3.05 I checked with them again on if it really at 3, and they said that its at 3 and some will see my shortly. They made me wait additional 30 minutes after that. After checking with them multiple times they finally took me in to only talk to a nurse practitioner. If they had clearly communicated beforehand that it will take 1.5 hours I would have not waited and rescheduled for some other day. Moreover I had completed my paperwork right when I went in, the paper had 10-20 questions on it for which all answers were either yes or no. I dont understand how that can add delay to the assessment unless people working there are slow.

reviews.author: Jae-In Shin
reviews.text: We’ve had a great experience with the doctors and staffs here. I want to give a special thanks to Chanthavy for her incredible skills and patience with my kids. Her professionalism and kind demeanor truly stand out. Thank you to the entire team for making this process so easy for us.

reviews.author: Karen Conner
reviews.text: This is the ultimate destination for orthodontic treatment!My daughter was treated by Dr. Leone and Dr. Vaughn during her school years with Invisalign, and she had great success. When I decided to improve my smile, there was no doubt about where to go—Leone and Vaughn are leaders in this field. Why go anywhere else? The staff is friendly and professional, patiently answering all my questions about the treatment process. Dr. Leone embodies the quintessential Italian spirit, balancing genuine warmth with a straightforward approach—she tells it like it is. It's refreshing to know I can trust her to be honest about what she can or cannot do for me. I truly value that honesty is alive and well at LVO.During week 19 of my treatment, I struggled to fit my upper aligner correctly. I called the office, and they scheduled me for a visit that same morning. No “we can see you a week from Tuesday” here—they prioritize getting you in and resolving issues quickly! I met with a technician who understood my issue and made the necessary corrections in no time. Now, I also know how to handle this myself if it happens again. I greatly appreciate the knowledge, care, and promptness of this team. They genuinely care about their patients, and it shows. Many thanks to the LVO team for all that you do.

Their prompt response and commitment to resolving the problem demonstrated their dedication to providing excellent care.It's evident that they don't tolerate anything less than perfection. Their commitment to excellence is unwavering, and it shows in every aspect of their practice. I truly have a lot of respect for that!

reviews.text: I recently completed treatment with Dr Leone. I cannot say enough about the positive experience I had with her and her offices. She recommended a great treatment plan after a thorough evaluation and carefully walked me through it.  I felt very supported through the Invisalign process and jaw surgery.  I appreciated the professionalism of her and her staff.  I am a physician and a medically sophisticated patient for this reason. I would highly recommend Dr Leone’s  care and the amazing staff at her office.  My biggest regret is not getting treatment much much sooner!

reviews.text: Working with L&V has been one of the best experiences I’ve had related to health.They are efficient with their systems but also give you ample time for one on one care with the most experienced orthodontists in the region. Can’t recommend them enough.Thank you Paola!

reviews.author: Kevin Escalante
reviews.text: Succinct, efficient, and astute doctors/staff. The removal of Invisalign attachments went smooth with Cristal. Thank you all!

reviews.author: Aria A
reviews.text: I have been going to L&V for a few years now due to my own fault. The doctors are great. The staffs were great too until I had a very uncomfortable phone call today. I requested to get my last name change due to a bad and abusive divorce. I requested this in June when I was in the office and explained my situation. But, I guess they forgot to adjust my invisalign profile. All of my new invisalign boxes had my previous last name. My actual last name is Armand which is simple to pronounce. The scheduler kept saying arMAN-d and laughed when I corrected him. I was trying to be understanding and thought maybe it's just a mispronounciation but it happened multiple times. I guess it was funny to say Man-d to someone who just told them about their abuse. I think my rating is generous after that experience.

reviews.author: Gulo Himitsu
reviews.text: It has been wonderful being a client of Leone and Vaughn this past year and a half. My smile has never looked better and I couldn’t be happier. My final appointment with Cristal was phenomenal. I had some trepidations about what the final steps would be, and with the removal of the anchors. Cristal sat down with me and detailed out the whole process, she even took the time to take one more pass at removing my anchors and helped to settle any remaining nerves that I had.Such a great experience.

reviews.author: Gordon Yu
reviews.text: Smile Direct Club destroyed my ability to bite down on food, and Leone & Vaughn fixed it. Your teeth are important. PLEASE save your health, time, and money by avoiding Smile Direct Club and coming here for your orthodontic work. Get it done right the first time.

reviews.text: Pros: Nice looking office, parking is available, doctors seems very nice, they offer a prompt appointment for ortho evaluation, which is free.Cons : Price might be a bit in high side, Doctor seems to be in a bit of a rush, they seems to have plenty of business to care about individual needs, little effort into Made to earn one’s business.

She personally accompanied me to the receptionist to assure my next 2 appointments were coded correctly as there had been recent "system updates".  A great representative for LVo.  Thank you, Linda.

reviews.author: jemma c
reviews.text: I have been struggling awhile with whether or not to write about my experience as a patient here.  I hate to give a less-than-stellar review to a local business, but I also want to share my experience with other potential patients - especially since orthodontics is such a big investment.  It's also something that I think about daily when brushing/flossing/eating, so I decided to write my honest review.  I went to Leone and Vaughn based on all the reviews and accolades of the providers, but I have not had the experience I had hoped for.  I had Invisalign as an adult (in my 30's) and was open to regular braces if that would be a better option for my situation.  I had a minor correction and was told that Invisalign would work for me.  Unfortunately, I've been very disappointed with the results.  My teeth look straight from the front, but from the side (profile) the upper teeth have just been pushed/tilted  backwards.  There are spaces between my teeth and the gums all along my front teeth which weren't there before I had treatment.  Every time I eat, food gets stuck between several of my front teeth in places that are visible, which is frequently embarrassing.  When I'm not eating, I can see black spaces where there weren't any before.  I brought this up to the orthodontist when we were close to the end of the treatment and was told I would have to go back to my general dentist and have bonding or veneers done to correct it.  This was a huge disappointment since I'd already paid about $5,000 for the Invisalign.  My bite is also not 'balanced'.  I can make one side or the other touch, but both sides do not touch at the same time.  They did try to grind down my natural teeth in the back to get them to touch, but they were never able to get it correct.  Also, because of the change in the position of my teeth, and having them pushed back in, my lips are not supported anymore.  My lips turn down at the corners instead of going straight across.  At first, I could not drink out of cups without spilling because my lips did not meet properly.  I have learned how to accommodate so that it doesn't happen anymore, but my lips still have the same downturned appearance in person/photos.  The changes in my teeth affected my lower face, too.  I have dimples and lines that I didn't have before and there is a lot more movement in my muscles.  I have deep 'marionette' lines that have shown up as a result of the loss of vertical dimension in my lower face.  (I had a consultation with a nurse injector to see if fillers or botox will help with these issues, and they explained why it happened in the first place.). The change in the proportions of my face is something I did not anticipate and has been something that I have to get used to now.The issues with my bite have caused TMJ problems.  It's not everyday, but I'm getting headaches and muscle pain from the position of my teeth.  Because my upper teeth were tipped/pushed back, my lower teeth and jaw have to also go back to fit behind the upper ones.  It just feels like my jaws don't fit right anymore and there is extra tension in the muscles of my face to try to keep my lower jaw back in the new position.In addition, I found that there wasn't consistency with the care.  They had 3 orthodontists and they were running several chairs at once.  They would be rushing in and out of the chair and often didn't have time to spend with each patient to give individualized attention.One more thing - I've given it some time to see if any of the issues above would improve after things 'settled in'.  It's been several months and I've been faithful with wearing my retainers - I wear them religiously.  If anything, the jaw issues, facial esthetics, and especially the black spaces (food traps) are getting worse.   I cannot in good faith give more than a 2 star review to this business.  I hope this helps some of you in your search for an orthodontist.

reviews.author: Max Willis
reviews.text: Leone & Vaughn (L&V) is a top-tier provider for orthodontic treatment in the Seattle area. I was wary at the thought of getting braces, but after my original consultation in March of 2016 with Dr. Leone, I immediately felt excited at the prospect of fixing my bite/teeth with the Invisalign treatment.I have only been to the Interbay/Elliott area office, but it was definitely a beautiful and well set up space. Everything is sleek, suave, and modern.At every step of the way, L&V was efficient, friendly, and accurate. Checking in at every appointment was a breeze, and I was always seen on time (that's a huge pet peeve of mine: when doctor's offices always see you much later than your appointment time).During my appointments, the orthodontic assistants were well-trained and accurate in describing certain procedures being performed on my teeth at the time of the appointment. While I was never seen by Dr. Vaughn, I can say that Dr. Leone and Dr. Davis were excellent. I never felt nervous or worried about what they were going to do my teeth when it came to adjusting brackets or making cuts between my teeth to allow them to compact more.After each appointment, I met with a receptionist to confirm my next appointment. One little thing I really appreciated about this was the slip they printed for me that detailed my next appointment, including about how long the appointment would last.I cannot thank Leone & Vaughn, Dr. Davis, and all of their orthodontic assistants enough for improving the longevity of my teeth. If you need braces or just want to get a consultation, check L&V out. I highly recommend their services!

reviews.text: Absolutely the best!!!  I can comment on 2 appointments for care.  We came in from out of town, 3 hours away, for an ortho consult for my grandson, age 8 and my husband came for his Invisaline -- a 65 year old and an 8 year old.  When it came time for Dr. Leone to review all the photos of my grandson's teeth, she made the entire family feel very comfortable.  Her bedside manner with my 3 year old granddaughter was so special and hilarious.  She involved the 3 year old in the exam, gave her gloves to put on, and seated her on the other side of her brother, engaging in "doctor chatter" with her, calling her Dr. Izabella. After Izaiah was done, 3 year old Izabella wasn't done and said her tummy hurt and she needed her teeth checked, too.  Dr. Leone acted very concerned, put her in the chair, put the light on her tummy to make it feel better and checked out her teeth too. Dr. Leone then took Izabella to see her Papa (grandpa) who was getting his Invisiline put in and then the kids were taken to the play room for some waiting time. reviews.text: My journey began three years ago.  That may sound long but I did not have an ordinary case, quite the opposite really.  My wisdom teeth had come in fully impacted so badly my previous permanent retainer had broken off and all of my teeth shifted into a terrible cross bite.  (Bottom back molars sat outside the top back molars).I began consulting with some of the highest ranked orthodontists in Seattle.  The first three I met all gave me the same answer:  we break your mid-palatal suture bone and expand surgically (SARPE).  This suture bone (roof of mouth) fuses when you're 13, and is not usually recommended for adults.  The process is long, gruesome and extremely painful.Finally, I had my consultation with Dr. Vaughn.  While he admittedly told me upfront there was not an exact clear cut path, as long as I was committed, we would find a way WITHOUT surgery! Low and behold they did!!! They made me a custom appliance for expansion, used a new non surgical procedure called "propel" that worked wonders on the crossbite, we used regular braces on the bottom and finished off with a round of Invisalign.  Ultimately, I now have perfect teeth without the breaking of any bones! So what others called impossible was reality at Leone Vaughn and Davis.No matter which of three doctors you are working with, they never miss a beat.  The atmosphere of all three offices is great, each catering to patients of all ages.  Great and friendly staff that always greet you with a warm smile.  Most importantly, accommodating with scheduling.  Even though we moved with 6 months left in our treatment (myself and my husband) we flew out to finish up our treatment.  After all that hard work there was no way I would transfer so close to the end.  My husbands case was much more simple than mine, a nice quick painless round of Invisalign did the trick. (Less than a year).We would recommend anyone looking to have orthodontic work done go here! They treat you like family and really really know what they're doing.  (No wonder they teach at UW!)

After going every 6 weeks for the past 18 months AND seeing the final outcome, I would happily recommend L&V to anybodyUnlike most of the other doctors I saw, when I originally consulted with Dr. Leone she really spent time with me reviewing my options and explaining the different aspects of each one. She didn't only focus on how straight my front teeth would be but on my overall bite and the health of my teeth. I've never had such a thorough consultation, and that kind of attention to detail continued throughout my treatment. I chose to go with Invisalign and now that I am done I can't be more thrilled. My smile looks great!During the course of my treatment I realized what a huge difference made to do Invisalign with the orthodontist instead of general dentist. Even though the price might be little higher, the results and devoted attention to overall success are guaranteed. I strongly recommend doing Invisalign only with specialist such as Dr. Leone.Another advantages of this practice are: warranted coupon for $750 from yelp without question, offering affordable interest free monthly payment plans, contemporary office with most up to date technology in orthodontics, as well same day service for retainers.Piece of advice regarding Invisalign: absolutely choose Acelledent device that cuts down the time in half. It is worth every penny to be able to change trays every week instead of every two weeks. I highly recommend this option since that not only cuts the time it half, it also helps with teeth tenderness being quickly gone when using new trays.Overall, this is the best medical practice experience I had so far and would encourage anyone to start with Leone and Vaughn first when seeking orthodontist work.

reviews.text: I was a patient here ten years ago. The entire experience was drawn-out and anxiety-inducing. The brackets of my braces were continually removed and glued back into place, trying for perfection, even though when they were finally removed for good my two front teeth were misaligned. I had a permanent retainer installed on my bottom teeth that I just had to have removed at another orthodontist's office because my teeth were shifting out of alignment. They never told me that the permanent retainers deteriorate over time, causing teeth to move. Dr. Lund also ground down my canine teeth as a minor, without parental consent or even my own consent. I never would have agreed to the procedure if he'd given me a chance to speak. Do not go here, and do not agree to a permanent retainer!

reviews.text: This is my second time working with Lund and they will always be my go to recommendation for anyone with orthodontic needs.First, the offices are so cute! They are colorful, energetic, friendly, and inviting. Even in the months where it seems like it never stops raining, you walk into the Lund office and it seems like the day just gets sunnier.Second, their doctors are amazing. I got to work with both Dr. Paul and Dr. Rebecca throughout my orthodontic journey and they are both awesome. They are great at listening to patient concerns and addressing them as quickly as possible with as much detail as they can.Last but absolutely not least, THE ORTHODONTIC TEAM IS INCREDIBLE! I worked closest with Zena and Karley but the entire team is amazing. They're all so sweet and very considerate (but Karley and Zena are definitely my favorites). The team is great about taking their time, not rushing you or making you feel like you HAVE to stay still the entire time if you feel uncomfortable. They'll always explain what they're doing for you, even if you already know what they’re doing by the end of your treatment. If you really want a truly exceptional appointment, Zena and Karley are great and will have you smiling or potentially laughing out of your seat by the end of the appointment.Lund, 10/10 would recommend. If you go anywhere else, you’ll get cavities and your teeth will fall out.

reviews.author: Sohyun Kim
reviews.text: Such a great orthodontics office. Every part of my experience here was excellent. I came here originally because a part of my permanent retainers broke off and I wanted to get them off because they have bothered me for a while now. When I called to get an appointment, they said I could get an appointment in 2 days (very short notice, so really appreciated) and that it could be possible that they could actually take off the retainers same day.When I went to my appointment, the front desk was friendly and welcoming. Everyone I talked to while at my appointment were so nice. I got a scan of my teeth done and I was able to meet with the doctor, who said she could take off the permanent retainers on both sets of teeth.I was given a clear estimate of costs for the removal and the clear removable retainers I could get if I wanted to have something else for my teeth so they wouldn't shift. This was much appreciated considering last time I got a removable mouth guard at a different dentist's office, they gave me a low estimate and it ended up costing much more. So, thank you for actually billing me the amount you told me it would cost.They were able to take off the permanent retainers the same day, which felt so good. Then they took that scan and sent them to the lab to create the removable retainers. I'm so glad technology has advanced so now you don't have to almost choke on the goo they use to make the mouth molds.I was able to pick up the retainers a week after, and that process was fairly fast and easy. I checked in, they brought me to my retainers and asked me to try them on, then the doctor came to make sure they looked good and asked me if I had any questions.Thank you so much for the amazing experience. I'm a little sad that since I already had my braces done when I was younger, I won't have much of a reason to come back. However, if I need replacement retainers or someone needs a recommendation, I will recommend Lund Orthodontics!

reviews.author: Pepper
reviews.text: I wanted Invisalign to correct my midline, and I think I made this clear when first starting. However, two years or so into my treatment, I was told that Invisalign would never shift my midline to center, and that I would need an invasive surgery to correct it. What was the point then? To take my money and waste my time? I asked about traditional braces, but I was told that wouldn't correct my midline either.I feel like I was made to sign that paper at the end of the Invisalign treatment, the one that claims "I'm happy with my results." Well, I'm not happy. I haven't been happy with my teeth since ending treatment, and I now have TMJ pain and stiffness from wearing the trays and nothing to show for it. I can't even wear the retainer I was given because it causes me pain.I've since gotten a second opinion from a different orthodontist, and I was told midline correction is possible with braces. I feel like they made me sign that paper to get rid of me as a patient.I give this place two stars because even though I wasted years of time and thousands of dollars, the staff was always nice to me.
