reviews.author: Lydia Hillier
reviews.text: I have been going to Lund Orthodontics for over 15 years now. I have been consistently impressed and appreciative of the wonderful care that both Dr. Lund Sr. and Dr. Paul, his son, have provided. I have bilateral cleft lip and other related issues and they were able to cater my orthodontia care so well to my situation. They were also amazing at helping with the coordination of my care between the consistent surgeries and dentistry I also needed. I am forever grateful for all of their help;  my teeth look amazing. On top of providing such uniquely great care, all the workers, especially Dr. Lund Sr. and Dr. Paul, have been so kind and thoughtful. They always want to know how my life is going and are always excited about my successes. They are like family. I did not realize that going to an orthodontist could end up being a such personal and meaningful experience. I would recommend Lund orthodontics to anyone and everyone who needs an orthodontist!

reviews.author: Susan H
reviews.text: Hi.  I'm a caregiver in a local hospital. I'm also a woman in my early 60's who has never liked the look of my crooked teeth in any of my photos, despite my naturally friendly smile! Due to impacted wisdom teeth when I was younger, my teeth crowded over the years to the point that I gave up flossing (most of the time!) and eventually, had to have a back molar extracted. That was a wake-up call for me. Having seen my elderly mother go through 5 sets of dentures in her lifetime, I finally decided it was time I do something to save my teeth and KEEP them for as long as I can! Several of my co-workers referred me to Dr. Paul Lund. I made an appointment for a consultation. Dr Paul's kind, understanding and professionalism know-how gave me hope and confidence and I decided to begin my Tooth Fairy journey with braces! He gave me an approximate 2 year ball park and I just took one day at a time, always looking forward to my next visit! Everyone, the entire staff, from the front desk to his assistants were all amazing and friendly!  Today, LESS than 2 years later, my braces are off and my teeth are beautiful! I'm extremely happy with the outcome and it's an amazing feeling to be able to smile without feeling self-conscious for the first time in my life! Thank you, Dr. Paul and thanks to your entire team!  Oh...and I almost forgot...I promise to wear my retainer as directed, because it is SO worth it!  Sincerely and gratefully yours,  "Aunt" Sue

reviews.author: Christina Lee
reviews.text: Dr. Lund gave me a smile I never dreamed I could call my own. The shape of my teeth posed a challenge that most professionals said would require expensive veneers to fix. Dr. Lund understood the smile I wanted and thought he could get me there with my natural teeth. He felt like a true partner. reviews.author: Aaron Richey
reviews.text: Not a good fit for our family, or for any family that might struggle getting teens to wear retainers at the level of compliance required. We paid $6k for our daughter’s braces and retainers. If your teen falls behind on wearing a painful retainer for 12 hours a day, they will charge another $500 or more to refit a new pair, and to be honest they were a bit inflexible, and used some shaming and demanding attitude when we faced challenges with 100% compliance. We are now regretting the initial decision to spend this money. I don’t think we knew from the outset (and wasn’t well communicated) how much of an investment it was going to be. I would have appreciated a bit more of a collaborative and flexible policy toward teens that may need a re-fit if they are struggling with the pain and discomfort of wearing retainers. Unfortunately, paying another $500+ is not feasible for us.

reviews.author: Don Klaudt
reviews.text: I returned to NE Seattle Orthodontics recently to have new retainers made, since the pair I had been using since 2015 was cracking. When I called the office I learned that the orthodontist who straightened my teeth with braces years ago had sold the practice to Dr Tori Matthys. I was quoted a price of $500 for a returning patient, and arrived for my appointment.I was directed to a chair and was met by a technician who proceeded to do a 3D scan of my teeth. I was surprised, and a bit disappointed, that my $500 did not include a consult, or even a brief meeting, with Dr Matthys. But I just went with it. The process was completed, and I returned a week later for my retainers.After wearing them for 3 or 4 nights, I began to notice that at one location each on the uppers and lowers, the slight separations that had previously existed were significantly increasing. I could feel these with my tongue as sharp edges which had not previously been there. I discontinued use and called the office to discuss the problem.I returned soon after and described my concern to two different technicians, expressing that new retainers should not exacerbate imperfections. They agreed. Then Dr Matthys finished with a patient and, meeting her at last, I explained to her as well. She gave me a technical description explaining that the 3D scan was an accurate representation of my teeth and, to my dismay, implied that I was perceiving a change that was not happening.She suggested that I wear my old retainers 24 hours a day for three weeks and then return for another scan. She said that will present my “best teeth”. She also gave me the option of a full refund. I chose the former, and wore my old retainers faithfully until I returned several weeks later.I was surprised that wearing the retainers full-time caused some discomfort, indicating that they were aligning my teeth, and thst only overnight use allowed for some movement away from the alignment achieved with braces. I would kindly suggest that patients retuning for new retainers be advised of this, and be urged to wear 24/7 until their appointment for the scan.For my third visit I was directed to a chair with a so-called “specialist” in a separate office. He also did a 3D scan, but he seemed to make more of an effort to dry my teeth (even using paper towels) to ensure the most accurate scan. He then compared his scan to the previous, noting several areas of noticeable improvement he thought were the result of continuously wearing my old retainers.After this, Dr Matthys entered and compared the second scan to the first, saying that she saw virtually no differences, essentially contradicting her specialist. Was she again suggesting I had imagined the gapping? Was she circling the wagons? I don’t know, but I wasn’t impressed.A week later I was fitted with the new retainers and have been wearing them every night for the past 2 1/2 months. They are excellent. I am amazed how tightly they still fit after all this time. Clearly, when done properly, the 3D scan is vastly superior to the old method of creating retainers.Can the difference be attributed entirely to wearing the old retainers continuously prior to scan? Or did the skill and effort of the technician have an impact as well? I don’t know for sure, but I suspect both were factors.Since I now have very well-fitting retainers, this review is three stars rather than what my initial experience justified, which was a one or two star. I am happy, but I had to do some boat-rocking to get there.Additional suggestion for improvement:  The technician for my second fitting removed the new retainers from the mold without gloves, and set them directly on the table beside me. She directed me to put them in, and only then did she put on gloves. Apparently this was because she then handled them after I removed them. Clearly, only her gloved hands should have touched the retainers, at any time, and they should not have been placed directly on the table. Even better, she could have asked me to remove them from the mold.

reviews.author: jered Burton
reviews.text: Dr. Matthys is an incredible orthodontist, as is her specialist team. I was part way through my adult orthodontics in preparation for tooth implant surgery when Dr. M took over the clinic. I was very nervous to have my care switch to an unknown Dr mid process, as I had learned that apparently I have rather odd tooth anatomy. It turns out that I’m actually SO glad that she stepped in. Her skills are incredible, she worked in conjunction with my dentist/periodontist (whom she actually personally knew from UW) to create a perfect set up for the implant surgery. He is insanely precise and particular and told me he was glad to see that I was working with Tori.  Her team has also been so pleasant, I typically work with Jen and she and I are like old friends at this point. Mary took care of all the financials and appointments for me and was also just awesome. I can honestly say I looked foreword to each visit, and that’s saying something when it comes to braces eh?!? Also, I think it’s really great that they use 3D printing tech for all of my retainer needs as opposed to the old fashioned goop and tray method. BLECH! It’s so very convenient and really quick. A+ top shelf service on that for sure.Anyhow, this is a great group of folks in Wedgwood and I strongly recommend them for adult braces. I actually have a couple friends that I had send their kids to see Dr. M as well and we have agreed on how great she is.

reviews.text: They are fabulous as always.Staff is so kind and patient with me and my dental anxities, no matter how many cavity fears I have (that are often wrong) they always check and talk about what theyre seeing vs what Im seeing so I understand what to watch for at home and what may look scary but is really nothing to be worried about.Ive walked in for appointments multiple times to see other clients giving the dental team gifts (cards, pastries, snacks) so if you cant take my word for it, take theirs. reviews.author: Valora Joestar
reviews.text: I know other people have had bad experiences but please hear me out before you judge them based on those reviews.I came here for a last second root canal, my prior dentist office didn’t have anyone in house who could. They got me in for a referral appointment very quick, and I was able to get a root canal within only a couple weeks after that. The day of the procedure, they were removing my temporary crown (which my prior dentist was supposed to only temporarily adhere the crown) so they didn’t have to drill through it, but it turns out my prior dentist accidentally permanently adhered it. They tried everything they could to remove it so it didn’t have to be drilled through, and they even asked me first before proceeding with drilling to make sure I was informed and had the choice. They also made sure to document EVERYTHING thoroughly about the situation with the crown and even contacted my prior dentist about it. Because of that I won’t have to be charged by my old dentist for a new crown since there’s documentation. They were also very understanding and comforting that I was stressed about the procedure, considering I metabolize anesthetics VERY quickly. They made sure I was taken care of the entire time, which helped a lot. I often get anxiety attacks with these types of procedures and they were very kind and comforting. One of the gals even gave me a type of squishy stress ball to help me as I worked on calming down.I’ve had no issues with the billing process, and they’ve been very communicative. They explained all charges well with an itemized bill. I can honestly say they are definitely worth going to, as someone who is very scared of dentists. Not to mention their office is one block from the D line bus station so it’s very easy to get to.

reviews.author: Audrey Elizabeth
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with the handling of my orthodontic treatment. I was originally prescribed Invisalign Lite, which was expected to take about a year to correct my bite. About six months into treatment, my original orthodontist left the practice. My new orthodontist informed me that I should never have been placed on the Lite plan in the first place.By the end of the treatment, my bite was actually worse than when I started. None of my back teeth were making contact, extra bonding was left on my teeth, and some of my enamel was filed off. I was then told I would need to pay out of pocket for additional treatment to correct the issues caused during my original plan. Since the decision to place me on Invisalign Lite was not mine, I asked the office to work with Invisalign to resolve the situation. Invisalign agreed to cover the remainder of my treatment, but the orthodontic care coordinator has repeatedly refused to provide that agreement in writing.Now, despite my concerns that my bite still does not make proper contact, my orthodontist has stated that my treatment is complete. I was told my teeth/bite would continue to settle after treatment, but I was given no guarantee that they would fix it if my bite didn’t settle. I requested a comprehensive T-Scan evaluation to properly assess my bite, but my request has been ignored. For months, my calls, voicemails, and emails have gone unanswered.It’s incredibly frustrating because it feels like the office is more focused on ending my treatment than actually resolving the bite issues that remain. The staff has always been kind and pleasant to interact with, which makes the lack of accountability and communication even more confusing and disappointing. At this point, I simply want proper follow-through and a genuine effort to correct the problems caused during my treatment.Edit: I have called and left voicemails. No one has called me back.

reviews.author: Sean Dimsey
reviews.text: I have been thinking long and hard about whether to send this review. I think it needs to be said. I have NEVER had a doctor/dentist try so hard to be be right about something to the point that he kept pushing a treatment that was not needed AT THIS TIME, and that even the specialist said that I did not need at this time BUT I COULD IN THE FUTURE. Dr. Sessions bedside manner is aggressive and uncalled for. He needs to learn to listen to the patient. I don't care if he went to medical school and thinks he knows my teeth and pain or lack thereof better than me. I originally came in to have a crown placed. Dr. Sessions said that he thought that I might need to have a root canal and suggested I came back when the orthodontist/specialist could look at me. He specifically said that "the appointment would be long enough so that if I did need a root canal that we could do that and then immediately transition into the crown work so as not to make me come back a third time, and that if I did not need it we could just go ahead with the crown". I came back a week later and saw the specialist. The specialist said that given that I was not feeling pain and not reacting to her cold tests that I DID NOT need one now but I could in the near future. I agreed and said that if I needed it in the near future I would get it then. Next I waited forever for Dr. Sessions only to be met with his disbelief that I did not need a root canal. He was just trying to pass me off because of my sever gag reaction. He went out of his way to test me again with cold spray for a long time because he just would not accept that I was ok and could not feel the cold and currently did not need a root canal. And even after that he still kept trying to push me to pass me off to someone else. I finally had to remind him in a serious tone that I was here to get a crown as promised if I did not need a root canal (and even if I did) and that I was not leaving without a crown as promised.  He even (during the prep process) tried his hardest to get me to react to his drilling by going extra deep to try to get me to react. I am going to look into Dr. Sessions past and past places of employment. Dr. Sessions needs to learn to listen to and believe his patients. I am glad I took time before writing this otherwise it would have been full of expletives and foul language as that is how angry he had me. Dr. Sessions, I'm not going anywhere and you will look me in my eyes the next time I show up.

reviews.author: Kevin Simeon
reviews.text: BEWARE — this place is a total scam.I’ve never experienced a more predatory dental practice in my life. They pile on hidden fees, try to upsell unnecessary procedures, and pressure you into things you don’t need. They even tried to remove my permanent retainer after I explicitly told them not to!I had braces six years ago — yet they tried to convince me I needed them again. The front desk staff are clueless, and their customer service is nonexistent. Weeks after my appointment, I got a surprise bill in the mail. I called for clarification and was told I’d get a call back the next day — no one ever called.If I can save even one person from going through this nightmare, it’s worth writing this. Stay far, far away. Don’t fall for it.

reviews.text: I had my dental cleaning covered in full by my insurance for a few times at Gentle Dental since 2023. My dental insurance was changed in 2024 and I updated the new insurance info to Gentle Dental right after my cleaning session 7 months ago. However, my insurance info has been sitting in the email without anybody of their team ever looked into it. In the past 7 months, I have been constantly receiving the whole dental bill that they sent out… I kept calling them and went in person multiple time asking to fix it. They always say they would check and give me updates. However, no action has been taken. I was very mad and upset about their billing team, who couldn’t even take care of the basic work.Finally, few weeks ago, after going to the clinic in person again, someone helped and updated my insurance info within one minute. However, the insurance denied to pay since it has been too long after the service. The clinic had to “adjusted” my bill, which is still a couple hundred dollars on me.Please know that running a business is not just the work of the providers and marketing team. With their back up systems being this bad and unorganized, I would never want to be a patient of this company.

reviews.author: Tatyana Smith
reviews.text: Very unimpressed with the attitude of the other woman on front desk. Katie or Kate is usually super sweet and always helpful and finds some kind of resolution or answer for me. reviews.author: Umair
reviews.text: ⭐☆☆☆☆ (0 stars if I could)Gentle Dental Ballard is a predatory and disorganized company. I had a cleaning just 6 months ago, and they pushed over $17,000 worth of “recommended” services — yet never performed a single actual treatment. They ignored my calls for over 3 weeks, gave no follow-up, no care, nothing. Just pressure and silence. It's absolutely unethical. Stay far away.

reviews.author: Paul Vose Mr
reviews.text: The dental service itself was okay, however, their billing department is terrible. After my one and only visit they billed me instead of my insurance. I was able to get a hold of them to let me them know that they needed to bill my insurance, and not me. They eventually were able to successfully bill my insurance. However, they continued to send me bills for the full amount of the visit.This was more than frustrating. They let me know to ignore the bills, but they continued to send them with language that highlighted an increasing sense of urgency (30 days past due, 60 days past due etc). Furthermore, they are also hard to get a hold of. Trying to connect with them to get them to stop sending me these bills has been more than a chore.Unfortunately, after reading through these reviews, these problems were experienced by more than just me. I’ve opened a complaint with my insurance company with the hopes this pushes them to correct their poor service which borders on negligence at best. I encourage others who experience this to do the same. Please do not visit this practice, there are plenty of other dentists in Ballard and Seattle who are able to properly bill patients.

reviews.author: Moon Baillie
reviews.text: These folks kept cancelling appointments for lack of staff, then charge me extra for cleaning visits because "they had to do extra work because I waited too long" Their billing service is sketchy, and not very clear. When on the phone they offered a reason for the bill I owed "maybe your insurance sold you a plan for people under 18; they're known for doing that" More murky reasoning.  Don't work with these people.

reviews.author: Matt Perrone
reviews.text: Gentle Dental is a dentist office chain that has services such as dentistry and orthodontics. This location is in Ballard on 15th, right next to Taco Bell. Parking here can be a pain, with only a handful of spots in front and constant cars coming in and out of Taco Bell. Inside they have a waiting room before you go in to see the dentist, and wait times are hit or miss here - I've waited close to a half hour sometimes after my appointment time, but sometimes it's a minute or two. The dental professionals are really nice and good at what they do, quick and informative with fun personalities. The front desk, however, is mostly the complete opposite. I've met two of them that are really bad at their job, have no personality, are rude and condescending, complete know it all's, and are always right no matter the situation. Pricing here is ok, especially if you have insurance, but be warned that they are known for improper and inaccurate billing. Don't just pay a bill you get from them because it could just be them fishing for extra money because of a mistake they made. Overall if they fixed the office attitude, answered the phone, got back to you when they said they would, and we're more organized in their paperwork, this could be a 4 star dentist.But, it's not. They tried to bill me for over 2 and a half years for something I paid for. I showed them receipts and charges on my bank account 9 total times. Their receptionist team kept saying they will take care of it, but each month I'd get a letter in the mail and an email saying I owed money. Every office visit was the same answer, we will take care of it. After calling their head office multiple times, only to get their voicemail each of the 6 times I tried, I got an office manager who finally looked into it and said they never billed my insurance and we're trying to bill me instead. They removed the charge after 2 and a half years. That's wild. The home office never got back to me either, 6 voicemails total.The worst part was how rude some of the receptionists were, telling me flat out that I'm wrong and I need to pay the bill or else. Being short with me, cutting me off mid sentence because they think they know it all and are right, then responding in a condescending way like I need help understanding how being billed for a service works. When you try to explain it to these receptionists, it's just an uphill battle the whole time.I'd just avoid this place all together if you're looking for a new dentist, it's not worth the headache, and you'll probably have some sort of problem at some point so it's best to just find a different one.And before they respond with the generic message - no, I don't want to contact you at a phone number that you won't answer and won't call me back. I've already been through this and your team hasn't even returned a call so don't waste your breath.

reviews.author: Tracy Pham
reviews.text: I have had such a terrible experience with this dental office and I would never wish the headache that I experienced there on others. I am warning others to not give this dental office your business or time.My first appointment went fine, though not great. My real issues began after the appointment.They were not able to bill my insurance properly for that first appointment. I contacted my insurance and they were able to cover all of my fees in April of 2025. However, I kept getting sent bills up until June 5th 2025.I called the office a total of THIRTEEN TIMES and left FOUR VOICEMAILS in order to get this billing situation sorted, as I was worried this would be sent to collections. Two weeks later, they still had not gotten back to me. There has not been a single time that they have answered the phone. The only time I've gotten a real person is when I pressed "1" saying that I was a new patient instead of pressing "2" for returning patient.I have also called the central office and they have left two emails and a voicemail on my behalf, saying that the Ballard office would get back to me on a specific day, which was a Monday. They never got back to me.Eventually, I just decided to come in person and talk to the receptionist directly, and the situation is still yet to be sorted.When I came in person on a Friday, I also asked to cancel my appointment for the following Tuesday. The receptionist said that she canceled my appointment for me, but I got another appointment reminder on Sunday.Because so many of their systems are automated, I cannot tell if this is a fluke in their system or not, but I will not be accepting or paying any no-show fees.The dismissive service of Gentle Dental is completely unacceptable and very frustrating. The fact that you can only get a real person when you are a first-time patient is indicative that they are trying to lure in new patients, but will not provide much care to the existing ones. Based on other reviews, this is not an uncommon experience.The dentistry work is nowhere near skilled enough to justify this level of incompetence and carelessness on the part of the billing/accounting/scheduling, or pretty much every other aspect of this business.A comment under bad reviews telling  people to call such and such number does not indicate any level of care either, given that when I and other customers have tried to call, we are only directed to voicemail.No matter who you are or where you come from, everyone deserves better care than this. Please do not accept this unethical, disorganized, sorry excuse for a dentist as a care provider.EDIT: Just so everyone knows, Gentle Dental has left this phone number for me to call and I have yet again, only gotten their voicemail after calling twice during business hours. I'm pretty positive that this was an automated response and it does not at all seem like they actually care about mending things.

reviews.author: Michael Gerton

reviews.author: Oleksii Motorykin
reviews.text: Warning for everybody: DO NOT DO DEEP CLEANING! Today I came for a regular cleaning, same as what I do twice a year for the previous 15 years. I was notified that, because I had a deep cleaning procedure before, they cannot do the regular cleaning, and, from now on, it will have to be periodontal maintenance (which, of course, cost extra).I argued my case and even had the hygienist look at my teeth and state that everything look normal and we can do the regular prophylaxis cleaning. He went and ask if we can change from periodontal maintenance to regular prophylaxis. Came back, said it's all good. Only to have a doctor come and tell me that they legally cannot do it.First, I absolutely doubt there is a legal reason to deny treatment. Because Second, I just go to another clinic, and they will do the cleaning. What if I denied deep cleaning before? Would right now I be able to do regular cleaning? Answer is yes.This feels like money money money. They will tell, state, persuade, do whatever necessary to do a treatment. Nobody told me, at the time of deep cleaning, that it will require additional expenses for an extended duration. No official diagnosis was delivered. They just said: you need a deep cleaning.So, this is a warning to all, unless you are prepared to pay extra for all regular cleanings, do not fall for a deep cleaning charade.

reviews.author: Eric Alayoubi
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars, I would. Last week, I visited this dentist for what should have been a routine procedure: a crown installation and two cavity fillings. Instead, I endured the most unprofessional, careless, and unsettling dental experience of my life.From the moment I sat in the chair, I was subjected to erratic, rough work that left me choking and gagging. Throughout the procedure, the dentist and her assistant carried on a casual conversation about how full they were from their office potluck—while their tools were inside my mouth. This lack of focus and professionalism was disturbing.Things went from bad to worse. After placing the temporary crown, the assistant didn’t return promptly, so the dentist began filling my cavities without any assistance. After finishing one, the assistant returned just in time to remind the dentist that she hadn’t administered Novocain before starting the second. Her response? A casual laugh and a flippant “Oh yeah, haha.” I was stunned.When I got home, I realized a chunk of my tooth was now missing, leaving behind a jagged, painful edge. The crown also had sharp ridges all around it, clearly unfinished. I scheduled a follow-up for the soonest available date, which was a week later.At the follow-up, the dentist accepted zero responsibility. She claimed the damaged area was “just how my tooth is” and couldn’t explain why this wasn’t mentioned during the original procedure. When I pointed out the new, larger hole in my tooth that now traps food, her response was: “That’s just how it’s going to be.” No solution. No accountability.When I asked why there were sharp edges in this newly formed hole, she denied they existed—despite me literally feeling them with my tongue. It became clear that continuing the conversation was pointless; I had lost all trust in her judgment and skill. I told her I would seek a second opinion and requested only that she smooth out the crown.She agreed—but then inexplicably began drilling into the very same area she claimed was perfectly fine two minutes earlier. I stopped her immediately, reiterating that I no longer wanted her working on the affected tooth. At that point, she insulted my dental hygiene, told me I “needed to brush better,” and left the room.This level of negligence and unprofessionalism is completely unacceptable. I will never return and strongly urge others to think twice before trusting this office with their dental health. I am now pursuing corrective treatment from a qualified professional who, at minimum, understands the importance of patient care and accountability.

reviews.author: Dannie Moore

reviews.author: Veloria Zhu
reviews.text: I had a frustrating experience with Gentle Dental regarding a fluoride treatment charge. I was not informed in advance that the fluoride would cost extra, and only after the procedure did the front desk mention a $36 charge. I asked to speak to a manager, but was repeatedly told he was “busy.”I understand that mistakes happen, but poor communication and dismissive customer service make for a terrible patient experience. Transparency in pricing and respectful communication should be a priority. I wouldn’t recommend this location unless you confirm all costs upfront and are prepared for potential billing headaches.update 04/02/2024: it has been almost a year and I am still getting the bill. The manager called me and left me a message  that it will be cleared but I still got a bill that stated that I will be sent to collections. I did not receive instructions on how to even pay the bill.

reviews.author: Lauren Webb
reviews.text: Went here for a few years and it started off just fine, then a few not so great encounters changed my mind. I would not recommend!1. The dentist told me it’d be fine to do an x-ray when pregnant, but then I made eye contact with the dental assistant and she shook her head no. Whether you should or shouldn’t do the x-ray when pregnant, the misalignment was concerning.2. I was booked for three cleanings in one year (insurance only covers two), the third appointment happened to be a few days before the start of the new year. I take full responsibility I should have caught this, but also have always put trust into my past dentists offices to inform me if I was going to be doing something extra that would end up charging me north of $200 for. It took me about three weeks to finally get ahold of a manager (calling multiple times a week) where they luckily took care of the “accidental” third appointment booking but to get to the point of an actual productive conversation was painful.3. After this ordeal, I switched dentist offices and when I called to get my x-rays emailed to me, their email system was down (second time this has happened to me) so I had to call back again a few days later and was able to retrieve them.Overall, my experience with Gentle Dental has been a headache. From my experience with receptionists (particularly one), to my ability to get ahold of management, to their baseline email system being down multiple times, to scheduling, the list goes on. Poorly managed business.

reviews.author: k thomas
reviews.text: Everyone at Gentle Dental Ballard is amazing! From the front desk all the way across the board everybody takes great care of me! I have massive Dental phobia, or I did, because actually Gentle Dental is greatly reducing that visit by visit. You used to have to knock me out with a tack Hammer to get me to the dentist and yesterday I did a fairly big procedure with only nitrous . They are amazing and they are the reason that I'm able to move through my childhood trauma with Dentistry and take good care of my teeth. They don't overwhelm me or make me feel guilty. They just take good care of me and want me to be relaxed and have a good experience which has been the case every single time I've gone. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Baicai Xiao
reviews.text: Subject: Complaint About Potential Fraud at Gentle Dental BallardDear Gentle Dental Leadership,I am writing to express my deep frustration and disappointment regarding the unethical practices and potential fraud I have experienced during my orthodontic treatment at Gentle Dental Ballard. Below are the details of my case and my demands for resolution:Case Details1. Signing the Contract and Beginning Treatment* In October 2024, I made a $1000 down payment to Gentle Dental Ballard and signed an 18-month orthodontic treatment contract under the care of Dr. A.* After waiting over a month for my aligners, I received three aligners on November 26 and started wearing them. I also scheduled an appointment for January 7, 2025 to pick up the remaining aligners.2. Doctor Replacement Without Notification* In mid-December 2024, I received a voicemail from the clinic stating that Dr. A would be “unavailable” on January 7, and I needed to reschedule. I immediately called back, but the staff member who answered (not the person who left the voicemail) assured me that my appointment did not need to be canceled.* However, when I arrived at the clinic on January 7, 2025, I was told that Dr. A was unavailable, and I needed to reschedule. The staff claimed they had already informed me, but when I explained that I had called back to confirm, they casually said, “Oh, the other person must have made a mistake.”* It was only at this point that I learned Dr. A had permanently left Gentle Dental Ballard. The clinic never informed me of this significant change and had unilaterally assigned me to a new doctor.Key Issues and Concerns1. Withholding Information About Dr. A's Departure* I suspect that Gentle Dental Ballard deliberately withheld information about Dr. A's departure to delay treatment and maximize charges.* From October 2024 to January 2025, I paid over $1200 out of pocket, and my insurance provider paid over $1000, yet only three aligners (out of an estimated 70+) were delivered. This behavior severely violated my right to be informed and disrupted my treatment plan.2. Unreasonable Transfer-Out Fees* I chose Gentle Dental Ballard specifically because of Dr. A's expertise, not the clinic itself. Given her departure, I decided to transfer my case elsewhere, only to be told that I must pay $1265 in transfer-out fees because the contract was with the clinic, not the doctor.* As of now, I have paid a $1000 down payment, over $200 in monthly payments. Adding the $1265 transfer fee, the clinic has charged over $2500 for just three aligners. And my insurance provider has paid over $1000.  This is an unreasonable and exploitative practice considering my total treatment cost is $6795 (including a $2000 insurance reimbursement).My StanceAs a loyal patient of Gentle Dental Ballard since 2020, this experience has completely eroded my trust. I will not return to Gentle Dental Ballard.I urge leadership to take my case seriously and address these issues promptly to ensure patients are treated with respect and transparency.

reviews.author: Hannah Schneider
reviews.text: I went to gentle dental for the first time recently and as someone who is afraid of going to the dentist i am incredibly impressed. Everyone i met was so sweet and kind and incredibly efficient! Absolutely would recommend.

reviews.author: P Terry
reviews.text: This has been my dentist office since moving to Seattle 4 years ago. I always have a great experience. Everyone is personable and professional and the office visits well managed. They make recommendations without selling. The staff may occasionally change but they are consistently great. I highly recommend the Ballard location to family and friends.

reviews.author: Julia Atkins
reviews.text: The insurance they had on file was outdated, so I was billed for things I shouldn’t have been billed for. I called and updated my insurance and asked them to open the claim with my updated insurance. Had to call back 3 times and ask for this and they STILL haven’t refiled the claim. I called my insurance and asked if they cover the outstanding charges (basic things like x-rays), to which they said they 100% cover those things and have not heard from the dental office at all regarding the new claim. I am cancelling my future appointments. It should not take 4+ calls to a dentist office to reopen a claim with insurance. If you look in previous reviews I am not the only person who’s experienced their suspicious billing practices.

reviews.text: This was my first time seeing gentle dental. Very nice front desk staff. She did not request pay copay first. However Bright now dental Seattle every visit asked copay first otherwise didn’t let me go inside. They cheated me 6 years. I paid them extra money 6 years. Also dentist said I should get another crown on my right up tooth and don’t care my right jaw hurts. In Gentle Dental Ballard, staff are nice and friendly. They explained to me very well. Dentist Jung is very friendly. Dentist Jung checked and said right now not needed crown. I told them I had right jaw hurts. They checked me thoroughly and suggested mouth guard. They explained very clearly and told me about copayment. I am happy they told me about paying. I am a health care worker. I recommend Gentle Dental Ballard.

Their more recent dental assistants have all been really stellar and kind. Their front desk staff are also friendly and very communicative about your insurance and billing. If you are looking for a dentist in Ballard, give them a call!

reviews.author: Linda Venczel

reviews.author: David Cataño
reviews.text: I am so happy to find this place, I had a broken tooth and they helped me fix it the same day before my wedding looking better than ever 😀🦷💯

reviews.author: Katy Cañete
reviews.text: I have had a good experience with Gentle Dental and their providers for my son and I, the front desk staff was incredibly welcoming and the staff I met during our services were all lovely and helpful.Unfortunately my experience with their billing has been different. I have been getting huge bills for nine months without explanation of what they are for or why they weren't paid for by my insurance.I called three times and have spoken at length over the phone with someone in billing without any clarification. They sounded confused themselves and not interested in helping me understand the actual charges. Twice they promised to look into it and get back to me but did not. All the while I am still getting bills in the mail without any details.My insurance clarified for me that the claims were not processed on their end within the timely billing window so were all denied.I have hope that they can resolve this issue and hopefully won't continue to charge me for the claims that were denied for their error but I feel disappointed and frustrated by their customer service on the billing end.They can do a much better job of being clear in their invoices, not acting bothered by a patient who is confused over the phone about their balance and to understand or show some empathy that it is stressful to repeatedly be getting unclear invoices that you're not supposed to.Frustrating and time consuming!

reviews.author: shelby weitzel
reviews.text: My son and I have gone to Gentle Dental Ballard for a few years now. Without exception, the receptionists, hygienists and dentists have been friendly and responsive. They make their crowns on site, so I am able to go into the weekend as good as new. I greatly appreciate the quality of services provided.

reviews.author: Tamara Romman
reviews.text: Do not go here. I made an appointment and asked that they let me know how much the charge would be with insurance. They said they would call me back before my appt to let me know cost. The day of the appt they still had not informed me of cost so I called to follow up. Turns out they never made the appt and told me they're closing early and can't see me. I was so confused. All of a sudden I have no appointment and they're closing? Very frustrating as I took time off work, arranged for childcare, etc. for this commitment. Reception has a very difficult time with basic scheduling. Several phone calls back and forth and didn't schedule my appointment. Definitely would not recommend.

reviews.author: Kina
reviews.text: I was a bit hesitant to do a franchise type, but i was wrong, luckily. The ballard location is FABULOUS, clean location, super friendly staff. I am so so glad i chose gentle dental in ballard. The staff are understanding and patient, fan-fricking-tastic with my kids

reviews.author: Morgan Nissen
reviews.text: Every single person was so kind! I get very nervous going to the dentist and today was my first visit at this location. I had nothing to worry about! Gentle indeed. They listened, explained, and were so nice and positive. I can’t recommend the team here enough. I am actually looking forward to coming back in 6 months. Thank you all. Thank you so so much!

reviews.author: Susan Feigenbaum
reviews.text: You get what you pay for. This is some of the cheapest dentistry out there, but the dentists/orthodontists are not great and so over booked that they're constantly letting things slip.I've had a bunch of things go wrong in my Invisalign treatment and routine fillings

reviews.author: India Miller
reviews.text: Everyone there is so nice! They were so receptive and understanding of both my pain and my finances while trying to help me navigate insurance. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Murphy
reviews.text: High quality, professional and exceptional service and care. The staff was friendly, informative and worked well together. The dental work was excellent. So happy and relieved to have quality dental care. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Reid Cook
reviews.text: They did such a nice job on my two fillings and periodontal deep cleans. Looking forward to seeing them again.

reviews.author: Conrad Pendergast
reviews.text: Helped me repair a chipped tooth on the same day. Fast, professional service.

reviews.author: Erik Usher
reviews.text: Sung my dentist is great and Jordan at the front desk is always making scheduling work for me. They’re  a great team.

reviews.author: Lukas Bellisomi
reviews.text: Dr Buddula is a wonderful Periodontist and has done two gum grafts for me. Very friendly and performs professionally. Didnt feel any pain whatsoever. Post procedure day no pain as well.Thank you!

reviews.author: Susan Larsen
reviews.text: True to name. Always pleasant, patient,  gentle, and reasonably priced. Appreciate that they always have a positive attitude and see me on time.

reviews.author: Annik Johnson
reviews.text: I would never get dental care here. This business does not keep their property clean - trash is constantly overflowing all over the parking lot. I’ve seen rats running through the area. These pictures are by the front entrance. It’s disgusting!

reviews.author: Natalie Park
reviews.text: I am posting this here hoping that this will provoke some sort of action from management.I had a teeth cleaning done in December of 2022. To this day, January of 2024, they still have not billed my insurance and I continue to get bills. I had more appointments in the spring of 2023 that finally just got billed within the past month or so. I still am receiving bills in the mail for $300 because they continue to not bill my insurance. I have called and spoken to the manager MULTIPLE times, I have even gone in person twice! I wrote out exactly what insurance to bill for each visit (insurance changed from 2022 to 2023) with my member ID numbers, which insurance it is, how to send the claims to them, and the insurance’s number. The manager glanced at it and handed it back to me and said “we have all this information already, I don’t need this.” But then months and months of back and forth, every time I call them they say they dont have my insurance info from that 2022 visit. I’m at my wits end, we are now at over a year later receiving this bill every single month and me having to call the insurance asking if you all have sent a claim in and every month they say no. I have been more patient than I should have been, please fix it and bill my insurance!!!!! I had to seek care elsewhere because of how incredibly frustrating this has been. This is my last attempt to settle this bill, from now on they are going straight in the trash and I’m not going to even bother calling every single month I receive this ridiculous bill.

reviews.author: Casey Hutchinson
reviews.text: Showed up at my appointment today that I’ve had scheduled for 6 months (confirmed via 3 emails/texts this week) and the office door was locked, office was dark, no one answered the phone… huge waste of time.

reviews.author: Vicky Min
reviews.text: Posting for a friendSuper unprofessional: rarely picks up the phone and when asked to send info over, they said they would 3x (3 different people!) and never didDuring a cleaning, they cut my lip and it was bleeding a lot. Never apologized for this. 0/10 would not recommend.

reviews.author: McKenzie Lee
reviews.text: Such a great experience at this dental practice! Front desk is very kind, nice, friendly, and helpful! (shoutout Jordan) All within an hour appointment I got x-rays, an exam, AND a teeth cleaning! Very quick & efficient  I would recommend this dental practice for anyone looking for friendly & quality care. They made me feel comfortable and did not shame me for my dental hygiene which is not the case at other practices. Very transparent. Looking forward to continuing my dental care here

reviews.author: Lexie Walthall
reviews.text: I rarely leave reviews but I wish the reviews here had been more representative of the care at this clinic before I booked an appointment. Hopefully this can dissuade others from receiving subpar care.I have pretty healthy teeth and gums, and throughout the appointment, I was in pain. Later that day, my mouth was achy and sore.  I've never experienced pain at the dentist before with routine exams and cleaning. It did not feel gentle, and it felt like I was rushed through my apt. When the assistant was flossing my teeth, she didn't work it back and forth past my teeth, she shoved it through, and didn't even floss on both sides of the gums. Speaking of gums, my dentist suggested that I have a piece of my gums cut out because it's a little bulky (no signs of infection/irritation present though), which felt like a ploy to overtreat. The shaded glasses I was provided had big smears on them and were dirty. The dentist provided my cleaning, and if we are all honest, we know they don't have very much time to provide a thorough cleaning like hygienists do. There were open suitcases on the floor filled with supplies. I work in acute medicine and understand how healthcare can be busy and stressful, but the care here was extremely lacking and unprofessional. I'm going to go elsewhere for my dental needs.

reviews.author: Heyzeus
reviews.text: Very wonderful people, super helpful and willing to share information. I really appreciated it when i came in spooked with a cracked tooth. I plan on staying with them for a long time because of service

reviews.author: Rhea Patton
reviews.text: Very pleased with all of the dental services my family has had done at the Ballard Gentle Dental. They've been attentive and kind with the million questions that I ask! The convenient location can't be beat if you are in Ballard and the front desk (Jordan!) is the best :)

reviews.author: Abdullah Bashmail
reviews.text: Extremely disorganized scheduling system. I was scheduled for a general checkup as a first time patient only for me to show up with no dentist on site. Never coming here again. Thanks for wasting my time.

reviews.author: Doris
reviews.text: Name is kind of ironic because I went in for a routine cleaning (can’t be more basic of a service) and had my tooth chipped off. Unsurprising since my mouth was flooded with blood during the cleaning and later got an infection from the cuts.Didn’t end there. They charged my insurance and then thought it was appropriate to mail me a $300+ bill.I had an East Asian male dentist, wouldn’t assume for all other dentists, but Visit at your own risk.

reviews.author: Buddy Bobadilla
reviews.text: Dr. Jung really cares about his patients and staffs. Getting a crown done today, always making sure that I'm comfortable, thanking his assistant is the process. HIGHLY RECOMMEND him to all my friends and family.. Thanks Dr Jung..

reviews.author: L T
reviews.text: Nice place to come for dental care

reviews.author: Janelle Germain
reviews.text: I've been a satisfied patient at the Ballard Gentle Dental for many years, but after my last visit, I'm looking for a new dentist. Dr. Payne and most (maybe all?) of the old staff have left. The current dentist performed a very quick and painful cleaning on my teeth, and didn't notice when I flinched in pain a couple times as he was cleaning with the high pressure water. He didn't use a pick and look carefully to see if everything looked ok and felt solid, so I'm not confident that I don't have any problems. Just a bummer of a visit to a dental office that I used to love.

reviews.author: C K
reviews.text: Weirdest dentist experience I’ve ever had. At the initial appointment, which I scheduled as a cleaning, they took x-rays, the dentist came in for a second and looked at my teeth and told me I needed a $400 night guard, and the person I thought was the hygienist said the cleaning hygienist was out sick so I needed to schedule another time for my cleaning?? When I went back for my actual cleaning, it was minimal but fine, but they mostly seemed focused on getting me fitted for the night guard. Then, when I came to pick it up, which I was told would be a quick appointment, I sat in the waiting room for 20 minutes after my scheduled appointment time. I told the desk clerk that I needed to leave soon, which is when they took me back and gave me the thing told me the dentist was coming to check the fit. The dentist never came to check fit, the hygienist told me “I guess you can just leave if it feels fine”Overall, this place feels super unprofessional and almost even scammy (3+ appointments just to get a routine cleaning, and a new, super expensive accessory pushed the entire time). I would recommend you take your dental care elsewhere.

reviews.author: Quyen Lubi
reviews.text: This Dental clinic overcharged us over $3k for an implant. Our insurance paid the fee but they never refunded us the money for over a year now! We called them every week and they always say they’ll look into it but they never do anything about the money! We are stuck and cannot do anything else! Please be super aware!

reviews.author: Alex McCann
reviews.text: The staff are very friendly and it costs less than the private practice I used to go to!

reviews.author: Annette Sherr Cabunoc
reviews.text: Was very happy that my insurance was accepted & they work with you on payments too,all very professional and very well informative and very much friendly and fast at thier work,Thank You Very Much Aprecieated All of Your Work.

reviews.author: Nicole KL
reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment here because it came up in Tricare's search engine as a covered dentist. On the day of my appointment,  they call me to confirm insurance verification before I arrive. I tell her it's Tricare and the only info she should need is my benefits number. She insists I need to provide more info and to call back when I have the needed info. She calls back 2 hours before my appointment and leaves a message saying if they have to figure out this info upon my arrival, it will push my appointment time by an hour. And if I don't have the info needed, they would reschedule me. So I call her on the drive (I had to drive 1.5 hours to get there, plus a 20 minute window to do new patient paperwork) and she still stands firm that I need to provide a phone number to Tricare. It's then revealed that even if I arrive early, I will not be seen until an hour after my scheduled time because "they block out 2 hours for new patients to include paperwork". This was the first I was told about that. It was pretty obvious that they overbooked or were understaffed, but the delay was made to seem normal. My childcare was only available for the 1 hour appointment. Such a headache! Such incompetence! Tricare was called after this call and confirmed all I should need to provide is my benefits number.

reviews.author: Jess Foxx Quinn
reviews.text: Worst place I ever went for dental. Doctor was a total whack job. Siad he would like to rip all my teeth out and give me new teeth all in ONE visit. The follow up visit the receptionist gave me the wrong date and time and when I came in she made it sound like it was all MY fault. I stormed out. Days later I got a letter asking me not to come back because of my behavior. Talking to others, I am hardly the first person to be treated poorly. The place is just a high tech corporation housing a bunch of nuts in lab coats. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

reviews.author: Pari Barekatain
reviews.text: their are exceptionally expensive. They told me I need few crowns and charged me lots of money. I changed my dentist, and new dentist basically told me I do not need any crowns, and I require few fillings and cost other of thousands dollar less.

reviews.author: PikaTira
reviews.text: I was not planning on writing a review until I received an unreasonable bill today. The dentist and front desk are friendly, but I will not recommend this place based on their overall proficiency.The nurse always got my name wrong, and always talked to me like she is the dentist. I, personally, had a difficult time understanding the nurse when she was trying to explain me my situation.I had 2 teeth crowned here. I returned twice to fix the crown because one of the tooth's shape is so off and the other tooth became very sensitive that I can barely eat with that side of the mouth.They try to schedule me another appointment for teeth cleaning, but due to the fact that the tooth are still bothering me after the 2 appointments. I probably won’t come back to them again.

reviews.author: Yoko Rion
reviews.text: I've been a patient in Gental Dental Ballard a little bit over a half year and I just love coming here every time! Everyone is very kind, nice, and most importantly very experienced in what they are doing 👍 ❤

reviews.author: David Pearce
reviews.text: I had a crown on one of my front teeth that broke on a Wednesday night. I looked on my insurance webpage and Gentle Dental was not only on my plan, but 4 blocks from my house. I called Thursday morning. They got me on Friday at 1:30. From Britt at the front desk, to the dental assistants and Dr. Payne, I was totally impressed at the level of quality in every interaction. Dr. Payne was able to create a new crown with an excellent color and have it on the same day. I left with my tooth repaired and a smile on my face. Gentle Dental took my insurance and I paid the copay. All done in one day.If you are looking for a dentist and are in the Ballard area, trust me, you will be completely satisfied and happy! Thank you Gentle Dental team.Dave

reviews.author: Vong Ly
reviews.text: I first came here because I had an old crown that needed to be re-cemented. They told me the crown could last for a while and I'd just have to wait and see. which I told them I'd like to do. It had been a while since I've been to a dentist, so I had a lot of follow up work to be done, including another crown buildup. After a few appointments, they were supposed to work on that other crown buildup, but operated on my existing crown, which I didn't realize until my current crown had been drilled through.Communication is extremely poor among the staff and doctor. If you need to go here, make sure you know exactly what they are intending for each appointment.

reviews.author: Daryl McDonald
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Gentle Dental in Ballard. Dr Payne and all the staff there were great!

reviews.author: Nga Tran
reviews.text: I was here for the cleaning, Exam, and Filling. Everything was amazing. The team here works wonderfully together. I love hearing everyone's happy laughs while working together. It makes me feel comfortable whenever I been here. Dr.Payne is very professional, patient, and careful. I’m pleased to know this office and will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Mdug
reviews.text: I am a long-term client. I was in for a cleaning and my yearly X-rays.  Expected costs are discussed and signed off on up front but there was a change after the appointment(this rarely happens). The receptionist and I went over the services & costs actually completed. I declined one service and an examination by the Doctor was an extra cost.  I was satisfied with the explanation. The practice recently moved and the new location is great! Spacious and bright.

reviews.author: Harper Zimmer
reviews.text: I have been coming here for 6 months now, and I have received excellent care. I have had to have extensive dental work and the team has gone above and beyond to make me as comfortable as possible. A wonderful experience! I have a lot of anxiety surrounding the dentist and this group is amazing.

reviews.author: Christina Joshua
reviews.text: I haven't been to a dentist in years and am finally able to get the major work done I need. Very informative and helped me get a plan set to get all my issues solved. 1st root canal ever and all went well. Definitely not a fun procedure but it wasn't as painful or bad as people have told me they can be. Temporary crown placed just fine and even had some good laughs with the staff. One can see the staff like their jobs and enjoy working together and that can make a huge difference in a patients experience. 1st time I've not dreaded going to the dentist. Thanks for everything and see you soon for more work.

reviews.author: Soren Ludwig
reviews.text: New fancy facilities, good dental care and advice.

reviews.author: Brandee Randall
reviews.text: Do not go here! Super rude and unprofessional!!! Stay away! Go somewhere else!!!!!!!!! Front desk lady absolutely RUDE!!! Dr. PAYNE UNPROFESSIONAL RUDE!!!!

reviews.author: Tina inTucson
reviews.text: The staff, doctor, and assistants do a GREAT job here. They check in often throughout a procedure to make sure you’re doing alright. I’ve never been someone to dread this, but have always considered being numbed at the dentist a necessary evil that, despite the pre-numb gel, always feels like someone is digging around your gums and jaw. This is not the case with a Dr. Payne as I’ve never been more comfortable.The new office is gorgeous, modern, full of light, and spacious. I always have a fun time with everyone here and will be coming back again soon.

reviews.author: Kelsey Loftus
reviews.text: I have never really felt comfortable going to the dentist but the doc and hygienists are always so friendly and are experts at making the whole experience calming and comforting. I've never felt belittled or guilty/ashamed for not being the best at flossing or having dental issues in general (which has been an issue for me with past dentists).

reviews.author: Kristopher Stewart
reviews.text: I always enjoy my time at this location. The are very attentive and professional and my visits are typically quick and painless. By far the best experience I have had at a dentist.

reviews.author: Mario Olivencia
reviews.text: I felt well taken care of at gentle dental, the front staff, assistants, and doctor were all great.  During the procedure Tracie the assistant and the doctor made me feel comfortable, were patient with my questions, and the best part is I felt no pain at all!

reviews.author: Vicky Chu Tilbury
reviews.text: Dr Payne and Tracy are so wonderful here! They make every visit pleasant, painless and most importantly they tell you what they are doing every step of the way. I’ve moved to Edmonds but continue to come to this office because of the staff. Thank you!

reviews.author: Eloy Zamora
reviews.text: I always have a pleasant experience with the team from Gentle Dental Ballard.  The staff is great and you can expect quality dental care here.   I was able to get an appointment for a cleaning in their new like location.  It's a modern office centrally located with brand new equipment.

reviews.author: Sam Driscoll
reviews.text: Dr. Payne and Tracie are incredible and always make me feel so comfortable and relaxed when I come in for an appointment. Dr. Payne is very informative throughout the entire visit and his sense of humor makes going to the dentist actually enjoyable. The girls at the front desk are always friendly and never fail to remind me when I have an upcoming appointment! I’m excited to see the brand new office they’re moving to in a few weeks!

reviews.author: Anna Chamberlain
reviews.text: I went here and am not typically the type to post reviews but my service was unacceptable! First thing when I walked through the front door they told me that all of their equipment had broken before I got there so I wasn’t able to get a cleaning. I was surprised that they didn’t call ahead of time to let me know we could reschedule. When I met with the dentist he told me that I needed 4 crowns!!! I’ve gotten a second opinion and they told me I don’t need any crowns at ALL, just a few corrections on previous fillings. I understand that dentists all have different expectations and methods for treatment but that is A LOT to put someone through if it’s not necessary?! The hygienist and front desk staff seemed kind but I was so upset to with Gentle Dental Ballard. Not to mention if you have dental anxiety, expect them to make it worse!!

reviews.author: L Cooney
reviews.text: Very relaxed experience, staff is super friendly and helpful, good references. Beautiful views of Puget sound

reviews.author: Meadow A
reviews.text: The staff is friendly and all around amazing! Gentle Dental in Ballard lives up to the name.

reviews.author: Eloy Zamora
reviews.text: I come here regularly for my cleanings and the staff is always professional and quick but never rushed.   Plus you can't beat the views of the Sound from the office.

reviews.author: Yousif Askar
reviews.text: I chose them as part of my primary dental care that my insurance requires and they were based on my location the closet. I made an appointment over the phone over a month from the appointment date, and I expected to get exam and cleaning the same day as I was promised over the phone. But they said that they don't do it the same day, which I explained to the dentist Joshua Payne that I had to get time off work to be here and it's hard to do so!I wanted to post here so I can share my frustration and let others know how bad they treat new patients.

reviews.author: AJ
reviews.text: I absolutely love Gentle Dental in Ballard. The staff is always so amazing and makes me feel like a welcome guest. Chris is the absolute best! She is the main reason I keep coming back here. She is super sweet and very knowledgeable. Anthony was another big reason I keep coming back but  has moved to the Everett office, so I'll miss seeing him. Tori was there this last weekend, and she was so sweet. I truly love all the staff here and feel like a valued patient every visit.

reviews.author: Peter Zerbe
reviews.text: Do not go here. These guys are incompetent. Twice they busted in asking for insurance information in the middle of my clean. I have insurance, I had my insurance card, but these guys thought that I could magically solve whatever issue they were having while my mouth's agape and stuffed with dental tools instead of calling my insurance company. I was told that they eventually sorted things out only to come back in 6 months later to do the same dance (ie. They did not have any details of my insurance on record). When asked why they waited until I came in to check my details, the practice manager replied that she only checks a day before. When asked why I wasn't contacted about the issue yesterday, she responded that she wasn't in yesterday. Really!?

reviews.author: Denise Hubbard
reviews.text: I am always completely satisfied with the services provided at Gentle Dental (Shilshole). The Dental Hygienist did a great job of cleaning my teeth and answered all my questions. The Doctor who checked my mouth after being cleaned did a check for any unusual signs or symptoms of oral cancer, which I appreciate very much! Everyone, including the Receptionists are very kind.

reviews.author: Bekah M
reviews.text: This has literally been the best dental experience I've had in my adult life. I came to Gentle Dental after many years between dental visits because I'd had no luck finding a good provider. Anthony at the front desk was attentive and helpful in scheduling my appointment, and remembered me when I came back months later. Dr. Bara was kind and literally gentle, and being able to look over beautiful views of the water while getting your teeth cleaned is incredible. I've had to switch between three different dental insurance companies, and Gentle Dental had accepted all of them, and worked with me to make sure my treatments were going to be covered. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Feeds Timer
reviews.text: Very rude front desk guy and dentist!

reviews.author: John Turman
reviews.text: I had a great checkup and cleaning here. Beautiful scenery overlooking the bay. The entire building is in the process of renovation after Anthony's Restaurants left the lower levels of this space.Dr. Payne is a genius and all the staff here are sweet as can be. I would definitely recommend them. I found this place via Aetna's DocFind.

reviews.author: Nikki Gepner
reviews.text: A big thank you to Dr. Clements and her team!Dr. Clements provided me with a thorough assessment coming up with a plan along with my dentist that saved me a lot of time and money in the long run.I had Invisalign and my attachments stayed strong which saved me time compared to experiences I hear about other orthodontists where the attachments fall off requiring replacement between adjustments and in some cases prolongs treatment time.The work I needed required regular coordination between Dr. Clements and my dentist Dr. Keerti so that I could have my badly chipped and worn front teeth restored without needing to remove any tooth structure.  I had been told by other orthodontists that I would need to do braces for this but Dr. Clements made it possible with Invisalign and I am very happy with the result.

reviews.author: RV
reviews.text: Dr. Clements is truly one of the best orthodontists I’ve worked with. She is extremely meticulous and detail-oriented, and it shows in the quality of her work. I came to her after a previous orthodontic treatment didn’t go well, and she was able to quickly assess the situation and correct the issues in a relatively short amount of time.She took the time to really listen to my concerns, as well as the goals I had for my treatment, and made sure the plan reflected what I wanted to achieve. Her expertise is clear, and I always felt confident I was in capable hands throughout the process.Her entire team is also wonderful—Julie, Siobhan, Maddie, and the rest of the staff are consistently kind, welcoming, and professional. The whole office has a warm, friendly, family-like environment that makes every visit comfortable. I highly recommend Dr. Clements and her team.

reviews.author: Carrie Aull
reviews.text: All three of my kids went to Clements Orthodontics and we've had great experiences will all of them!  Dr. Clements and her entire staff have always been so friendly and attentive.Our family highly recommends Clements Orthodontics!

reviews.author: Susan Stenner
reviews.text: I had a terrific experience with Clements Orthodontics. As a person going back for orthodontic work as 50+ adult, I can say that going the Invisalign route was sooo much better than the old style braces I had back in the 80s! Plus every single person in this office is so nice I couldn’t have had a better experience or been happier with the results.

reviews.author: Sarah Blodgett
reviews.text: If you're a busy family looking for an orthodontist, this is the one to choose. You spend way more time than you expect at an orthodontic office. Between lobby waits, scheduling and rescheduling calls, and actual appointments, it adds up. So who you choose matters. That's why we're so grateful it was here. Highly recommend.I just wrapped two years of Invisalign, and throughout I felt genuinely cared for, not just treated. Dr. Clements is incredibly thoughtful and thorough. She explains everything clearly and gives honest guidance.My daughter is also a patient, and her experience is really what sealed our trust. She started young with a palate expander to correct a fairly serious crossbite. We'd been quoted nearly $10k elsewhere and told she'd need perfect compliance with a mouth guard...something we knew wasn't realistic for her age. Dr. Clements walked us through every option, gave us a developmentally sound plan, and the results have been incredible. Her crossbite is fully corrected, and now we're just monitoring. As a parent, you do the best you can and it was such a relief knowing this early intervention was done right.The entire staff is exceptional - warm, organized, and genuinely kind. They coordinated my appointments with my daughter's to things easier on our family (such a gift) and always flexible when we needed to adjust.A very special shout-out to Chavonne, our regular assistant. She made every visit something we looked forward to. She genuinely got to know our family and remembered what matters to our daughter - she went out of her way to make her feel cared for and we are so grateful!

reviews.author: Nancy Zhang
reviews.text: Professional orthodontist, and good quality products with very nice service team.My daughter and son are both their clients, we all happy with that.

reviews.author: Kathryn
reviews.text: Best Orthodontist experience! Clements Orthodontist was great with me as I navigated my braces journey as an adult. Every worker is nice and gentle. I was very impressed with the options I had, and I will recommend all family and friends here. Just got my braces off, and I’m so happy with the experience!

reviews.author: Skintegrity MedSpa
reviews.text: Always a delight. Karen is great and I couldn't be happier with her.

reviews.author: Makaila N.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my time at Clements Orthodontics. From my free consultation, all the way to my retainer delivery, I had nothing but an excellent experience. The consultation was more than just taking pictures and telling me orthodontics would benefit me. Dr. Clements came in and gave me a detailed explanation of my treatment plan and then the treatment coordinator went over pricing and payment options, so I knew what to expect from start to finish. I looked forward to my appointments as the environment was welcoming and family-like (which is hard to find in a clinical space). I felt as though every one of the staff members took interest in my treatment and comfort for each appointment. Madi, Julie, and Chavonne were all wonderful and I enjoyed my appointments with each of them. Overall, my experience at Clements Orthodontics was lovely and I would recommend this office to anyone looking for a confident orthodontist and office to give them the joy of having confidence in their smile!

reviews.author: Carrie Scott
reviews.text: I highly recommend Clements Orthodontics! The team is amazing and the quality of care is unmatched! Dr. Clements treated me like family, she’s talented at what she does and I’m so happy with my Invisalign results! Thank you Clements!

reviews.author: Acadia Maggi
reviews.text: Dr. Clements is absolutely wonderful! She is kind, patient, and truly takes the time to make her patients feel comfortable at every visit. The entire office is welcoming and professional, and we always feel well cared for. We’re so grateful to have found her and highly recommend her to anyone looking for an orthodontist!

reviews.author: Andrew Bosa
reviews.text: Was an amazing experience great staff and super smooth process

reviews.author: Megumi Kalenderian
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Dr. Clements and her team throughout our son’s orthodontic treatment. She was always kind and informative, taking the time to explain everything clearly to both us as parents and to our son. She consistently made sure the treatment plan was working well and that our son was happy with the progress and final outcome.What we especially appreciated was how she shared her own experiences with her children—what worked for them and what was challenging—which helped us make thoughtful decisions along the way. Completing a two-year orthodontic journey successfully felt much easier thanks to the happy, warm atmosphere in the clinic and the friendly, supportive staff who were always encouraging.Now that our younger child has started her own orthodontic journey here, we feel completely confident and reassured knowing she is in the same caring and capable hands. Highly recommend this practice.

reviews.author: Sasha Hathaway
reviews.text: We’ve had three of our children go through braces at Clements Orthodontics, and we couldn’t be happier. The results are amazing, the staff is wonderful, and their smiles are truly priceless.

reviews.author: Jill Nagashima
reviews.text: Very thoughtful and competent staff. Super wonderful people and great with both my kids for two rounds each for two kids of braces.

reviews.author: Gary Watkins
reviews.text: Just finished Invisalign. Clements Othodontics have been fantastic. Very friendly, professional and great results. Don’t hesitate to put your faith in their hands. Great with kids and adults alike.

reviews.author: K Riffell
reviews.text: It is worth the drive from Seattle to have an orthodontist I can trust. Dr. Clements is excellent.

reviews.author: Danielle Antal
reviews.text: What a terrific human being! I had a lot of questions and Dr. Clements was able to answer with honesty and knowledge.

reviews.author: Stacie Sandritter
reviews.text: Dr. Clements and staff are the best! From the very start I’ve been thoroughly impressed with every aspect of my treatment. The office doesn’t have the hectic vibe I so often find in medical settings and the staff are kind, personable, efficient and organized- I never feel like I’m being rushed or ignored. Coming from someone who has been to multiple providers, I highly recommend trusting Dr. Clements with your orthodontic treatment.

reviews.author: Shailesh Kumar

reviews.author: Christy Tucci
reviews.text: Both of our kids have been patients at Clements Ortho and we had a great experience! They were always prompt with appointments and even helped coordinate care with our dentist. We highly recommend Dr. Clements for all your ortho needs!

reviews.author: Meredith
reviews.text: Dr Clement’s and staff have been GREAT with Maya. It was a lot of work to get her smile in shape and they were FANTASTIC!!

reviews.author: Traci Svee
reviews.text: We couldn't be happier with our experience at Clements Orthodontics. Dr. Clement has treated both of my daughters, and the results for both are absolutely fantastic—truly smile transformations!What sets this practice apart is the level of care and attention. The staff is consistently kind, and incredibly responsive to all our questions and scheduling needs.Most importantly, Dr. Clements went above and beyond to ensure my daughters were comfortable throughout their treatment. I specifically remember how she took extra time and effort, outside of her working hours, to personally check and adjust my daughter's wires to make sure they were not digging in or causing discomfort. This dedication truly shows how much they value their patients.If you are looking for an orthodontist who provides outstanding results and a truly compassionate and responsive patient experience, look no further. I highly recommend Dr. Clements!!!

reviews.author: Iris Hsu-Rose
reviews.text: Dr Clements is very patient and gentle.  Both of my kids were treated by her and had great results.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kelli
reviews.text: We are so pleased with our orthodontic treatment with Dr. Clements and her team. We are always greeted with a smile, and the staff are patient and helpful with questions and scheduling. Dr. Clements created a thoughtful and successful treatment plan for our son. We are grateful!

reviews.author: Gwen G
reviews.text: The absolute best! Dr. Clements and team have been very professional, caring and kind since day one. From the minute you walk into the office, you automatically feel at ease and welcomed. I cannot be happier with my results. My case was complex and Dr Clements genuinely looks out for the patients best interest and results. She is very straightforward and explains all options and explains things so you always know what to expect. I have 4 children that went through orthodontic care under other providers and not one comes close to the level of compassion, expertise and caring that Dr Clement and team provides. Highly recommend for the whole family!

reviews.author: z
reviews.text: Dr. Clements and her team were amazing and super professional.
