I wouldn’t have asked for a better experience and am so grateful.

reviews.author: emily
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Clements! Would recommend this place if you want Invisalign!

reviews.author: Andreé Pavo Punzalan
reviews.text: I have loved my overall experience with Dr. Clements and her team! I had to undergo surgery in my neck in the middle of my Invisalign treatment. They were very accommodating and gentle with me while I was recovering and was so kind asking how I am doing each appointment. I felt like Dr. Clements went above and beyond in helping me get a better smile on the outside and in!I am done with my own treatment but I won't miss them yet. I'm taking my daughter for her own treatment there now and I'm glad I can still pop in once in awhile to say hello to everyone. So lucky to have found Dr. Clements!

reviews.author: olivya rientjes
reviews.text: great service and very friendly orthodontists!

reviews.author: Allison Hart
reviews.text: Chavonne was super helpful when my daughter’s wire snapped out and needed to be trimmed right before closing time - thank you for your kindness!

reviews.text: The process for my braces was pretty easy and straightforward! It was great!

reviews.author: Teresa Douglas
reviews.text: Both of my sons had ortho treament at Clements Orthodontic.  Dr. Clements and her staff are fantastic! The doctor and her entire staff are very knowledgeable, friendly and they provide excellent care, and the results were fantastic.  The facility is very clean and modern, and the treatment timing was on schedule.

reviews.author: Beary Creative
reviews.text: Every time I would come in for my appointment, I felt rushed. I always felt like an inconvenience and could never ask any questions regarding my treatment, because either the staff didn't know the answers, or the doctor would run away immediately after checking my wires. On top of that, they charge $75 for taking the wires off on a different day than your scheduled appointment and added a $500 charge when I paid for the whole treatment in full.

reviews.author: CrewofMaltby
reviews.text: They were able to fit me in the same morning that I called for an emergency repair of a lower permanent wire that another local orthodontist had done poorly, and which had failed in just 2 days. Very grateful for the extra knowledge and options from Dr. Clements. Facility was clean, staff friendly, and the waiting area was inviting. I would not hesitate to have more work done here. Thank you Dr. Clements!

reviews.author: Kelli Winkler
reviews.text: Always so warming to come in!! Doctor is wonderful!

reviews.author: Ruchita Shah
reviews.text: Dr. Clements is an amazing, compassionate orthodontist and goes above and beyond for her patients. Blessed to have her as an orthodontist for my kids.

reviews.author: Joanne Chuang
reviews.text: Excellent for everything and really appreciate!!Love everyone here!

reviews.author: Matthew Kiely
reviews.text: Really nice dentist place. Feel the children have had their teeth and braces looked after very well here. I do feel that if you show up late they won’t see you but they can easily keep you waiting the same amount of time. Bit of a double standard. Overall happy though

reviews.author: Kay Taylor
reviews.text: Exceptional service, engaged, kind staff and expert results. to ensure that my teeth remain straight and protected throughout my life, I needed a new retainer. I also was fearful that I would lose the one I had been using for over 20 some years. The team was amazing and understanding my goal pro providing me a retainer that has a quality and endurance, that will ensure I reach my goal. Adults will have a comfortable experience, excellent price and a solution in this practice that will sustain the health and appearance of their teeth, thank you so much to the entire team!

reviews.author: N Juntwait
reviews.text: I highly recommend Clements Orthodontics.  We researched a number of different orthodontists and are so glad we chose Dr. Clements and her team - we now couldn't imagine seeing anyone else!  We have had three kids and one adult in her care and couldn't be happier with the results for each individual.  When you meet Dr. Clements, you will instantly feel confident placing your trust in her.  Her office runs like a well oiled machine: friendly, professional (and consistent!) front desk and staff; prompt appointments; clean, modern space; and an overall upbeat and positive environment. When setting up the plan, Dr. Clements takes the time to provide clear explanations of treatment options, costs, and recommendations. This was key to selecting the right plan for each kid (braces vs Invisalign).  Her front desk manages all the paperwork and worked with our insurance which was seamless process.  As to the patient experience from the eyes of a student, my youngest daughter actively looks forward to her appointments because of the games and prizes - and these are real prizes, like sizable gift cards, tickets, full size squishmallows, etc. The entire experience could not be more positive. We are super thankful for Dr. Clements and her amazing team!

reviews.author: Kristina Adad
reviews.text: I can't tell you how much we LOVE Clements Orthodontics! Isabella first visited at age 8 due to serious overcrowding. Everyone was so friendly and there was even a search game with prizes for her and her sister to do while they waited. They gave us two options for long-term solutions to improve her smile. I got other opinions but the prices and staff at Clements could not be beat! Less than one year into phase one produced a GIANT improvement in her smile and space for incoming teeth. Best money we ever spent (no insurance)! We are getting ready for phase 2 and it has been such a pleasant experience my 12 year old isn't apprehensive at all. She loves coming to see Dr. Clements and her staff. My niece now sees her, too! 8/12/16 I now have two daughters with beautiful perfect smiles thanks to Clements Orthodontics! We love everyone there and can't recommend it enough. Thank you! My oldest, now 15, actually took the time to thank me for paying for her beautiful smile! :-)

reviews.author: Jaxon Coburn
reviews.text: I’m a 17 year old and I absolutely love my smile because of Dr. Clements! My smile started out crooked and I had a massive overbite, but through their great treatment with Invisalign, my teeth now feel perfect.Every time I come in to the office the front desk is so kind to me and helps me whenever I am confused with scheduling.  The assistants are very patient and also professed in what they are doing. Dr Clements always makes sure that my teeth are on the right track, and is very adaptive to me whenever I would lose an Invisalign or something.I love how organized the office is, and overall the aura is great every time I come.  It makes want to come in all the time!

reviews.author: Chandra Stefan
reviews.text: We have loved Clements Orthodontics for our daughters. Every person who works there is great and our overall experience has been fantastic. We met with 3 orthodontists prior to choosing Dr. Clements, and we have been so happy with our decision.

reviews.author: Kim Stone
reviews.text: We are super happy with Clements Orthodontics. All the office staff (front desk, receptions, finance, etc…) are super friendly and always helpful. The orthodontic assistants we have had have all been great with my 9 year old - skilled as well as super nice and friendly and put her at ease. We’ve had a great experience with Dr. Clements and all the staff every time we’ve been to the office.

reviews.author: Cathy Madson
reviews.text: Have always had a great experience with Dr. Clements and staff! Kind and efficient at all they do. Was also pleasantly surprised at the better pricing than other orthodontists I checked with.

reviews.author: ali bagherian
reviews.text: Dr. Karen Clements stands out as the most compassionate physician I've ever encountered. Her remarkable expertise provides a sense of assurance, and her enthusiasm and commitment to achieving optimal results will instill hope throughout the orthodontic journey. I would like to take this opportunity to express my gratitude to Dr. Clements and the entire team at Clements Orthodontics, who consistently exhibit a warm and friendly demeanor.Thanks for giving me a beautiful smile.

reviews.author: Jerika Cummings
reviews.text: Great Orthodontics office, highly recommend! My daughter started her phase 1 treatment at 9 years old, after 1 year she just got them off and is SO pleased with her new smile!! My son is now starting his phase 1 treatment this week - 8 years old but mature dental age compared to his sister.Dr. Clements is a great provider, she has a busy clinic but always makes time to answer patient and parent questions or concerns. When we were first referred, I was nervous starting braces so young so based so on my daughter's situation we were able to wait and watch 6 months or so while I got comfortable with the idea of it all. I later had an insurance issue due to my husband changing jobs mid-treatment and she looked into it personally with her billing staff to make sure that I had received the maximum benefit, this type of attention to detail is rare among dental care providers!The clinic is a fun and welcoming atmosphere! All staff is kind and caring - they go above and beyond to create fun seasonal promotions for patients (scavenger hunt for Easter with Squishmallow prizes and Free Summer Ice cream treats with appointments). This stuff may seem trivial, but it makes a huge positive impact on my kids as I'm dragging them to ortho appointments often! They made my daughter a care package to celebrate being "braces free" - complete with all the things: gum, popcorn, caramel, and apple chips - she just loved it! Thanks Dr. Clements and your team for all your hard work!! Great job taking special care of your patients!

reviews.author: Chantal Klenke
reviews.text: Yesterday I finished my Invisalign journey with Dr. Clements! From the consultation to the end they were wonderful. Dr. Clements is as picky as her patients meaning she won’t settle but she’ll work with you. She doesn’t settle for a just okay finished smile but she wants the “perfect smile/bite” for everyone! Love this office! 11/10 recommend! Photo to show my finished smile!

reviews.author: Erin Vey
reviews.text: A 5 start experience from beginning to end. Dr. Clement’s and her staff were wonderful from the consult to the braces coming off. I appreciated that our appointments were always on time, we rarely had to wait. My daughter felt seen and heard at her appointments and she really loved the summer treats! Would definitely recommend this office for ortho!

reviews.author: Ken Gibbs
reviews.text: Very pleased with my invisalign results.Dr. Clements and her staff are great to work with. Always pleasant. Never had to wait. Very informative. Would highly recommend.   😁

reviews.author: Reed Hacker
reviews.text: Definitely deserve the quality install stamp of approval. I'd use them again, but their fixes have been permanent! Very happy with the care I received. Intelligent staff. Haven't been back in years, which prompted this review.

reviews.author: Phil McCoy
reviews.text: I was surprised and delighted when Dr Clements and staff all gathered to sing me a song of celebration when my Invisaligns came off. It touched my heart and brought a tear to my eye. Dr Clements took me from spikey-twisted, hillbilly gap-teeth to a solid, uniform smile. I had no idea how I would feel. My life and smile are changed for the better for ever. Crisp, focused professionalism delivered on every visit. Everyone works in concert to deliver precise, positive results. Their office is a happy place. And I am so grateful. Words fall short.

reviews.author: Amy Tran
reviews.text: Love all staff, they were truly the sweetest! Dr. Karen Clements, however, seemed like she was always in a rush and never announced when she was going to do something..

reviews.author: Julie Gere
reviews.text: I am so thankful that my children had Dr. Clements for their orthodontic care.  Dr. Clements was always attentive, caring, and clearly communicated the plans and progress being made.  We knew what was happening and why.  The staff was always also amazing in making my children feel welcome and comfortable during every visit.  When something suddenly happened between visits to cause discomfort, they were quickly seen that day or the next to solve the problem.  All of this occurred seamlessly with friendly smiles and kind words showing genuine concern. I am grateful for the wonderful care and beautiful, healthy smiles that my children received from Dr. Clements and her staff.

reviews.text: Dr. Clements has a thoughtful approach to her recommended treatment. She and her staff are very professional, on-time and make genuine connections with patients and their family. Highly recommend

reviews.text: Dr Clements and the others who work on my son's braces are fantastic.  Very calm and patient with my son's tendency to panic in the dentist/ortho chair.  And his previously Problematic teeth are looking better and better!!!

reviews.author: Ed Byrne
reviews.text: I've been taking my kids to Dr. Clements and her team for years. For something as potentially scary to kids as dental work, the staff here go out of their way to maintain one of the friendliest, upbeat, professional and sympathetic offices I've ever encountered.

reviews.author: Michele Graaff
reviews.text: As an adult getting orthodontics at 40 years old, I had a lot of concerns and questions.  Now, a year and a half into treatment, I couldn't be more pleased to have chosen Dr. Clements and her team. Scheduling is easy, appointments are efficient and thorough, and staff are friendly and caring.

reviews.author: Allison Lee
reviews.text: Every person we encountered at Clements Orthodontics was courteous and welcoming.  The kids felt comfortable from the start, and it was a great experience for all of us!

reviews.author: John R
reviews.text: I went for a free consultation and evaluation.  The staff is very friendly and the doctor seems very knowledgeable.  My case is a bit complex and the orthodontist seems to have come up with a plan that could work.  My overall experience was positive.A few things I noticed/question though.  My exam and consultation is supposed to be free but she can't really come up with a treatment for me without a impression which will cost me $250.00.  The assistant said that is to cover the doctor's time in meeting with me in case I don't use their service.  Hmm...with the cost of orthodontics being so expensive I viewed the "free" services as making an investment in getting the patient's business.  This kind of feels like I'm paying for the "free" consultation/evaluation.  Another thing I noticed is with the open floor plan that this (and other orthondontists' offices) have there's very little privacy.  I wonder why they don't put up wall divider's or something?  Maybe for kid's that's fine but for adult's we kind of like it a little more private.

reviews.author: Colleen Maestas
reviews.text: We are new patients to Clements Orthodontics and are really happy.  Staff is very welcoming and friendly.  Dr. Clements is great with my daughter, makes her feel very comfortable.  We would definitely recommend her practice to others.

reviews.author: Dee Dee Roe
reviews.text: All three of my children have been seen at Clements Orthodontics.  Two kids were being followed by another local orthodontist and I wanted a second opinion regarding braces.  Dr. Clements & her staff are professional, caring and personable.  Her treatment options and outcomes were better for my children than the first orthodontist.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rebecca Lohman
reviews.text: I am a dental hygienist and I chose Dr. Clements based on a recommendation from a colleague; I am extremely glad I did!  Dr. Clements and her team have been amazing throughout this whole process.  They are incredibly compassionate, knowledgeable, and really listen.  My kids love going and their office is well equipped for all ages.   She thinks about all the pieces that not only make a great smile but that are best for a healthy mouth long term. Scheduling is easy, her team is very supportive and the details they go out their way to do, really make the difference.   I would recommend her 100%!

reviews.author: cara erdman
reviews.text: Our first experience was wonderful! The staff was friendly, Dr. Clements was extremely nice and professional and my son left with excitement about getting braces!

reviews.author: Tammy M
reviews.text: Our youngest daughter is just starting her ortho work with Dr. Clements and team. Great environment, fun for the kids. Organized staff and clear communication. Glad we made the choice to go with Dr. Clements.

reviews.author: Linda Jamieson
reviews.text: Dr Clements and her staff are amazing! Efficient appointments makes scheduling them easy! I  always enjoy our chair-side conversations and the friendly atmosphere. Staff never hesitates to solve any concerns I may have. A happy place and always decorated for the season!

reviews.author: Warrick McDowell
reviews.text: I've never had braces before and I am 32. I consulted multiple orthodontists with recommendations of anywhere from 2-4 years of braces or even surgery. I looked into Invisalign as well, but I was not a proper candidate. After many consultations, I ended up going with Dr. Clements and family. I say family because that's how I was treated. Not only did I get to know everybody and they get to know me, but it only took 16 months (and no surgery) for my treatment to satisfactorily complete. And it was completed a full week before my wedding, to my delight. I would recommend Dr. Clements to anybody and everybody, no matter their age or circumstances.

reviews.author: Amiga Debbie
reviews.text: We always have an positive experience with Dr. Clements and her amazing staff.  Our 10 and 12 year old sons are her patients.  Her staff is always happy, caring and professional...  shows they enjoy their job and working with Dr. Clements.Dr. Clement's office runs smoothly -- appointments are on time and confirmed by email and phone, billing is handled efficiently (we auto-pay) and don't worry about paying extra for additional visits (when they have to have their wires removed for their teeth cleaning appointment).  The location is convenient for after school appointments.  Plenty of parking.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sonja Saliternig
reviews.text: I'm always looking forward to my appointments at Dr. Clements' office. Everybody is professional, friendly and easy to talk to. They do everything to make you feel comfortable and they never make you wait. It's just a great atmosphere and you always feel welcome. I would highly recommend Dr. Clements and her team.

reviews.author: Linhui Ge (Gery)
reviews.text: Super nice and friendly staff! They answered pretty much every single request of mine in a very timely fashion.  I have been using there service for years and I don’t plan to leave, which should tell you something.

reviews.author: Ruth Ann Hackenbracht
reviews.text: I want to give the biggest, most heartfelt shout-out to Dr. Judy Chen the absolute best orthodontist ever!!! Dr. Chen gave me a truly beautiful smile through my Invisalign treatment. She is exceptionally knowledgeable, skilled, and mapped out my Invisalign plan perfectly. Her genuine care, kindness, and deep understanding spoke volumes throughout the entire process. Dr. Chen’s unwavering dedication shines through her work, and I could not be happier with how straight and perfect my teeth look now!A huge and very special thank you to Erika, her Orthodontic Assistant! Erika is the sweetest, most attentive assistant who always made me feel completely comfortable and welcome during my tray and attachment checks!The entire office team consistently went above and beyond! They made managing my Invisalign tracking smooth and stress-free, and I loved coming in for my appointments! Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Dr. Chen and team, for your expert care, my gorgeous smile, and an unforgettable experience!!!I highly recommend Judy C. Chen Orthodontics to anyone looking for the best orthodontic and Invisalign care!

reviews.author: Conor O'Brien
reviews.text: Dr. Chen and her staff are phenomenal. I came to her as an adult patient with a number of alignment and bite issues, and could tell right away that she would do a great job. She is knowledgeable and thorough, and I am thrilled with my results. I would gladly recommend her to anyone.

reviews.author: Grace Chang
reviews.text: I've been seeing Dr. Judy since I was little for checkups, and I started braces in 8th grade. Dr. Judy and her assistants—Erica, Katie, Sunny, and Zara-have always been very kind and helpful, especially when my braces were bothering me. Even when my braces became loose a couple of times, they helped fix the issue quickly. I really appreciate how they always let me check my teeth with a mirror after each visit.I would definitely recommend this orthodontic office for people living in Sammamish and Redmond. The only improvement I can think of is the parking lot, since the space are a bit tight. Otherwise, the office and staff are great, and I'll miss Dr. Judy and her team after the past two-three years!-Astro Chen

reviews.author: Yi Li
reviews.text: i can’t say enough how great this place is! Dr. Chen is very professional, I can say my son’s teeth get corrected very smoothly, only very minor discomfort in the beginning and no complaining at all, which is very rare for my son. All crew are super nice and very good at handling kids!

reviews.author: Rika Tsuda
reviews.text: We started looking into orthodontic treatment to fix our son’s overlapping front teeth. We had consultations at two other offices, but Dr. Chen explained everything in the clearest and simplest way.What really stood out was that she never pressured us. She even mentioned that a second phase might not be necessary, which made us feel that she truly cared about what was best for our son. It really felt like she was recommending the shortest and best treatment plan specifically for him.Scheduling appointments has been easy, and the staff is always kind and welcoming. We’re so happy we chose this office. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Daniel Ge
reviews.text: I was recommended to Dr. Chen by my dentist, and I feel very fortunate to have done my braces with her team in this office. The staff are consistently thoughtful and transparent with my orthodontist treatment, and they are happy to have thorough discussions on the variety of choices (such as rubber bands or springs) until we found the method that best works for me. The scheduling flexibility also made it very easy to book future appointments. Would strongly recommend

They were always more than happy to help, regardless of the time of day.I highly recommend Dr. Chen and her team for your treatment. If you’re skeptical, at least give them a visit. You’ll see why they’re the best!

reviews.author: Melissa Miu
reviews.text: Review for Dr. Judy Chen and TeamI really did my homework before starting orthodontic treatment—I visited orthodontists all over Washington to find the best plan and the best value. Most of them told me I’d need metal or partial braces for several years—some even said five or more. I really didn’t want to go that route because of the appearance, the discomfort, and the frequent weekly visits for adjustments.My case was also a bit complicated. I had a dental implant placed, but I waited too long to get the crown, so the surrounding teeth shifted into the space. At that point, braces or Invisalign were my only options to reopen the gap.Then I found Dr. Judy Chen, who prescribed Invisalign—and I couldn’t be happier with the results. After about two years of consistent wear (at least 20 hours a day—though I’ll admit I slacked off a bit maybe more than a bit during vacations because I was constantly eating as a foodie and only wore it to sleep), I’m finally ready to move forward with getting my crown placed. Dr. Judy also introduced me to Dr. Phillips, a prosthodontist, whose crown expertise has been incredibly helpful.I also want to give a special shoutout to Erika and Sunny. They made every visit enjoyable with their jokes, check-ins on my life, and how thorough they were in their work—always making sure Dr. Judy gave a final check as well.I’m so grateful to Dr. Judy and her entire team for their kindness, skill, and support throughout my treatment. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for thoughtful, personalized orthodontic care—especially if you’re hoping to avoid metal braces (no promises, but worth checking!).

reviews.author: Stan Finkelshtein

They have a warm and caring demeanor that immediately puts you and your child at ease, making the entire process much less stressful. The actually take the time to listen to your concerns and address any questions you may have, ensuring that you feel comfortable and confident in their care.So far, the results of the treatment have been amazing, and I am constantly amazed by the progress that we have made. I cannot recommend Dr. Chen highly enough, and I am confident that anyone who chooses to work with them will be just as impressed as I am. Thank you for all that you do!

reviews.text: The most professional dentist I have ever seen, I have been working with Dr.Chen on my teeth for three years, can’t expect a better treatment .

reviews.author: Sarah Bigelow
reviews.text: Dr Chen was recommended to me by my oral surgeon after I suffered a traumatic accident wherein my jaw was broken in nine places.  Due to other head and neck injuries, timely surgery on my teeth had been impossible.  When Dr Chen took my case, my teeth would not meet at all.  I could not chew or bite food.Dr Chen gave me hope through the trauma.  She used technology to show me how orthodontics could accomplish what surgery could not.  Within six months, I was chewing meat and vegetables.  Within eighteen months, I could bite a sandwich neatly.  My interactions with food became ordinary, thanks to Dr Chen's skill and expertise.The office staff have consistently been cheerful, friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful.  They have accommodated my schedule, since I travel out of town often.  They are meticulous with follow up appointments, communicating through email and phone.  I cannot praise Dr Chen and her staff enough.  Thank you for giving me a normal life again!

reviews.author: Griffin
reviews.text: Fantastic place to get teeth work done! I had a massive underbite when younger, and Dr. Chen helped to bring a smile back to my face (and my teeth!)

reviews.author: Lori Thompson
reviews.text: We started seeing Dr. Chen when she bought the practice from our previous orthodontist Dr. Taylor. We have been absolutely thrilled with her from our very first visit! Besides having a good experience all of these years our children's teeth look beautiful! I would highly recommend Dr. Chen to anyone who is searching for an orthodontist!!

reviews.author: Jenny Juang
reviews.text: My daughter had braces with Dr. Judy and the whole experience was fabulous.  From the beginning the explanations were straight-forward and easy to understand so we knew what to expect financially and physically.  The staff and doctor are friendly, kind, and caring.  Any situations that came up (my daughter broke/lost her retainer twice) were taken care of quickly and with understanding.  Best of all my daughter now loves her teeth!  It's so nice to see her smile widely rather than be embarrassed about her teeth.  I know where we will be going when my younger daughter needs braces!

reviews.author: Danielle Pino
reviews.text: I decided to get my teeth fixed as an adult - as a teenager and young adult, it was not an option due to financial issues and so this was a pretty big deal. Severely crooked teeth while growing up meant I was afraid to smile and have pictures taken of me.Dr. Judy Chen and her office team are amazing! They put me at complete ease! They described the whole process from beginning to end, showed me a simulation of what my teeth would look like finished, and handled any and every issue (real or imagined :) ) that I had over the course of my 2 yr. treatment. They had a great payment plan, and they even reimbursed me money after a change in my insurance I was not even aware of!I highly, highly recommend Dr. Chen whether for children, teens or grown-up treatment. She and her staff are kind, considerate, very responsive (and financially honest!). If my son ever needs braces, I know where to take him!

reviews.author: Diedre Kelly
reviews.text: Dr nicholsen really cares about the outcome of your teeth. He listens to your needs and delivers the best results. The staff is very down to earth and makes the atmosphere feel like home.  I was referred to him and would do the same for the next person.

reviews.author: Kimberley Mertz
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Dr. Nicholson and his team. It’s so rare that you meet a doctor and staff that are so invested in their patients!  When we decided to go with Dr. Nicholson for our daughter’s braces, and filling out the paperwork, they noticed that I had just celebrated a milestone birthday and sent me two birthday cards!  And not a generic office card, these were cards that were purchased and personalized.  Over the summer, we lost my husband’s mother.  The team was so supportive and kind to my entire family.  They sent us cards, again, personalized cards, that mentioned parts of the obituary.  We didn’t send it to them, they looked it up.  And when they sent the card to the family, they even included my son who isn’t even a patient (yet)!This office runs so smoothly and efficiently, and if you can believe it, they all put us in a great mood when we walk in.  Their office is out of the way for us, but we wouldn’t trade orthodontists for the world.  I can’t say enough about this office and would recommend them over and over.

reviews.author: Adam Osman
reviews.text: I have had braces since i was in middle school and i am graduating college   next year. I was told my original treatment plan was three to four years and i do believe i missed appointments when i was 14-15 so i understand an extra 1-2 years added. However it has been over 7 years, and the most frustrating part is that Dr. Nicholson has been telling me i was “close to getting them off” for the past 3 years. I would get my hopes up when he would tell me “next summer” or “this next winter” and it would pass over and over. I’ve had braces since i was 12 and i’m turning 20 and its still not even close to be done and i cant seem to understand why its taking so long. I wanted to schedule a one on one appointment but i couldn’t even do that so I finally decided i want them removed so i can just get Smile Direct. But now i have to wait several months just to schedule an appointment for them to get removed. This has honestly been one of the most frustrating experiences in my life and i cant wait for it to be over.

reviews.author: Johnny Adam Smith
reviews.text: First off if I could give a 0 star review I would most definitely give one. But since 1 is the lowest I have no choice. If you are looking forward to get braces do not come to this ortho, this place is so slow and so unreliable. I understand that during the pandemic things have changed and it’s going to be a little harder to get people in for appointments but, over 5 months with no call back or email scheduling for an appointment? It’s ridiculous. How are you going to tell people you’ll get with them as soon as possible but when we call for an appointment you never call back or even try to. People want to get their braces off ASAP but you’re doing the opposite and you’re extending their treatment time by not cooperating. If I could go to a different orthodontist I would but don’t want to waste money. Even if you guys can’t schedule us, Atleast let us know that we’ll be getting a call for a appointment shortly? Because I’m completely clueless at this point. At this point we might need to start my treatment all over. How are other orthodontists getting people in 4 times over a 3 month period and you guys can’t even do it once.

reviews.text: My daughter began seeing Dr Nicholson when she was about 10 years old, which was about 2003. You cannot tell that she had dental issues when she was younger! Her teeth and smile are knockout, thanks to Dr. Nicholson! Our family regards and recommends Dr. Nicholson and his team highly! reviews.text: I can't even begin to explain my experience here. I have been wanting braces for so long. When I first walked in I was very skeptical, thinking that they were going to over charge me, have hidden fee's, that the employee's were going to be rude. I WAS SO WRONG TO THE MAX. The staff's were so polite, they were very nice, made me feel comfortable and welcomed, they helped me through the process, and they worked with me so I could get my braces on. I went through tough times, I was a 19 year old full time student and was working part time so money was very tight. I missed payments for 3 months caused to being stressed out and I went on a vacation to get away from it all. Did I mention I was paying my braces payments on my own? I didn't know what to do. I didn't want to have my braces taken out, because I have been wanting them and needing them for as long as i can remember. They gave me confidence, boosted my self esteem, and made me feel proud to smile. One of the staff had talked to me, and we worked out an agreement to where I was able to keep my braces. I was so grateful for that, for the staff's and Dr. Nicholson. Sure enough before I knew it, I was done with my payments! and 9 months early too! I looked forward to going to all of my appointments, I love my braces, the progress it has shown, what it has done for me. I love the staff here and the experience I had with them. It is because of them, I am about to start my dental assistant program! So thank you to each and everyone of you. Thank you so much. I highly with out a doubt recommend this place to everyone that is looking to get braces. You won't regret it. My rule for braces, take good care of them, take good care of your teeth, every 6 months cleaning, brush twice a day, floss, etc. Last but not least, Embrace your braces! It's all worth it (:Sincerely,Serry Le

Because of the nature of my teeth prior to invisalign and TERRIBLE biteline this journey has been long, but the end result is wonderful!! My teeth are now straight and my biteline is nearly perfect, and that is due to Dr. Lovrovich patient carefully crafted plan to help.  There are other invisalign knock offs, but getting the real thing and the service that comes along with it is WORTH it as you are seen regularly to see if you are on track with your plan, and to even get rescanned if you are not satisfied.I also have to give quick shoutout to Stacey the dental hygienist who always takes the extra time to explain band placement, customized aligners if they are uncomfortable or just answer questions if needed. My entire series of Invisalign trays had already been created and received by the office, so I received all of them, instructions on continuing treatment, a partial refund, and directions to find another orthodontist in my new location.In the end it was a year before I established another orthodontist, but I simply kept rotating trays like clockwork and seamlessly finished the course of treatment. reviews.author: Madam ZoZo
reviews.text: I was referred to Leone & Vaughn by my dentist. At the initial consultation I was told I was too old (age 40) to have my overbite corrected and that the best they could do was straighten my teeth a little. They also told me I was a candidate for Invisalign. Having never seen an orthodontist before, I took them at their word.I had a few follow-up questions after the appointment, mostly regarding payment and what would happen if I relocated during treatment and had to transition to another provider. The sales person quickly stopped answering my questions, and sensing a lack of transparency I looked for another orthodontist.At the second orthodontist, my age was never raised as a challenge and I was told I was absolutely NOT a candidate for Invisalign - that my overbite could be corrected but required more traditional braces. They modelled the treatment plan and explained everything in detail. They never had a problem answering questions and told me to pay month-to-month in case I had to relocate. I proceeded with the second orthodontist and traditional braces.It has been 2-years and I just got my braces off. My overbite is corrected, proving I am indeed NOT too old. Leone & Vaughn aren't concerned with treating patients' concerns, they are in it for the quickest and easiest way to make money.

reviews.author: Jen L
reviews.text: I had the most disappointing and unprofessional experience at this office. From the moment I walked in, I felt rushed and uncomfortable. The doctor's assistant made me feel like I was an inconvenience, speaking too quickly, and displaying a condescending attitude. When I asked about Invisalign, hoping to get an unbiased recommendation for the best treatment, I was met with hostility. The assistant even mocked me by slowly mouthing the word "orthodontist" and explaining its function, which felt completely unnecessary and unprofessional.The rest of the interaction with the assistant was awful. She made me feel like I was dealing with a high school bully instead of a healthcare professional. I’ve seen multiple orthodontists across the country, and this was by far the worst experience I’ve had. The doctor herself was no better—she showed up late, rushed through my appointment, and made me feel belittled for my past treatments. She even made a strange comment about how the treatment I was seeking "wouldn’t help my self-esteem," which was hurtful and uncalled for.There seemed to be a culture of indifference and judgment, especially when it came to financial decisions. The doctor mentioned that I needed to make sure I was making "financial choices" and made me feel as though I was making the wrong decision just because my treatment wasn’t a high-ticket item. To make matters worse, I was handed a $9,000 bill with no clear breakdown of what it covered, and no treatment plan was discussed. When I asked for clarity, I was told the doctor was "too busy for phone calls" and that the treatment plan wasn’t available.The whole experience felt like a series of missteps and lack of communication. I felt emotionally drained, and by the time I left, I was frustrated and confused about what I was actually paying for. As a Black woman, I also felt that there may have been a level of prejudice in how I was treated. I would never recommend this office to anyone.

reviews.author: Kyle Moore
reviews.text: IF I could give TEN stars I would.  Amrit and her amazing team handled both my children's orthodontic needs and BOY they were needed.  We started each kid on the path at around 3rd grade,  and each was OUT OF BRACES before high school.  Now in retainers, their teeth are great and genetically that is a miracle!  They don't treat everyone the same; for instance our oldest went with invisalign, knowing that they required more attention, putting them on and off, not throwing them away in a  lunch room - and our youngest went old school METAL - because he would lose his nose if it didn't attach to his face.   The care, flexibility, warm office setting and the fact that they do listen to their patients and the parents concerns, was so refreshing.  It was never you MUST Do this - it was presented as best options and they hit every single mark.  The prices were extremely reasonable and the service and friendship they provided our family the whole way was an experience I would recommend to anyone.  Thank you to the whole team.  You all rock like Pearl Jam live from the front row!

reviews.text: Having done several orthodontic consultations, I am very happy to have selected Dr. Burn to be my orthodontist as she was able to work & communicate effectively with my dentist and surgeon. reviews.author: Heather K
reviews.text: When I was looking for an orthodontist for my children, I asked around to friends for recommendations. I visited a couple of orthodontists and Dr. Burn stood out. My child had a more complicated orthodontic need and the others said they would start braces right away and have two phases. Dr. Burn recommended a different solution that would best be timed with her growth spurt to minimize time with the device. I really appreciated Dr Burn thinking foremost about the experience of the patient and not about getting someone started right away. We came in for periodic check ins and when it was time she started on phase one. That child required 2 phases and so I got to know the team well over the years. Everyone on staff is kind and very good at their jobs. Little to no staff turn over which means it’s a great place to work!We loved Dr Burn so brought our younger child and I decided to redo my orthodontic work with Dr Burn ( PSA don’t be like me and not wear your retainer and therefore have to redo your orthodontic work later in adult life!). Each of our orthodontic needs have been very different and each time I have been impressed by Dr Burn’s assessment and treatment plans that are tailored to our individual needs.We’ve had a few after hours emergencies and Dr Burn has been quick to call us back and help us.I’ve recommended Dr Burn to many friends and encourage you to have a consultation to see if she’s a good fit.
