reviews.text: It’s been a 10 year journey with Dr. Burn and her team. 10 years of professionalism, commitment, outstanding communication, and flexibility (covid came in the middle of this). We could not have asked for a more thoughtful process or better results. We could not be more pleased!

reviews.author: Yiming Chai
reviews.text: Dr. Burn and her team are extremely professional and caring. Dr. Burn communicates her ortho recommendations clearly, both to the parent and to the child, with the patient’s long term best interest at heart. She is also very patient with answering any questions the family may have. My 11 year old connected with Dr. Burn at the very first appointment and understood the treatment plan. Although she is nervous, she understood the why. Thank you Dr. Burn!

reviews.author: Cara Mattera
reviews.text: Good communications for appt., plan, and process. Clean, timely

reviews.author: Heather Abbott
reviews.text: We love Dr Burns and the whole team!   The environment is so welcoming and appointments are efficient and scheduling is smooth (all important for busy lives with kids and teens!)  They really support the whole process of orthodontics and my daughter is delighted with her new smile!

reviews.author: Demesha Y
reviews.text: Dr. Burn and her team are amazing!From my consultation to the final stage of my treatment, Dr. Burn and her team treated me with professionalism and respect. Honestly, the office felt like a second home with how welcoming everyone is!Throughout my treatment, Dr. Burn was very transparent and ensured that I understood each stage of my aligners.  We even joked about how stubborn my teeth were but we never gave up!Overall, I highly recommend Dr. Burn and her team to anyone seeking ortho work. The consultation is free and they provide payment plans.This was the BEST experience I have ever had.Thank you so much for my new smile!

reviews.author: Rogene Eichler West, Ph.D.
reviews.text: Dr. Burn and her team are simply the best. I am a grown-up who found her bite and smile shifting over the years. I am extremely happy with the results of their work and grateful for the confidence it has given me. They are extremely skillful, innovative, detail conscious,  personable, and collaborative with your other health care providers. They have always accomodated my sometimes crazy work schedule. I let things slide during the pandemic and they picked up where we were - without judgment. I feel extremely fortunate to have found such a supportive team.

reviews.author: AeuMuro Lake
reviews.text: The most consistent, professional, kind care can be found here. My daughter got braces young- 3rd grade- but she was supported through the entire process by Dr. Burn and her team. Now she has them off and her smile is just darling! Would definitely recommend this practice. Also relatively affordable payment plan options are available! We will be taking our son there for braces soon.

reviews.author: Ryan Laszlo
reviews.text: i had very big gaps in my teeth and braces fixed it all

reviews.author: Mel Parsons
reviews.text: Absolutely love Dr. Burn and her whole office. They have excellent communication and service as a team. She's provided orthodontic work for two of my kids and myself! I wanted to straighten out my teeth as an adult and she took great care of us all. Not only that, but I recently took my 9 yr old in and she advised we just wait and see rather than start anything too aggressive this early.

reviews.author: LN
reviews.text: Dr. Burn and team are amazing!Dr. Burn and team made my treatment process incredibly easy to follow, they were very accommodating with my busy schedule and were always efficient on every visit. I appreciate the team for all that they’ve done and thankful for my new smile :D Thank you!!

reviews.author: S M
reviews.text: Wonderful experience with our oldest, will definitely send the siblings here when it is their time. The gold standard of care.

reviews.author: David High
reviews.text: It is a joy and a privilege to see Dr Burn and her ENTIRE staff! They are the best in the business!

reviews.author: zhang mengyi
reviews.text: Dr.Burn and her team are caring and professional. The 2 year treatment experience was stress-free as they really pay attention to details and focus on each patient. Now I feel much more confident and secure about my smile! Thank you!

reviews.author: Bill Fleming
reviews.text: Great place but could use a cocktail hour.  :-)

reviews.author: Lauren Kurland
reviews.text: We are repeat customers at Dr Burns! A throughly kind and professional practice!

reviews.author: Amber Severns
reviews.text: I highly recommend Dr. Burn! My children have been coming here for the past year and we have had such a great experience at each visit. Dr. Burn. And her team are great at communicating what to expect and what the best treatment options are. My children feel comfortable and respected and completely at ease during each exam, priceless.

reviews.author: Maria Hannon
reviews.text: Hello Everyone at Amrit Burn Orthodontics!Just a note to thank all of you for the excellent care that Joseph has received from everyone at your office!  His teeth look great and he even likes his cool new retainers!From Gracie, to Rob, to Joseph…everyone in our family has been so pleased with the services provided, the care and safety precautions taken, and the fun environment that is always present at your office.  Many thanks to you all! 🙏😊With gratitude,Maria Hannon

reviews.author: David Uffelman
reviews.text: Dr Burn is the BEST orthodontist! She completely transformed my son’s teeth & he couldn’t feel more proud of his new smile. Highly recommend her practice.

reviews.author: Katrina Dam
reviews.text: Dr. Burn and her staff have been so helpful and genuinely kind. Thank you for getting me started on my new smile journey!

reviews.author: Chloe Bell
reviews.text: Dr. Amrit Burns and her team are amazing! About 6 years ago I was a patient with a more complicated process than the average braces. I had braces for about 2 years and jaw surgery. The team was always consistently positive and gave me a smile I am so proud to have. After my procedure was done, I moved to Orange County for 5 years. When I was there, I never received service as great as I did with Dr. Burns.I just moved back to Seattle about a month ago and called Dr. Burn’s team to have my retainer replaced. When I called, I was shocked that they remembered me right away!If you’re looking for an amazing team for braces or any other procedures for either your kids or yourself, I highly recommend you see Dr. Burns!

reviews.author: K Brox
reviews.text: I love going to visit Dr. Burn and the rest of the crew. They have the most up to date technology and and very nice ambience to the office that makes you feel at ease. I am very lucky to have Dr. Burn as an orthodontist and I hope to be a dental patient for years to come. They are very professional and kind and I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Rachel Sidles
reviews.text: Dr. Burn has shown me the best care I could have imagined. She is pleasant to work with, very caring, and she knows her business extremely well. My teeth look better than they ever have, and her office has top of the line digital technology to scan teeth in 3D. I had Invisalign, and each retainer I had fit perfectly. The staff here are very helpful and friendly, I really can’t say enough good things about this place. DO NOT go with one of those cheap Invisalign options, it’s very worthwhile to do it right the first time around. Dr. Burn is the BEST.

reviews.author: Katie Nye
reviews.text: Absolutely the best orthodontist, hands down! We travel from lynnwood for orthodontic treatment for my daughter, passing by many ortho offices along the way. Dr. Burn is worth the drive! She is the sweetest doctor. Very kind, compassionate and she is patient care centric. Her team is just as great as she is. We absolutely love Kim at the front desk, she will make you feel like you are her best friend, and it’s genuine too! Kim is very knowledgeable and fantastic with working around schedules and with insurance (that in itself is amazing). Vicky the gal you will meet with for your first appointment is wonderful, my daughter loves her because she reminds her of her Aunt, an instant connection. Dr. Burn’s office is conveniently located near I-5, no reason to drive downtown Seattle, fight traffic or fight for a parking spot. Oh, did I mention she has a parking lot on the front and back side of her office?? Ortho isn’t just for kids either! Dr. Burn treats children and adults. I can’t recommend her office enough!

reviews.author: Alexander Thorne
reviews.text: Excellent orthodontic care. Had braces for almost 3 years and they were always there when I needed them. Top notch care and very friendly. Was able to get an appointment 4 years after my braces were removed to get a check up and make sure everything was still okay with my teeth. They still remembered me and everybody was as nice as they were when I initially had braces.

reviews.author: sea.and.sol.retreats
reviews.text: Dr. Amrit Burn was my 6th Orthodontist whom I visited before I committed. The 5 others had no option for me other than jaw surgery for my over bite.  I told Dr. Burn, as I did all of the others, I would like to avoid surgery unless it is absolutely necessary due to any life threatening situation. Amrit took extra time and found another option.  From this experience, I felt absolutely important, cared about, and looked after, and heard. These elements of customer service are crucial to find authentic connections with your patients.  I could not be more blown away with the hospitable, easy going,  but on point service of the Amrit Burn Orthodontic team. I drive sometimes an hour for my check up because this team is worth it.  I feel cared about, and could not recommend Dr. Amrit Burn more. This team is amazing. Mic dropped.

reviews.author: Kate Hall
reviews.text: Dr Burn took me on as a patient after I relocated to Seattle and I was able to finish my Invisalign treatment with her without any problem! Dr Burn is excellent and thorough! Dr Burn’s office staff are the best and so friendly! They are so welcoming - I felt like I’d known them for years! The office is nice and clean and parking is easy! Glad I chose to come to Dr Burn!

reviews.author: Shelley Wolfe
reviews.text: I recently had a consultation with Dr. Burn. She was very thorough and explained all of my options for the best results. All of the staff members are great too!

reviews.author: Mark Squire
reviews.text: I came in as a middle-aged man. I was a little self-conscious about getting braces later in life. Dr. Burn and her staff couldn't be more welcoming and friendly, and put me at ease immediately. I can't say that I enjoy wearing braces, of course, but this crew really understands the unpleasantness. They work hard to  make sure the experience is as painless and pleasant as possible, and it is clear they really care about their patients.  If you're going to get orthodontics, this is a wonderful place to do it!

reviews.author: Jessica Ball
reviews.text: De. Amrit and staff are amazing. They take the time to explain in detail what the next steps are and the overall plan. The staff are always cheerful and kind. The kids love going there and they love doing the guessing games that they have set out to win prizes. Best place ever!!!

reviews.author: Jessica Bainton
reviews.text: Fantastic. Dr. Burn was honest about the treatment I needed and didn't try to do anything unnecessary. The staff went above and beyond to help me while I had my appointment and my two toddlers with me. I highly recommend this office.

reviews.author: johann adam
reviews.text: Staff is friendly and competent.  They helped us navigate our complicated insurance situation, and were nice enough to help the couple of times we had to reschedule at the last minute.  Thanks, and we'll be back next year (with sibling).

reviews.author: Kristine Recabarren
reviews.text: Both of my boys have had their braces under the care of Dr. Burn. She truly cares about each of her patients and provides the best possible care.  Recently, my oldest son had an orthodontic emergency after hours. I called Dr. Burn and she met us at her office, along with one of her staff members at 8 pm that evening to administer treatment. The office staff is very friendly and gets to know each one of their clients.  I highly recommend Dr. Burn.

reviews.author: Sandy C
reviews.text: Dr. Burn and the staff is amazing. Dr. Burn explains everything when asked and is extremely talented. Her and her staff are super friendly and kind. Before my surgery, they did their best in comforting and supporting me. I would definitely recommend Dr. Burn.

reviews.author: Jonathan Blanco
reviews.text: Very kind and proffesional.

reviews.author: C U
reviews.text: Dr. Burn is very knowledgeable and I had a great experience with her. She is an excellent orthodontist and the staff are friendly. I recommend Dr. Burn and believe she is the best.

reviews.author: Mila Heerkens
reviews.text: Had a little trouble with my fixed retainer, as a traveller. We just walked in and they gladly had a spot for me. Very kind people, we need more of that in this world.

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.text: I came to Dr. Riolo after a general dentist attempted to expand my palate at 23 years old and introduced many asymmetries in my face (the picture of me in the purple shirt). In just 2 years, Dr. Riolo was able to finish my treatment and leave me with the beautiful smile I have now. He and his team were able to graciously guide me through the intimidating process of double jaw surgery, and I could not be happier with my results. He and his team are extremely kind, knowledgable, and efficient. I never had to wait for long times at appointments, and I always knew the next step/ had an appt set up before I left the office. It's obvious that Dr. Riolo cares a lot about his patients, his team, and practicing orthodontics at the highest standard. I cannot recommend Dr. Riolo and his team enough; they restored my smile and I absolutely love the result.

reviews.author: Dan J
reviews.text: I started treatment with Christ Riolo in 2021 and continued through 2023, and the experience has been devastating.In June 2023, he completely ruined my bite, leaving it uneven and open, which made basic functions like chewing, speaking, and even resting my jaw extremely difficult. His tooth-extraction-based treatment plan also caused me to develop severe TMJ issues and airway problems.My dental arch shrank significantly during treatment, leaving no space for my tongue and worsening my overall oral posture and comfort. I also suffered from major bone loss and gum recession.I raised these concerns multiple times—both in person and via email—but he consistently downplayed them and told me everything looked fine. How could I be “fine” when I was in constant discomfort and pain? It felt like my suffering was dismissed rather than acknowledged.Office visits were rushed, and sometimes he didn’t even see me at all. He was constantly juggling too many patients, and I never felt genuinely cared for.I’ve been physically and mentally miserable for over a year, and it’s taken me a long time to recover enough strength to write this. I’m sharing my story to warn others and hoping to help them avoid the pain I went through.That said, I’m finally feeling hopeful again. I’ve restarted orthodontic treatment with a new, responsible, and compassionate orthodontist, who truly listens and is working to fix my bite. I finally feel like I’m on the path to healing.

reviews.author: Matthew Lee
reviews.text: If you want braces but don't want anyone to know you have them, this is the place. Dr. Riolo has been doing this a long time and clearly knows what he's doing. My lower teeth were seriously crowded (crooked, overlapping, you name it), but after just 8 weeks in lingual braces they've already opened up and look better than ever, and I'm not even done with treatment yet. I highly recommend this place. My only complaint about Dr. Riolo is that he supports Michigan.

reviews.author: Victoria N
reviews.text: Orthodontal treatment is not for everyone.  Some people just need a surgery.

reviews.author: Andy Bean
reviews.text: Dr Riolo is the best orthodontist, hands down, I’ve ever had the pleasure of working with, and I’ve been to at least 3 different orthodontists with different treatments over many years. I had lingual braces, which I never tried before, but they worked great and nobody ever knew I had them. Dr Riolo doesn’t try to overengineer things, he listens to feedback, and uses the latest technology to really get down to the micro-adjustment level and takes the time to get things absolutely perfect. His staff is awesome too, very kind, very thorough, and extremely knowledgeable. Don’t go anywhere else. Your search is done!

reviews.author: Gary Smith
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his staff have been great. I wasn’t too interested in getting braces at 50, but after talking with them about their inside braces, I decided to go for it. The first few weeks took a little getting used to, but after that you completely forget they’re there—and the fact that no one can even tell you have them is pretty amazing.I highly recommend Riolo Orthodontics. They’ve been extremely prompt and professional throughout the whole process

reviews.author: Max Tomlinson
reviews.text: My permanent retainer broke at 10:30pm one evening. I am not a client of Mr. Riolo but I found his practice on google, his website mentioned a 24/7 emergency email. I sent him an email because my usual orthodontist is from an entirely different city, closed on weekends, and would take days to get me in, but I urgently needed somebody to remove the loose 1-inch wire hanging in my gums.Sure enough, I received an email from Mr. Riolo at 11:00pm on a Saturday, offering to get me in the next morning. I was in his practice the next morning getting the retainer removed and the concrete cleaned off my teeth.In genuinely one of the nicest things somebody has done for me, Mr. Riolo then told me I did not owe him anything. As of writing this I am in the process of moving which has not been cheap at all and I was very worried about the bill an emergency orthodontics service would cost me. To say I was shocked at being charged nothing is too little.I cannot recommend his practice enough.I also wish to thank the woman who assisted during this, at the same early morning time, I apologize for not remembering your name.

reviews.author: Lam Tran
reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience with Dr. Riolo and his entire team. From the very beginning, his expertise and forward-thinking approach truly set him apart—especially in recommending lingual braces. Throughout the entire process, no one could tell I was wearing braces, which was incredibly important to me and speaks to the level of precision and care in his work.Beyond the discreet treatment, the results were outstanding. Dr. Riolo and his team did an incredible job aligning my teeth, and I could not be happier with the outcome. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and commitment to excellence made the entire experience seamless and reassuring.What makes this practice even more special is the people. Dr. Riolo and his team are not only highly skilled, but genuinely kind, welcoming, and attentive. They create an environment where you feel cared for and supported every step of the way.My sister also had her braces done here and had an equally positive experience. It’s clear that they consistently go above and beyond for their patients.We are both extremely satisfied with the quality of care and results we received. I highly recommend Dr. Riolo for anyone considering orthodontic treatment—he is truly among the best in the field.

reviews.author: Alondra Rosales
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo is the best in Washington state, he explains every single detail and all your questions you have regarding braces. He is super sweet and funny, you won't go wrong going here. The best!!

reviews.author: Nick Jones
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo went above and beyond for me and really did a great job. I had a difficult adult case with bite issues and possible jaw surgery. Dr. Riolo worked with me and my dentist over the course of three years and helped me avoid having jaw surgery and ultimately I arrived at an outcome that I am very happy with. During this process, I was able to do all of my treatment using lingual braces and aligners, and because of that, I never had to worry about having any appearance issues while going through treatment.I would highly recommend Dr. Riolo. A+++

reviews.author: Allen Wang
reviews.text: Friendly staff, fast and efficient process, my teeth turned out great from the Invisalign

reviews.author: Andy Boes
reviews.text: I was referred to Dr. Riolo to help deal with alignment issues that caused serious wear and tear on my teeth. He got me set up with “lingual braces” (behind the teeth) to fix the problem. No one could even tell I had braces!More importantly, he was very responsive to questions and appointments, did high quality work, and got my underlying issue resolved ahead of schedule. I highly recommend his office.

reviews.author: Daniel Brigham
reviews.text: Being hesitant and also anxious to get braces as a 47 year old, Dr Riolo made the decision so easy for me. Its been a pleasure working with him and perfecting my smile. His staff is always very nice and very good at their jobs. I would recommend him to absolutely anyone needing Orthodontics.

reviews.author: ssurmic zen
reviews.text: As someone who was committed to getting lingual braces, my research made it clear that Dr. Riolo is the foremost expert in Seattle. His name came highly recommended from a couple of my UW friends, and after checking out his website and seeing the convenient location, I knew I had found the right place. Now, at the very end of my two-year treatment, I can confidently say that every bit of hype is absolutely deserved.From the moment you walk in, the staff is so welcoming and kind. It actually made me look forward to my visits (which is saying a lot for orthodontist appointments!). A special shout-out is absolutely necessary for Marlon, who was always there to help me with anything I needed, always with a smile and incredible patience. Thank you, Marlon!Now, for Dr. Riolo himself: he is a true artist and a perfectionist. The lingual braces were the perfect choice—all the power of traditional braces to fix serious alignment issues, but completely invisible. For me, it was a better fit than Invisalign, and I didn’t have to worry about the discipline of trays! Dr. Riolo is incredibly attentive to detail; he wasn't just moving teeth, he was crafting a perfect bite and a beautiful smile line. Every adjustment was precise and thoughtful.He is also wonderfully patient. We spent a lot of time on aftercare planning, and he was super helpful with referrals for a local dentist to make sure everything was coordinated including the extraction plan and everything. I also had a timeline I was hoping to meet, and he was so accommodated to. doc meticulously planned my treatment to expedite things where he safely could, which I am so grateful for.You are in the best hands here. The entire team is professional, warm, and brilliant. If you're considering orthodontic work, look no further than Riolo Orthodontics. Thank you for my new smile!P.S. Dr. Riolo – Go Blue! 〽️ It was so fun to discover our UMich connection!

reviews.author: alyx arteaga
reviews.text: I’ve had an excellent experience with Dr. Riolo and his team. They are professional, friendly, and truly care about their patients’ smiles. The process for my aligners has been smooth and well-explained, and I’ve seen great progress already. My wife also had her braces done here, and the results were fantastic. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality orthodontic care.

reviews.author: Leslie Ley
reviews.text: I got my retainers here and the whole experience was great. It was super easy to get in touch with the office because they replied quickly and made everything clear from the start. The staff was friendly and professional, and I felt really comfortable during the whole process. My retainers fit perfectly and it was all done quickly and smoothly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rex Reynolds
reviews.text: Riolo Orthodontics saved us.  We were traveling through Seattle and a wire broke on our daughter’s braces.  Dr. Riolo and his team were gracious to take us in and make the repair to the relief of our daughter.  Everyone was super kind and very professional.  Great location and beautiful offices as well!

reviews.author: Ed A
reviews.text: Very impressive office! I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: rene juarez
reviews.text: By luck I landed at Dr. Riolo's practice as I was a patient of another orthodontist who specialized in lingual braces in San Francisco. I had moved back to the Seattle area and was in need of a practitioner to help remove the lingual braces as they were almost done. I decided to finish my course of lingual braces with Dr. Riolo. I was and am consistently  impressed with his office team and his approach to lingual braces. He is an artist at making the best smiles possible! He was able to make improvements to my original orthodontic plan and gave me the smile of my dreams! Thank you Dr. Riolo! I am so fortunate to have been under your care and expertise! As someone who got braces later on in life ( I was 48 when I became a patient with Dr. Riolo), I am so glad I went with the lingual braces as they were not visible from the front of the teeth as they were behind my teeth. I am now in my 50's and I feel so much more confident with my smile and my bite.Thank you, Dr. Riolo and Team! You are the best!

reviews.author: Michelle Dellino
reviews.text: I needed braces to fix some bite issues and having a very client facing job did not feel getting the braces on the outside of my teeth like I had when I was a kid was not a viable option. I am so glad I found Dr. Riolo's office when searching for lingual braces. I have now been a patient at Riolo longer than I should be -- but that is my fault and not theirs! I think Dr. Riolo cares more about my bite alignment than I do. He has gone above and beyond to keep me on track, and get me the best possible results. Everyone at the office is friendly, efficient, and helpful. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Anita H.
reviews.text: DR. RIOLO TREATED MY TEETH LIKE THEY WERE HIS OWN, which honestly, I couldn’t appreciate more! Like, I swear, he put more care into my teeth than I do into my morning caffeine. His dedication to my smile went beyond what words can describe. He approached my teeth with the kind of care one might give to something they truly cherish—like a masterpiece they were perfecting, making sure no detail was overlooked. His constant reassurance and thoughtfulness made me feel like I wasn’t just another patient, but someone whose journey he was deeply invested in.My journey started in the fall of 2017 when I was referred to Dr. Riolo by a colleague in Seattle, where I began my adventure with SmileRunners (clear retainers), which I continued until the end of 2019. Then, COVID hit us all in 2020, and just before it reached Washington in March, Dr. Riolo informed me that the clear retainers weren't working and suggested I get braces. My front two teeth were like two mafia bosses, each trying to rule their own territory—constantly fighting for control, causing chaos and tension. It was like watching two rival families trying to take over the same street. In May 2020, I became a "metal mouth" once again (just like high school)—except this time, the entire world was locked down, so no one could see me. Perfect timing, right?I started visiting the Bellevue office, where Dr. Cousin was completing his residency. Slowly, he and Dr. Riolo began seeing me together. Every couple of months, I'd go in to get my bands changed and pick out fun colors for the season (red for Christmas, green for St. Paddy's Day, etc.). Fast forward to fall 2022, when my braces finally came off, and I was ecstatic! But life had other plans. I went back for a follow-up in spring 2023, and much to my surprise, I found myself back in braces (this time, just for the lower teeth). After many years of trial and error, both doctors worked tirelessly to figure out the root cause of my dental dilemma.Thanks to the incredible efforts of Dr. Riolo and Dr. Cousin, I am finally out of braces and into retainers, for good! I can’t thank them enough for their patience, expertise, and unwavering care throughout this entire journey.When I moved to a new location, Dr. Riolo made sure I was in great hands with Dr. Cousin, and I felt fully supported every step of the way. It’s been a long road, but I’m so grateful to them both. They made a sometimes frustrating process feel a lot easier and more manageable.Thank you, Dr. Riolo, for always listening and making sure my smile—and confidence—were taken care of every step of the way. Your care, kindness, and unwavering attention to detail have made all the difference, and I will always be grateful. God Bless!

reviews.author: Simon Dicé
reviews.text: Very smooth experience and very grateful for the level of care I received for my first set of braces at 33 years old. Was informed of all my options and really appreciated the guidance and tips for the whole process. Getting the braces on was so smooth I think I fell asleep halfway through for a little bit.

reviews.author: Bryan Johnston
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience from start to finish with Chris and his team. The staff were incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive. They explained every step of the process clearly and made sure I felt comfortable throughout. The results exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chris King
reviews.text: Riolo Orthodontics has been amazing. Being an adult with no dental insurance made it hard to find anyone to work with but that wasn't the case with Dr. Riolo. They are up front about treatment and didn't try to upsell me on procedures or things I did not need. They worked with my dentist the entire time and the office was clear in communicating and always responded quickly! I am in Redmond so I would visit their Bellevue office but I know that they have an office in Seattle that I could take the light rail to if needed. I want to thank Dr. Riolo and the entire team for their amazing work! I highly recommend Riolo Orthodontics to everyone in the Seattle and Eastside area that are looking at orthodontic work. I would especially suggest them to any adults that are looking at services like Invisalign and whose insurance most likely doesn't cover braces. Thanks again to Dr. Riolo and the entire team!!

reviews.author: Kristopher K
reviews.text: I moved back to Seattle from out of state with having braces on for two years continuing a lengthy and involved treatment. I found Riolo Orthodontics through Google after talking with two other places that wouldn't accept treating me between dental insurers. Dr. Riolo's office got me in very quickly to set up an initial appointment and took me on while I was uninsured. My case was unique and involved working with my general dentist, multiple oral surgeons, and a periodontist. The office always communicated effectively and accommodated any changes whether in scheduling or insurance and even a broken bracket that was fixed immediately the next day. Dr. Riolo was always helpful and made it a point to work as a team with the other specialists about working out the best long term solution to deal with my missing teeth. I am very thankful I found them and am grateful they took on a new patient, especially when most other offices would not consider someone continuing treatment or without a form of dental insurance. I'd highly recommend Riolo Orthodontics, especially for other adults that need orthodontic care and might not have dental insurance or have dental insurance that does not cover braces over a certain age.I must also point out that they have an office in Bellevue with free parking, making it easier if you are coming from the east side. Their office in downtown Seattle has a paid parking lot in the same building and is next to Pacific Place making it easy to take the metro bus or light rail to come in for an appointment.

reviews.author: Niko
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo is the best orthodontist and I highly recommend him. I went in as a 35 year old who had never had braces before. I didn’t want to have a mouth full of metal and the option to be able to have lingual braces behind my teeth was life changing. I had to have two years of corrective braces, but no one knew unless I would have told them. I absolutely love my smile and I have a lot of confidence with my teeth. My friends also noticed and went in as adults as well for the braces behind the teeth! I highly recommend making an appointment. He is the best.

reviews.author: Clio Herrera
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his team are nothing short of the best, and that’s exactly how I found them by searching through reviews to find the best and they did not disappoint. I had orthodontics throughout the pandemic and the team was always amazing, Dr. Riolo truly is an expert in his field. I receive constant compliments on my teeth and that is entirely largely due to the skill and dedication Dr. Riolo and his team put into their practice. If you are considering orthodontics in the Seattle area, I highly recommend Dr Riolo.

reviews.author: Yein Pyo
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his team are very professional and welcoming. Dr. Riolo is also very funny and meticulous, and he was willing to work within my financial constraints. I would highly recommend Dr. Riolo for any orthodontic needs!

reviews.author: Marco Lizarazo
reviews.text: I highly recommend Dr. Riolo for orthodontic care. I transferred from an out-of-country provider who recommended Invisalign aligners. Dr. Riolo was thorough and knowledgeable, always ensuring that I understood each procedure. Dr. Riolo provided me with exceptional care. He and his staff are "patient-centric" and warm. Thank you for your kindness and professionalism.

reviews.author: Ann McNally
reviews.text: Easy to work with - reasonable folks. And my son now has straight teeth! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cassaundra Moore
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo,Is an amazing person first and foremost, he was always inviting and honest. I went to Dr. R. after three other orthos failed my teen son. He was always open and honest about charges, and goals. He maid my son feel comfortable and excited again about getting the braces off. They set a goal together for 6 months and both did their part to complete it. Dr. R. made sure we were equipped with all that is needed for my son to maintain great smile. I would recommend Dr. R. 10 times over. I don’t write reviews and it took me forever to get this one done, but it’s been on my mind when I see my son smile. Hope this helps you make the right decision and choose Dr. R. and his awesome team for your goals too.

reviews.author: Nicolas
reviews.text: Got lingual braces from this office and it was an excellent experience. Dr. Riolo runs a tight ship, and was very accommodating throughout the years.

reviews.author: caleb rodgers
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Riolo Orthodontics as they helped fix long standing issues I had. I needed lingual braces which was new to me but couldn’t be happier I went that route. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing assistance with dental work. They have a great team and Dr. Riolo is very great at what he does!

reviews.author: Chua Zheng Yang
reviews.text: Amazing service. One of my braces chain fell out and as I’m going through braces treatment overseas, I couldn’t approach my own orthodontist. I had to circle through many clinics, many of whom rejected me citing the need for appointment and lack of tools. However, Riolu Orthodontics not only fixed it for me immediately, they did so free of charge as well. Very impressive and accommodating service to a foreigner.

reviews.author: Kristina Campbell
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his team have exceeded my expectations in delivering exceptional care throughout my treatment with lingual braces. Dr. Riolo took the time to thoroughly explain my treatment options, ensuring I fully understood the benefits and potential drawbacks of each. Thanks to his expertise, my teeth now look amazing!Furthermore, despite my demanding work schedule, Dr. Riolo's office consistently accommodated my needs by efficiently scheduling appointments and prioritizing urgent matters. The entire staff is not only friendly but also highly professional, contributing to a welcoming atmosphere. Without hesitation, I wholeheartedly recommend Riolo Orthodontics to anyone seeking top-notch orthodontic care.

reviews.author: Nanna Taralesca
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his team are amazing. I came to this team with a complicated case which required input from multiple specialists. I moved forward with using lingual braces. They were amazing. As an adult who spends a lot of time on camera for work, It was important for me to have low-detection style braces. Dr. Riolo really worked with me to help decide which type of braces make the most sense me. Truly, from the first appointment to when I had my braces removed, It was clear that my case was met with personalized attention and care. If you want dedicated care, highly qualified doctors running your treatment plan, modern and non-invasive technical tools, and friendly experts, then this is the place for you. Highly recommend Dr. Riolo for minimal or highly complex orthodontics needs.

reviews.author: Cameron Lowell
reviews.text: Nothing but great things to say about Dr. Riolo and his staff. Had some minor work done and he was communicative and trustworthy all the way through the process. Thanks!

reviews.author: Leah Kindred
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his team are absolutely incredible! He is so knowledgable and patient, and makes sure you understand what's going on for every step along the way. The assistants are kind and welcoming, and are tremendously knowledgable as well. My confidence has skyrocketed because of my new smile and I cannot thank Dr. Riolo and his team enough!

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.text: I began my relationship with Dr Riolo and his team in 2021 following a necessary Bi-maxillary Osteotomy performed by my oral surgeon. My treatment was long and extensive including Lingual braces as well as  Invisalign.Dr Riolo and his team put me at ease and held my hand through my difficult recovery process and orthodontic journey.From the front office to his orthodontic assistants I have always received great customer service and exceptional care. They also have a few locations which makes scheduling more flexible and accommodating.Dr Riolo is thoughtful, meticulous, focused on perfect results and at the same time fun and friendly. He always took time to explain each step of treatment and why it was necessary. My treatment is almost finished and I will be recommending Dr Riolo and his team long after my treatment is over. My results exceeded my expectations and I am grateful for their care.

reviews.author: Juju
reviews.text: The reason I got braces as an adult was because I was self conscious about my canine that was crooked. They told me it would only take 1 year of braces. After two years, I got my braces off and the canine was still a little crooked. When I pointed this out, they said it wasn’t that noticeable and the rest of my teeth lined up really well. The rest of my teeth had always lined up well. After paying $4000 out of pocket and suffering though the pain of braces for 2 years, I thought I would at least get the thing I came in for fixed…

reviews.author: Max P
reviews.text: Doctor Riolo and his staff have been the most professional, patient, understanding and honest set of individuals I have ever encountered.It all started when one of my friend’s recommended Dr. Riolo for his amazing skills as an Orthodontist.When I first met up with Dr. Riolo, he took his time with explaining the whole process from A to Z about Lingual Braces. The quote he said that stood out for me was that “my teeth may not be perfect but they will look MUCH BETTER”. Considering how crooked my teeth were, the progress was as perfect as it could get.Immediately along with his assistant Cali we created an action plan for my teeth. I got my teeth scanned and before I knew it I had Lingual Braces. Every couple weeks I had my adjustments and all of my concerns were promptly addressed.Another example of how amazing Dr. Riolo is, one time I was on a jet ski and my bracket popped open. It was a Sunday morning and I texted Dr. Riolo about what had happened. He came on his day off on Sunday night and opened his practice just to fix my bracket. That incident showed me that Dr. Riolo truly cares for his patients and is a man of his word. Towards the end of my treatments I requested a few of my teeth to be reshaped and once again Dr. Riolo made it happen while making my teeth look exceptional. I always felt very understood.As a healthcare worker myself I can honestly say that Dr. Riolo does an outstanding job and goes above and beyond  at being a MASTER AT HIS CRAFT. He didn’t only forever change my smile but also my life.

reviews.author: Susan Steinborn
reviews.text: A great experience as an older adult patient.  I would give 10 stars if I could.  Dr. Riolo is so very competent and knowledgeable, he watched over every step of my treatment and the staff was wonderful and very well trained.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Victoria C.
reviews.text: What a great experience! A few years ago I was searching for an orthodontist and made a great decision by going to Riolo.  The staff is so friendly and pleasant, Dr. Riolo is absolutely wonderful and the office is modern with high tech and modern!  I was very impressed.  I highly recommend Dr. Riolo!

reviews.author: Tessa Griffin
reviews.text: I rarely leave online reviews, but Dr. Riolo is a true 5 star experience. For all of you that got braces when you were little and need them again. Or those that don't want to deal with traditional braces in the middle of your career. Me too - and thank goodness I was referred to Riolo.I did lingual braces and couldn't have had a better experience. Did you know Dr. Riolo is famous in the dental world for using cutting edge technology to make the braces experience faster/easier/cheaper? My neighbors who are dentists fangirled that I was getting his treatment plan.You get used to them quickly and no one will know you have braces unless you tell them (truly, I had to actually tell people I had them when I was feeling self-conscious that they might have noticed).Outside of just the dental experience Dr. Riolo is super warm & engaging, with a talented/kind/flexible staff, and a convenient/elegant office blocks from Amazon in SLU. Oh, and did I mention they have an amazing payment plan?I can't think of a single bad thing to say. Go get your teeth fixed by Dr. Riolo. :-D

reviews.author: Patrice
reviews.text: I'm so happy to have my teeth aligned.  Dr Riolo saw me on each visit, and his staff was friendly and thorough.

reviews.author: Matthew B
reviews.text: Orthodontic care is not just about the final result, it's about the process of getting there. The procedures may take years and can be difficult for many children. Dr. Riolo and his staff are not just a great orthodontics team, they are compassionate and emotionally intelligent. They put a lot of effort into creating the best experience possible for their patients.This team has cared for all 3 of our children. Their smiles look great AND the experience was positive for each child.At every single appointment (for 3 kids over 7 years) the doctor and his staff were kind, patient and flexible, meeting each child where they were at the time. If the child was anxious or worried, they were treated with understanding and compassion while their needs and concerns were fully addressed. When necessary, the process was adapted to better support the child.One of our children has special needs and sensory processing issues and had a lot of anxiety about the orthodontic process. Because of this, the process took more than a year longer than it normally would have and required many more appointments. Dr. Riolo and his staff were unfailingly supportive and understanding throughout the entire process.Never once was our daughter made to feel uncomfortable because of her special needs, nor were we as parents. And we were never charged a penny more for all of the extra time and effort the team invested to ensure a great outcome for her.This doctor is an artist. His team is composed of compassionate professionals. I cannot imagine a better orthodontic experience for our children.

reviews.author: Brian Dahmen
reviews.text: Dr Riolo and his staff are great! I love my results and am glad I chose Dr Riolo after shopping around. This was all before the pandemic, and I paid upfront. During all the upheaval he went above and beyond the original treatment schedule and made his focus ensuring my teeth turned out great.His office staff share a good rapport, and I always felt comfortable in his office. Glad I made the right decision, in treatment and doctor.

reviews.author: Jerry Berger
reviews.text: Greetings!  After completing my orthodontic treatment I want to share my extremely positive experience with Dr. Chris Riolo and his Seattle team.From day one I knew I was in the best of hands--not only was everyone technically superb, with cutting edge tech,  but an unexpected bonus was the TLC (tender loving care for those who've never experienced it) from each and ever staff member.High tech and high touch!  Too often these are woefully separate experiences.  Advanced technical proficency doesn't always come with a high level of empathy or even basic human understanding.  (Left brain / right brain?)In my time, I have been around the block many times with dental professionals--and believe me,  I know the best when I find one--when I actually look forward to and enjoy the appointments.In all honesty, I can't recommend a course of ortho to absolutely everyone whether they need it or not--but for those who are contemplating this path--my praise for the Riolo team experience is absolute.  You will be thrilled with your decision, as I have been.

reviews.author: Steven Hooper
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo is, hands down, the BEST orthodontist for busy people and working professionals. He and his dedicated team are extremely client-oriented and ensure you get the optimal outcome. I had a lingual braces treatment to fix years of grinding, and it was so unobtrusive that several friends had no idea I was going through the treatment. I would highly recommend at least meeting Dr. Riolo for a consultation, as his approach and demeanor inspires a lot of confidence in the process and the ultimate outcome.

reviews.author: Kenneth Strange
reviews.text: I got braces through Riolo Orthodontics from July 2020 through January 2023.They were very professional through the entire process and I left with a new and refreshing smile!

reviews.author: Jennifer Naimy
reviews.text: People seem moved to write reviews when they're extremely happy or extremely unhappy with a practice. I fall into the first category. From start to finish, Dr. Riolo was warm, friendly and thoughtful and went out of his way to provide excellent care. In the pre-vaccine Covid months, he opened his office after hours to help me protect my immuno-compromised husband. Later, when I flip-flopped on a decision to do restorative work--prolonging my orthodonture by six months--he didn't charge for the extra time. His focus was always on making sure I had the best possible outcome. The only negative in this whole process is I can't seem to stop smiling at my teeth in the mirror. I truly didn't imagine the outcome would be as good as it is.

reviews.author: Kellee M. Franklin
reviews.text: It was a joy working with the entire Riolo Orthodontic team in Seattle! I am so pleased with the results of my lingual braces to correct an adjustment to my teeth from an earlier orthodontic treatment as a teen. The procedures were made easy by the friendly Riolo team and their innovative suite of options, including SprintRay 3D technologies — and the lingual braces did not interfere with my ability to conduct my professional responsibilities that involved public speaking and high visible, in-person and virtual client interactions. I highly recommend anyone seeking orthodontic care to check out Riolo Orthodontics — you will find an exceptional patient experience with excellent dental results!

reviews.author: William Broadnax
reviews.text: Dr Riolo and his staff are amazing. They provided a plan and cost up front, and it was better than they initially planned. They follow up and checked in often, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The follow on support is also something I didn’t expect. Best Ortho in Seattle 😁.

reviews.author: Tanya Gardanar
reviews.text: During the pandemic Dr. Riolo worked closely with my husband's dentist to ensure the ultimate orthodontics care.  The staff is amazing and they were always able to accommodate scheduling.  I highly recommend Dr. Riolo.  Your smile will never look better.

reviews.author: Maria Jimenez
reviews.text: This is one very happy client of Dr Riolo’s. He and the excellent office team work tirelessly making sure everything is perfect. My teeth are finally functioning properly. Follow up visits included in the fee, ensure optimal results.

reviews.author: hyunkyong shin
reviews.text: Great customer service from Sarah!!Answers were clear and where necessary detailed enough for us to make informed decisions quickly!! Highly recommend this place . Made my day definitely!

reviews.author: Jose Castrillo
reviews.text: Excellent professional and Human being! I was on vacation in Seattle and a bracket fell off. I´m from outside the US and I was worried on how expensive would changing a bracket be. Dr. Riolo and his amazing staff didn´t charge me and did an amazing job so that my treatment wouldn´t be impacted. I made sure my dentist back home pays it off, and If I get to go back to Seattle longer I´d definately carry on my treatment with Dr. Riolo.

reviews.author: Natalya V Kaverina
reviews.text: I have been a patient of Dr. Riolo for two years and have been very satisfied with his work. I have found him  to be both an exceptionally competent orthodontist and uncommonly caring professional.  He is very skillful in maximizing patient comfort during orthodontic procedures. I should add that he takes the time needed to answer questions and discuss treatment matters in a way that is easy to understand and gives me confidence that my decisions about treatment options are well informed. Also, I have found Dr. Riolo's staff consistently friendly and helpful. I highly recommend the services of Dr. Riolo and his  staff.

reviews.author: Sierra Discolo
reviews.text: I cannot speak more highly of Dr. Riolo and his staff. When I came highly referred to Dr. Riolo I was scared as I do not like the dentist or any dental work. I was greeted by Kristy warmly and was immediately felt at home. Kristy could sense I was nervous and she went out of her way to make sure I was comfortable and at place. When I finally met Dr. Riolo I was at ease. He is extremely professional and made my comfort his priority. He in detail examined me and detailed what my life with braces would be like. 12 months later I would not be more thankful. I felt out of place being an adult getting braces but once I had them I wanted to be an ally. I was always welcome and rooted on for the next step and for that I am forever grateful.

reviews.author: Becky Sturgis
reviews.text: Look no further!! You will not find a more experienced, caring and thorough team than Dr. Riolo and his staff. From the first consultation it's clear they lead the way in their industry and I'm so thankful to benefit from their passion.I'm a 30yo woman who wanted straight teeth but didn't want to shamelessly rock the braces look or deal with the hassle of invisalign. I didn't even know lingual braces (braces behind your teeth) were possible! Such a great decision and I would recommend it to anyone. The compliments I get on my smile now never get old. :)

reviews.author: אלכס ס
reviews.text: We are tourists staying in Seattle before our Alaskan cruise. Yesterday we needed an emergency fix in our son’s invisible braces. We called dr. Riolo’s clinic who agreed to see and help us with no appointment. Dr. Riolo was super nice and professional, fixed the problem in no time and we were on our way to continue our trip. Thank you so much for your kindness and expertise. Like our son said- I wish we had them back home. This is a reason to move to Seattle... totally recommended!!!!!!

reviews.author: Mary Beth Ringer
reviews.text: Incredible, compassionate help for us getting a retainer replaced on a tight timeline! I was bowled over by the caring response given to a brand new client! Thank you!

reviews.author: Chris M
reviews.text: Excellent service from entire team. Dr. Riolo and his colleagues are very approachable and highly proficient in orthodontics. Location is conveniently located in the same place as my dentist at the Medical Dental Building in downtown Seattle. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: A B
reviews.text: Had a great experience and the staff was incredibly helpful. Thanks team :)

reviews.author: Valerie Key
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience getting some new retainers made! So fast, and love that they use digital imaging instead of the old plaster molds to create the trays...a much more pleasant session!  Entire staff is friendly and very accommodating on scheduling visits.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gail Morrison
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo and his staff did a wonderful job correcting my bite.  I was skeptical as this was my third time getting braces, first as an adult.  But, the professional team at Dr. Riolo's office made the process smooth, painless and easy.  I actually looked forward to my office visits because everyone is friendly, the office is beautiful and Dr. Riolo has a great sense of humor.  Dr. Riolo is super approachable and super smart.  I was worried that my recent diagnosis of periodontal disease would make it more difficult to straighten my bike.  But, Dr. Riolo created a solution specifically for my situation and took great care of my teeth, gums and bite.   I strongly recommend Dr. Riolo and his excellent team.

reviews.author: Scott Moore
reviews.text: We are visiting Seattle on vacation and my son's braveb needed some repair. Dr Riolo took care of us right away for no charge and could not have been nicer. I wish we could clone him and bring him to Atlanta. Thanks so much.

reviews.author: Lisa Alvarez
reviews.text: Great staff very friendly and knowledgeable of their craft. Dr Riolo did a great job... 😊 & I love the choice of music in the waiting room. Great team, I definitely would recommend. Jasmine was very helpful with getting me started on my treatment. Looking forward to a beautiful smile.

reviews.author: Cindy Kang
reviews.text: I had lingual braces, which involved implants-dr.riolo helped me make the right decision and helped coordinating with my other dental office! Dr. Riolo and his assistants are super friendly! But scheduling with front desk is extremely difficult and inflexible.

reviews.author: Faiza Khalid
reviews.text: I've been to multiple orthodontists since age 9 (now 21), had headgear, expander and multiple braces through out the years and have not had an experience with an orthodontist that has been as attentive or personable as Riolo's office. Absolutely, genuine, extremely detail oriented and wants nothing but what is best for his patients. I had many insecurities with my teeth and was ready to get complete veneers however, my dentist recommended me to see Riolo about braces and Invisalign beforehand. My issues with my teeth were not an easy fix and I've been consistently amazed and excited by the amount of detail and care he's put into my Ortho treatment the past year. My braces treatment required a lot of technique and close attention every appointment and it was very priceless that Dr.Riolo was nothing more than ready and excited to do it. His expertise has transformed my teeth and I actually don't need to think about getting veneers anymore which would've been much more costly. The office and the dental assistants are absolutely the loveliest and patient on answering all of my questions and making my appointments. Having had experiences with quite a few other orthodontists I'm super excited whenever I get the chance to recommend Dr. Riolo. For anyone looking for orthodontic treatment I know they'll be in the best care when I tell them about his office.

reviews.author: Michael Ducharme
reviews.text: Dr. Riolo is awesome. We were visiting from Northern California and my sons permanent retainer came unattached on one side on the weekend. Dr. Riolo responded promptly via e-mail during the weekend and set up an appointment at 9am Monday to be seen. We filled out the heath questionnaire online prior to coming in and Dr. Riolo resolved the issue perfectly. He is a life saver.

reviews.author: Vanessa Jackson
reviews.text: We were on vacation in Seattle and my son's wire came out of his bracket and was bothering him. We went to Riolo Orthodontist hoping they could help us. Not only did they fix his wire but they got him in quickly and they didn't charge us either. The staff is amazing and they went above and beyond to help us. Thank you, you guys are awesome!!

reviews.author: Camelia Espahbod
reviews.text: As an orthodontist treated by another orthodontist, I must say that I received nothing but high quality care. If you are looking for an experienced, detail oriented orthodontist who delivers excellent treatment quality I highly recommend Dr Riolo. With his clinical and teaching experience, attentiveness and being a good listener he makes sure your concerns are being addressed properly. Additionally, I must admire him for staying up-to-date with the latest technology that helps deliver better treatment. He utilizes a variety of treatment techniques which allows him to deliver fine customized treatment for each patient.My 1.5 year treatment was recently completed and my bite feels much better. I am very happy that I proceeded with the treatment and chose him as my orthodontist. Oftentimes, I consult my patients orthodontic cases with him and consider him an expert in the field of orthodontics.

reviews.author: Josh Haberman
reviews.text: I'm about to get my braces off, which means I've been going to Dr. Riolo's office for almost two years. Here are all the reasons I highly recommend this place!1. Dr. Riolo does top-notch work. I'm not an orthodontist, so how do I know this? Well one time I was in London and a wire came loose. I went to see an orthodontist there to patch me up. When he was finished this British doctor told me how impressed he was at how my braces were set up, and to give Dr. Riolo his compliments. That's when I knew that Dr. R is at the top of his game.2. The office is super responsive at getting you in if something is bothering you. When you have braces, it's a fact of life that things come loose sometimes. Every single time this happened, they have gotten me in there in 24 or 48 hours max, even if I told them it wasn't that big of a deal. I seriously appreciate this. They make you feel like your well-being is a priority.3. The people in the office are incredibly friendly and fun. This is going to sound cheesy, but when I go in for an appointment it doesn't feel like a dentist appointment, it feels like I'm going to hang out with my friends. When you're going in every six weeks, this makes such a difference!So if you're thinking about braces in Seattle, definitely check this place out!

reviews.author: Philip Benenati
reviews.text: growing up I hated going to the orthodontist.  as an adult now, I had to go in unexpectedly for a broken built-in retainer and it was an amazing experience.  they were able to work me in right away and the visit was one the friendliness and most trustworthy health care visits I've ever had.  excellent staff and beautiful facility.  would recommend this to anyone.

reviews.author: Angela Varachi
reviews.text: Chris Riolo and team really know what they're doing!  The treatment is fantastic and everyone is personable and for what I'm having done, it's extremely affordable!I started with Riolo Orthodontics last May.  After one consultation we decided to being with Incognito braces and this has been the most phenomenal experience.  I had *what I think* is a fairly complicated situation and Dr. Riolo has timed everything perfectly so that I had braces on, started movement, had a tooth extraction and he placed a pontic (false tooth) in it's place on the brace wire.  Not a single person has ever thought my teeth were not exactly as they were supposed to be.  Dr. Riolo cut the pontic to look exactly like it's matching eye tooth and it fits in perfectly on the Incognito Braces.  It is impossible to tell that it's 1.NOT MY TOOTH and 2.That I have braces holding it on!  We're finishing up lateral angular movement with elastics and once there is alignment I will have the screws placed for my implant and we will hide that with the pontic for a bit longer until the actual crown can be placed.  I'm pretty sure that even after I have completed treatment I will keep going in their office just to stop by and say hi because of how wonderful everyone has been!

reviews.author: chelsie davis
reviews.text: While growing up I was often made fun of for how my teeth looked. I grew to become extremely self-conscious of smiling and would only give a slight grin to ensure my teeth were not seen. I thought there was not any hope for teeth as crazy as mine to ever be fixed. However, after being blessed by the skills of Dr.Riolo, my smile is now what I am endlessly complimented on. I feel much happier and more confident having undergone the orthodontic handiwork of Chris. I smile at every moment possible and could not be more satisfied. The service provided was amazing- I always felt at ease in the office, while Dr.Riolo's warming personality brought a level of comfort. The process of braces was one that went smoothly and has yielded results that have changed my life.

reviews.author: Rachel Daliva
reviews.text: I am getting Invisalign through Dr. Riolo's office and I couldn't be happier with their support throughout the process. Their office is very easy to find, and although it is right downtown, parking is quite easy to find right by the building. The staff are very welcoming and down to earth, making the office environment comfortable and relaxing, yet very professional at the same time. I had many questions about the process and their explanations were clear, allowing me to trust in their work. The office had a few patients being worked on while I was there, but I never felt ignored or neglected as a client. Overall, I would definitely recommend this orthodontic clinic!

reviews.author: Amy Clem
reviews.text: I've been working with Dr. Riolo for about a year now and I couldn't be happier. I'm almost finished with treatment and am totally satisfied with the results. It has been an easy and nearly painless process to have the smile I've always wanted.Here's one reason I'm grateful I ended up in his office and not where I had done a previous consultation:Dr. Riolo saw a unique way for me to utilize Invisalign but their automated treatment plan system kept rejecting it. Because his method offered optimal results in the most efficient way, he went to bat for me and made numerous phone calls until he reached a human being that could fulfill the treatment plan he prescribed. As a health care practitioner myself, I know how time consuming and frustrating these computer systems can be, and any doctor who is willing to take their own time to make sure their patient gets the best care should be recognized.

reviews.author: Roger Duthie
reviews.text: My family and I were in Seattle mid August on a holiday from Dubai. I had been wearing braces for 1.5 years. They only came off a month prior to my trip.  I was on my holiday when it broke.  A gap started to appear in between my two front teeth much to my dismay. I was really stuck and needed some assistance.We found Dr. Riolo's clinic and I have to say he was wonderful. He could tell I was upset by the situation and he immediately took my booking. When I got to his clinic he met me and proceeded to make me feel at ease. He made two new retainers for me and did not charge me through the roof. Dr. Riolo was professional, courteous but most importantly he understood exactly what I needed and made me feel better about my situation. I would strongly recommend Dr.Riolo and anyone of his team members.  Thank you so much Dr.Riolo and team!!Louise HodgeDubai

xu qian dds ms phd pllc.note: xu qian dds ms phd pllc

reviews.author: Hailey L
reviews.text: Dr. Sue and her team are awesome! I'm in the middle of my treatment right now, and the progress has been great. Comparing my teeth now to when I first started, the improvement is really clear. Really appreciate their care throughout the process!

reviews.author: lingyun jiao
reviews.text: Great experience and wonderful team！慕名带着侄女和侄子来看Dr. Sue，接触之后感觉她很真诚而且非常地专业。很多问题一眼就能抓住重点，解释得非常清楚，细节考虑得也很周到，让人安心。孩子也很喜欢这里，跟外国助理聊天聊得可开心了，一点不紧张。诊所环境特别好，设备和和材料都很先进，搜了一下都是最顶级的品牌，很放心，治疗价格也好，位置方便停车免费。非常推荐！!

reviews.author: Jiuju Huang
reviews.text: We've had a wonderful experience with Sunny Smiles Ortho for both of our kids' orthodontic treatment. reviews.text: I discovered Sunny Smiles through a referral from our family dentist, and I’m so glad I did. I can’t say how happy I am with my teeth right now. I got my braces off couple years ago, and I still think she did an amazing job. She is amazing. Beside the technical skill, she is also a very nice and kind person. She is friendly. She wants to get to know her patient, not just in and out for the appointment. I can’t recommend her enough.

reviews.author: K Evergreen
reviews.text: I’ve been a patient of Dr. Su for nearly two years now. Prior to seeing her, I had two other consultations, both of which recommended only Invisalign. Dr. Su, however, was the first to suggest braces as well as the removal of two upper molars to correct my overbite. She provided a thorough and detailed explanation of her recommendation, which made me feel confident moving forward with her plan despite my initial skepticism.Throughout my treatment, she even accounted for my pregnancy, ensuring that my care was adapted to my circumstances. Now, almost two years later, the results have been remarkable. My profile has significantly improved, my teeth no longer clash as they used to, I can sleep with my mouth closed, and my overall appearance feels more balanced—all thanks to her expertise.I have just a few months left in my treatment, and I plan to share before-and-after photos of the transformation. Dr. Su’s care has been nothing short of exceptional.

I never felt like I was having particular treatments "pushed" upon me, Dr. Cousins is very up-to-date on all of the recent research in various techniques and can truly talk through the pros and cons of each approach. I never felt in the dark, it was a real team effort.The staff throughout the practice are all very warm and professional. reviews.author: Y Z
reviews.text: My experience with Bellevue Orthodontics has been excellent! Dr. Cousin is very professional, friendly, and listens to my concerns. The assistants are also very good at their job, each treatment session was quick and hassle-free. I got the traditional braces for 1.5 years, and I'm happy with the results!

reviews.author: Minh-Thu Nguyen
reviews.text: While searching for an orthodontist to help with my teeth, I came across Bellevue Orthodontics’ website. After reading all the great reviews from previous patients, I decided to give them a try—and I couldn’t be happier with my choice!I originally had an overbite and wasn’t confident in my smile because of my gummy smile. My plan was to get braces first and then possibly a gum reduction. But to my surprise, the braces alone made a huge difference and helped fix my gummy smile! I’ve had braces before, but they never addressed this issue. Under the care of Dr. Cousin and his amazing team, my gummy smile is no longer a problem. I’m so happy with the results and how much my smile has improved. I highly recommend Dr. Cousin if you’re looking for an orthodontist who truly cares about giving you the best results!

reviews.author: Anita H.
reviews.text: Where do I even begin?My orthodontic saga started in the fall of 2017 when a colleague in Seattle referred me to Dr. Riolo. I embarked on my journey with smile runners (a fancy name for clear retainers), diligently wearing them until the end of 2019. Then, like a plot twist no one saw coming, COVID hit in 2020. But just before the world shut down, Dr. Riolo hit me with some hard truth—my front two teeth were like stubborn siblings, constantly fighting and trying to return to their “default settings.” His solution? Braces. Again.So in May 2020, I officially became a metal mouth (for the second time in my life)—except this time, I was not a high school teenager, just an adult with questionable luck. But hey, at least the whole world was locked up, so no one could really see me.This is where Dr. Cousin enters the scene. I started visiting the Bellevue office, where he was completing his residency, and soon, both Dr. Riolo and Dr. Cousin were tag-teaming my teeth. Every couple of months, I would go in, get my bands changed, and of course, pick colors that matched the season—red for Christmas, green for St. Paddy’s Day, spooky black and orange for Halloween. It became a ritual, a part of my life.Fast forward two years—fall of 2022—the braces finally came off! I was thrilled, my teeth were free, and I felt victorious. But life loves a good plot twist. I went back for a follow-up in spring 2023, and Dr. Cousin took one look and, with his usual kindness, gently broke the news—“We’re not done just yet.” Back in braces I went—lower ones this time.Honestly, if it had to come from anyone, I was glad it was him—because somehow, even bad news sounded almost poetic when he said it, like something out of a classic French novel. There was a certain grace in the way he explained things, a calm reassurance that made it feel less like a setback and more like a necessary step toward perfection. So, back in braces I went—lower ones this time.With every visit, every adjustment, Dr. Cousin’s patience and precision made me feel like my teeth weren’t just being corrected—they were being carefully refined. And finally, after all the persistence and dedication from both Dr. Riolo and Dr. Cousin, we reached the grand finale—I am now officially braces-free and in retainers for good!Throughout this journey, Dr. Riolo and Dr. Cousin have been more than just orthodontists. They are kind, personable, and incredibly skilled—never making me feel like just another patient, never over-explaining things like I’m clueless, but also never under-explaining things like I’m not worth the details. They truly care, and that makes all the difference.I have been struggling with my teeth for 15 long years, and now, because of them, that struggle is finally over. I am beyond grateful. I adore them both—their expertise, their humor, their care. And if I’m being honest, I always looked forward to my appointments. Their office felt like home, their staff felt like family. But alas, all good things must come to an end.That said, if I ever lose my retainer (knocks on wood), I know they’re just a call—and a 45-minute drive through Seattle traffic—away. And trust me, that drive is worth it. From the bottom of my heart, thank you, Dr. Riolo & Dr. Cousin. You didn’t just fix my teeth—you gave me confidence, comfort, and a reason to smile. Forever grateful.Adieu, et que la vie vous soit douce. À chaque rendez-vous, vous avez démontré une expertise exceptionnelle et une gentillesse rare. Votre professionnalisme et votre attention m'ont fait me sentir écoutée et en confiance à chaque étape du processus. Vous avez non seulement transformé mon sourire, mais aussi perfectionné mes dents grâce à la magie de vos mains. Si jamais je négligeais leur éclat, les dieux eux-mêmes me rappelleraient l’effort que vous avez mis dans chaque détail. Je vous chérirai toujours pour le soin que vous avez apporté à mon sourire. Merci pour tout. Que le Seigneur vous bénisse.

reviews.author: Mallory Smith
reviews.text: DON'T HESITATE; CALL HIS OFFICE NOW! Dr. Cousin and his whole team are a complete joy and very down to earth. I had a difficult time trying to find a orthodontist willing to work with me as a transfer case (I had been in braces for almost 2 years already). --- While other offices wanted to charge me $2-4k above what I had already paid for my treatment in Maryland, Dr. Cousin took the time to consult with my previous orthodontist and craft an ambitious plan to reach my goal at a reasonable price. He was honest with me that the plan was ambitious and I may need additional treatment, but we could see how far we could get and take a call once we were at 6mos. He worked his magic and I was diligent about my care (rubber bands etc) and my braces were removed after 6mos as planned! I am SO HAPPY with my results and the thorough care to get my smile perfect and STAY perfect!!! Throughout my treatment with Dr. Cousin, he took time to educate me and share the latest research. He also recommended me to a great Dentist so I could get great all around care. 1000% Recommend!

reviews.text: I highly recommend Dr. Cousin and the team at Bellevue Orthodontics. I came from a history of troubled teeth that did not like to cooperate. The attention to the details of my care/treatment were really appreciated on my end.The entire process was smooth, the care was attentive, high quality, effective, and professional. I never felt rushed and the staff in the office are incredibly friendly and easy to talk to.

reviews.author: John Menter
reviews.text: Ever since I was young, I had a significant gap between my front teeth.  It always bothered me, and I was very self-conscience when taking pictures.  At 46, I had assumed I was too old to correct it.  However, on advice from my dentist, I went in and saw Dr. Cousin to see what could be done to correct it.  He gave me a comprehensive treatment plan that involved significantly shifting my teeth to close the gap and fix several other issues.  I now have a smile I am proud to show off!What impressed me most about Dr. Cousin is that his 1st, 2nd, and 3rd priorities throughout my entire treatment was doing an outstanding job.  This really showed up as I had a regression in my bottom canine tooth 6 months after finishing my original treatment, and Dr. Cousin sole focus was on fixing the issue without charge.Finally, I felt so good about Dr. Cousin's work that when my son needed orthodontics, without hesitation, I send him to him.  Before my daughter had gone to Advanced Orthodontics in Bellevue and my experience with that business was significantly worse.Thank you Dr. Cousin and the Bellevue Orthodontics team!

A year and a half later, I've finally wrapped up my second stint with braces and couldn't be happier!Each step of the way, Dr. Cousin and his team were happy to assist and answer any questions I had. Before my treatment even began, Dr. Cousin explained what makes a great smile, how he was planning to shift my teeth, and how that would culminate into having a better smile. Before any major adjustment, he was always attentive to any concerns I had and made sure I was on board before proceeding. His team was excellent as well, as I enjoyed chatting with Sarah and Vickie whenever I had my monthly appointments. I'm thrilled with the results from my treatment, and I'm really thankful for Dr. Cousin and his team for their great work!Whether you're a parent looking to have their child get braces for the first time, or an adult going in for a second round of orthodontic treatment like myself, I'd wholeheartedly recommend going to Bellevue Orthodontics.

Let me just say, I could not be happier with my results!! My teeth are perfectly straight and my bite is back to normal. I was able to do all the work through Invisalign, which was an added bonus (to not need braces at 30 years old). Dr. Cousin was fantastic to work with throughout the entire process. reviews.author: Barbara Odell
reviews.text: I've been seeing Dr.Timothee Cousin for nearly 2 years for my braces and I was beyond impressed with the whole experience. I came in feeling anxious about getting braces and Dr.Cousin put me at ease by listening to my concerns and reassuring me everything will be fine. He would explain every step of the process and I could just tell how passionate he is about his work by watching him get excited showing me some of the technology and what kind of results I would get from it. Not only is he knowledgeable, he is also a caring person who would go out of his way to make sure his patients are taken care of. I remember reaching out to him at a very inconvenient time in the morning about some pain in my mouth and he called me right away to make sure I was OK. I was very touched! He also has a great sense of humor so my appointments were actually alot of fun. I never thought I'd use the words "fun" and "appointments" in one sentence! Hah! Now I have a smile that I've always wanted and I'm forever grateful for Dr.Cousin for making this process smooth and pleasant for me.
