reviews.author: William Bay
reviews.text: Dr. Tim was an absolute delight to have as my orthodontist. He was a pleasure to be around and my teeth came out straighter than I ever could have hoped for. I would absolutely recommend having Dr. Tim do your orthodontic treatment.

reviews.author: Ashley Giffing
reviews.text: I decided to work with Dr. Riolo because he is highly qualified and because he is the only orthodontist in the area that offers Incognito (lingual) braces. This type of braces is placed on the inner part of the teeth. It is just like to regular wire braces, but on the opposite side. As a woman in her 30's, there was no way I was going to walk around with conventional braces. I also did not want Invisalign (and Dr. Riolo said my case was too complicated for Invisalign) because I didn't like the idea of needing to take out the aligners each time I ate. The risk of losing the aligners and not wearing the aligners for a long enough period of time is quite high. I highly recommend Incognito. It was quite expensive, but well worth it. I will also worn you that the first 4 months while wearing the braces is very difficult. I was not prepared for this and wish I had been told. I got both the top and bottom braces put on on the same day. For the first week, I couldn't eat anything solid (be prepared for that) because my teeth hurt so much. Also, my tongue hurt a lot. It was getting chopped up by having the braces on the inside of the teeth. It took time for my tongue to get used to it. Make sure you have lots of wax on hand. I'm sure everyone is different, but that was my experience. During this difficult time, Dr. Riolo and his staff were very supportive. Throughout my treatment, I had to go in a few times for comfort visits for different reasons (wire poking me, bracket came off, etc). Riolo's office was good about getting me in quickly and fixing the issue. I recommend making sure you choose an orthodontist that is close to your area in case you need to come in in between appointments. Riolo is laid back, funny and professional. After getting through the initial hard part (first 4 months), my treatment was a breeze. I no longer noticed or thought about the fact that I was wearing braces. The nice thing about Incognito is that you can see the results as they are happening. After 6 months, my teeth already looked great and no one knew I had braces on. My treatment lasted 21 months (almost 2 years). It went by fast. My teeth look so good. Everyone tells me that my teeth look perfect. More importantly, my teeth are now properly aligned, so I no longer experience difficulty with chewing and I stopped grinding my teeth at night. I'm so happy I decided to get Incognito braces. I highly recommend working with Riolo and his team.

reviews.author: Greg Bench
reviews.text: I was a patient of Dr. Riolo's for 2.5 years, and I'm extremely satisfied with my results. While 2.5 years is a long time for an adult with braces, I always felt welcome and comfortable, and the staff was always encouraging and cheered my progress. Dr. Riolo was always professional, accessible, and delivered great results! I love my new smile and highly recommend Dr. Riolo and his awesome staff.

reviews.author: Susie Kosa
reviews.text: Dr Riolo and staff are amazing.  I always enjoyed going to my appointments, as the staff work very hard to get you in and out quickly, but also make the experience enjoyable. I had jaw surgery and had some complications, and he assisted with this, calling the Surgeon on more than one occasion, making sure that my recovery and concerns were being met.  The surgeon himself thought Dr Riolo did an amazing job at aligning my upper/lower jaw. It is obvious that he cares about each and every patient, in getting the best results for each individual that steps through his door.Glad to see he is opening up another office, as the only downside of office visits, was that because he was so great, he tended to be booked out pretty far in advance, but many times he would see me, on days where he had not planned on being in the office.If you are looking for an Orthodontist with years of experience, focusing on the end result for his patients to have a perfectly aligned mouth and beautiful smile, and makes sure to keep up with current technology, and new treatment methods, Dr Riolo is it! reviews.author: Melanie
reviews.text: I sincerely cannot stress or say enough wonderful positive things about my experience with LVO at the various locations. (I have been to two in Seattle,& Bellevue.) You are in trustworthy & competent hands with the people, the technology, the environment.I am so glad I didn’t wait or bother to compare places or look elsewhere!!! I was referred by a staff member from The Whittaker in west seattle location to try LVO for Invisaline. She was in the middle of her process with Invisaline.I am no stranger to doctors, procedures, surgeries- having been in a fatal car accident years ago, so I hope this review serves those who find it well. The process is well worth the investment of time, money & life changing.I will say my process took longer for me - to no fault but my own- because life got in the way of me following the EASY instructions to have a new smile quickly. I also slacked off. What a drag to prolong the beautiful results that were unfolding. If ya don’t slack off, don’t lose your teeth and stay motivated when life gets in the way with following your instructions, it can be  FAST and truly excitingly beautiful results to see your teeth reposition themselves to a new radiant looking smile. I was amazed how my teeth were changing so quickly.A HUGE shout out to GAIL again… She is truly an amazing personable professional.This is also true for the numerous staff working hard at the phones, desk to keep you happy, on schedule and all with an attitude that they seem to love where they work… and of course the doctors.From the moment I walked in they have taken good care of me in a timely attentive manner with such joy to share! reviews.author: Giao Tran
reviews.text: I came to this business due to good reviews, although the dentist and staffs there are great I am disappointed in the lack of transparency in the financial aspect. I was led to believe that they will bill my insurance my quoted price and the rest will be my responsibility. I got back the estimated but they fail to explain to me that they only bill the insurance in the increments of the quoted copay back in 2023.If I know then I would not make any changes in my insurance plan in 2024. Now after 5 MONTHS into 2024, the financial people contacted me and told me the new insurance won’t cover my treatment. Well of course not for this year because I thought it was all done last year. Anyway, please read carefully and make sure they explain how they bill the insurance and get a layout. Now I am stuck with paying extra on op of the already expensive  treatment if I don’t want to stop the treatment early. The financial personnel even said it is up to me if I want to stop the treatment early, well no duh, what else can I do.Overall, learn from my experience and check everything clearly so you don’t feel cheated.P.S the dentists and their assistants are great, this is for the financial department.

reviews.text: Everyone in here is very nice and I really like it.

reviews.author: Melvin Yin
reviews.text: I was an adult transfer patient from California for traditional braces, and Dr Leone kindly took over my case when I moved to Seattle. He (along with the other orthodontists) have always been patient, kind, and thorough in my treatment and explaining to me the process. They're highly skilled and adapt their treatment plans to my halfway-done treatment, a difficult task and something that many other orthodontists in the area do not want to take up.Cristal was my assistant and has been for at least 2+ sessions. She is always patient and kind, and is willing to go many extra steps to ensure the comfort of her patients, such as grinding down the excess wire as much as possible, and listening and explaining to me my treatment progress and even providing heads-ups that I might need to come in earlier than expected when, because of the treatment progress, I might have a wire poking soon. Kudos to the many other nurses at the office as well, they are all equally and highly skilled and kind.The offices in both Interbay and Bellevue (have not visited the rest) are extremely clean and orderly, it's honestly the cleanest and nicest dentist office I've been to, despite the high patient flow and many treatment desks. The receptionists pick up the phone almost immediately usually.It's been an absolute pleasure and I would highly recommend anyone, whether on traditional (me) or invisalign (seems to be their specialty) or others, and whether adult or child, to consider this orthodontist office. You can go to any of their locations and it's basically the same.P.S. personal story, when I first moved to Seattle I had trouble finding an orthodontist that's willing to take an adult transfer case, and because of my wire poking I foolishly manipulated the wire myself with pliers, bending it really badly. When Dr Leone saw me he said it's up to me whether I want him to take over my care, but as a matter of professional principle he's definitely (joking) not letting me walk out of his office with that bad wire. In the end I was offered whether to sign up for treatment with him, or just fix the wire for that day and I can go to some other orthodontist. That, is extremely kind of him, and he as well as the other staff have never failed to meet the extremely high expectations I have of him since that first visit. Thank you for this.Oh and they charge very reasonable fees, it was the lowest quote I have around the Seattle/Bellevue area, so if that's a concern. The decor and offices are extremely nice though so this definitely doesn't reflect the standard of care or quality of offices. They also support multiple insurances, at least guardian, and they handle all of the paperwork, I don't have to file any claim or indeed do anything apart from reviewing and signing documents from them.

reviews.author: family yadlin
reviews.text: As a parent of three children undergoing orthodontic treatment, I can confidently say that Kitagaito Orthodontics is an absolute gem, a practice that consistently exceeds expectations on every front. From the moment you walk through their doors, it's clear you're in the hands of a team truly dedicated to creating beautiful, healthy smiles.First and foremost, Dr. Kaz is simply wonderful. "Extremely nice" doesn't even begin to cover it. He possesses a remarkable ability to connect with both kids and adults, making what could be an intimidating process feel genuinely comfortable and even fun. His warmth, patience, and clear communication are truly a breath of fresh air, and my children genuinely enjoy their visits, which, as any parent knows, is half the battle!What truly sets Kitagaito Orthodontics apart, however, is their unwavering commitment to patient comfort and efficiency, largely thanks to their state-of-the-art technology. It's evident they invest in the latest advancements to ensure treatments are as smooth and pain-free as possible. From initial diagnostics to adjustments, every step is optimized, making the orthodontic journey surprisingly comfortable for all three of my kids. This modern approach truly makes a difference in the overall experience.And let's talk about the practicalities: cost. Having researched various orthodontic practices, I can confidently say that Kitagaito Orthodontics offers truly affordable rates without compromising on quality of care. This was a significant factor for our family with multiple children needing treatment. On top of their already competitive pricing, the family discounts they offer are an incredible bonus, making top-tier orthodontic care accessible and manageable.In summary, if you're searching for an orthodontist who combines exceptional expertise with genuine compassion, utilizes cutting-edge technology for maximum comfort, and offers truly affordable rates with fantastic family discounts, look no further than Kitagaito Orthodontics. Dr. Kaz and his team have created a welcoming and highly effective environment where smiles flourish. We couldn't be happier with our experience, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to any family seeking outstanding orthodontic care.

I don’t doubt people having good experiences at angolkar because the staff are quite nice and I personally had no issues with them ever and I personally have friends who have went there and told me they loved there end results. reviews.author: Niuvis Ferro-Gonzalez
reviews.text: My child and I visited the orthodontics office today.I give 3 stars to this clinic because the orthodontic treatment my child is receiving is actually working.However,  the whole environment of this facility is not welcoming.The space is limited and parents are denied the opportunity to be anywhere near their children while they are getting their braces. So, children are called by the technician and are taken to the back without having their parent's emotional support. To me that is wrong.Today we arrived at 9:25 am. They had a radio station on, with very upbeat music. The music was so loud that my ears felt uncomfortable.I had a hard time hearing what the receptionist was saying when we checked in and then as we tried scheduling my child's next appointment.During the entire time we were there,  patients and their relatives were raising their voices (yelling) as they talked to each other in the waiting area. Why? Because they couldn't hear each other over the loud music.No one took the time to explain to me what was going to be done prior calling my child and no one came to talk with me afterwards. I had to request that an explanation could be given to me. Yes, I need to know what my child is having done. Why? Because I am her mother.I did not know,  for example,  that my child was going to have x rays taken today.  Had I known, i would have reminded my child that covering her Thyroid gland is necessary.When I asked  my child about this, she reported that she did weare the lead apron, but does not recall having her Thyroid gland area covered. Maybe she had it covered and she simply doesn't remember, but I was not in the back with her so right now I don't know the true answer to that question.Here is the bottom line:The braces are doing their job, so we are happy about that.However, I would like to suggest that the dynamic of the clinic changes and turns into a more calmed and medical setting appropriate environment.I would love to see that staff are mindful of the fact that getting braces can make children anxious, so please choose a relaxing music that might help patients and their parents feel calmed and in good hands. This is not a disco club; this is a clinic.Please discuss with parents what is being done at each appointment.I realize the majority of the staff are young,  but that doesn't mean they can't be professionals.Braces are not cheap,  so even if the staff,  other than the doctor,  do not realize that patients are the stars of the show,  at least think of the customer service you provide, as a service we, the patients and their parents,  are paying for.Therefore it is not inappropriate that we ask for care quality.We are looking forward to see customer service improvements next time we visit the clinic.Orherwise, we will be looking into switching to a different provider in the near future.
